lines.traditional: 這不是汽水，是我自己做的檸檬汁，沒加糖。汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完醫生以後就沒再喝過。
lines.simplified: 这不是汽水，是我自己做的柠檬汁，没加糖。汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完医生以后就没再喝过。
lines.pinyin: Zhè bú shì qìshuǐ, shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de níngméngzhī, méi jiā táng. Qìshuǐ wǒ zǎo jiù bù hē le, qùnián kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu jiù méi zài hē guo.
lines.english: This isn't soda; it's lemon juice I made myself, with no sugar. I gave up soda long ago. I haven't had any since I saw the doctor last year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？難怪你最近看起來瘦了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？难怪你最近看起来瘦了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nánguài nǐ zuìjìn kànqǐlái shòu le.
lines.english: Really? No wonder you've looked thinner lately.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他最近才開始不喝汽水
choices.simplified: 他最近才开始不喝汽水
choices.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn cái kāishǐ bù hē qìshuǐ.
choices.english: He only stopped drinking soda recently.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他現在少喝一點汽水了
choices.simplified: 他现在少喝一点汽水了
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài shǎo hē yìdiǎn qìshuǐ le.
choices.english: He drinks a bit less soda now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經很久沒喝汽水了
choices.simplified: 他已经很久没喝汽水了
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méi hē qìshuǐ le.
choices.english: He hasn't had soda for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài háishì cháng hē qìshuǐ.
choices.english: He still drinks soda often.

questions.why: 汽水我早就不喝了，去年看完醫生以後就沒再喝過: he gave up soda long ago, after seeing the doctor last year, and he is drinking homemade lemon juice. 最近 is only when the woman noticed he looked thinner, and drinking less (少喝一點) was the doctor's advice, not what he does.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要去當模特兒？你不是念設計的嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你要去当模特儿？你不是念设计的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào qù dāng mótèr? Nǐ bú shì niàn shèjì de ma?
lines.english: I hear you're going to be a model? Aren't you studying design?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。當模特兒可以認識很多做設計的人，對我以後的工作有幫助。再說，給的錢也不少。我媽媽要我拿這些錢去買車，可是我想先存一年，以後去國外念書。
lines.simplified: 对啊。当模特儿可以认识很多做设计的人，对我以后的工作有帮助。再说，给的钱也不少。我妈妈要我拿这些钱去买车，可是我想先存一年，以后去国外念书。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Dāng mótèr kěyǐ rènshì hěn duō zuò shèjì de rén, duì wǒ yǐhòu de gōngzuò yǒu bāngzhù. Zàishuō, gěi de qián yě bù shǎo. Wǒ māma yào wǒ ná zhèxiē qián qù mǎi chē, kěshì wǒ xiǎng xiān cún yì nián, yǐhòu qù guówài niànshū.
lines.english: Yes. As a model I can meet a lot of designers, which will help my future work. Besides, the pay is good. My mom wants me to use the money to buy a car, but I want to save it for a year first and go abroad to study later.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 原來你早就計畫好了。
lines.simplified: 原来你早就计划好了。
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái nǐ zǎo jiù jìhuà hǎo le.
lines.english: So you planned it all long ago.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算用當模特兒的錢做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算用当模特儿的钱做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn yòng dāng mótèr de qián zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do with the money from modelling?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào bié de guójiā liúxué.
choices.english: Study in another country.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi yí liàng zìjǐ de chē.
choices.english: Buy a car of his own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fù dàxué de xuéfèi.
choices.english: Pay his university fees.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi shèjì yòng de diànnǎo.
choices.english: Buy a computer for design work.

questions.why: 再說 adds a second reason: the pay is good, and he wants to save it for a year and then study abroad (去國外念書). Buying a car is what his mother wants, and he says nothing about fees or a computer.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個星期六是我女兒滿月，我們想請親人朋友吃飯，妳那天有空嗎？
lines.simplified: 下个星期六是我女儿满月，我们想请亲人朋友吃饭，你那天有空吗？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù shì wǒ nǚ'ér mǎnyuè, wǒmen xiǎng qǐng qīnrén péngyǒu chīfàn, nǐ nà tiān yǒu kòng ma?
lines.english: Next Saturday my daughter will be one month old. We want to invite family and friends to a meal. Are you free that day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有空，恭喜你！要在你家請嗎？
lines.simplified: 有空，恭喜你！要在你家请吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǒu kòng, gōngxǐ nǐ! Yào zài nǐ jiā qǐng ma?
lines.english: Yes, I am. Congratulations! Will you have it at your home?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來想在家裡請，可是我家太小了；朋友開的餐廳又太遠。我跟我太太找來找去，終於找到一家離我家很近的。
lines.simplified: 本来想在家里请，可是我家太小了；朋友开的餐厅又太远。我跟我太太找来找去，终于找到一家离我家很近的。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng zài jiā lǐ qǐng, kěshì wǒ jiā tài xiǎo le; péngyǒu kāi de cāntīng yòu tài yuǎn. Wǒ gēn wǒ tàitai zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zhǎodào yì jiā lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn de.
lines.english: At first we wanted to have it at home, but our place is too small, and a friend's restaurant is too far away. My wife and I searched and searched, and finally found one very close to our home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你們這幾天一定很忙吧？
lines.simplified: 那你们这几天一定很忙吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen zhè jǐ tiān yídìng hěn máng ba?
lines.english: You must be very busy these days, then.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還好，最忙的是我媽媽。她每天不是打電話請親人來，就是去買要送客人的禮物，比我們還開心。
lines.simplified: 还好，最忙的是我妈妈。她每天不是打电话请亲人来，就是去买要送客人的礼物，比我们还开心。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo, zuì máng de shì wǒ māma. Tā měi tiān bú shì dǎ diànhuà qǐng qīnrén lái, jiùshì qù mǎi yào sòng kèrén de lǐwù, bǐ wǒmen hái kāixīn.
lines.english: Not too bad. The busiest one is my mother. Every day she is either phoning relatives to invite them or buying gifts for the guests. She's even happier than we are.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 滿月那天他們要在哪裡請客？
prompt.simplified: 满月那天他们要在哪里请客？
prompt.pinyin: Mǎnyuè nà tiān tāmen yào zài nǎlǐ qǐngkè?
prompt.english: Where will they hold the meal on the full-month day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài tā zìjǐ jiā lǐ.
choices.english: At his own home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài tā māma jiā lǐ.
choices.english: At his mother's home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài péngyǒu kāi de cāntīng.
choices.english: At a friend's restaurant.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài tā jiā fùjìn de cāntīng.
choices.english: At a restaurant near his home.

questions.why: 終於找到一家離我家很近的: after a long search they finally found a restaurant near his home. His home is too small and the friend's restaurant too far, and nobody mentions his mother's home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說他媽媽這幾天在忙什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的说他妈妈这几天在忙什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō tā māma zhè jǐ tiān zài máng shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man say his mother has been busy with these days?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhàogù háizi, zuò jiāshì.
choices.english: Looking after the baby and doing housework.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo cāntīng, kàn càidān.
choices.english: Looking for a restaurant and reading menus.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎsǎo jiā lǐ, zuòfàn.
choices.english: Cleaning the home and cooking.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yāoqǐng qīnrén, zhǔnbèi lǐwù.
choices.english: Inviting relatives and getting gifts ready.

questions.why: 不是打電話請親人來，就是去買……禮物: every day she does one of two things, phoning relatives to invite them or buying gifts for the guests. The man and his wife looked for the restaurant; nobody says she cooks, cleans or looks after the baby.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你妹妹上個星期生了孩子，我們這個週末去看她，好不好？
lines.simplified: 你妹妹上个星期生了孩子，我们这个周末去看她，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei shàng ge xīngqí shēng le háizi, wǒmen zhège zhōumò qù kàn tā, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Your sister had a baby last week. Shall we go and see her this weekend?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個週末先別去吧。我雖然有空，她精神也很好，可是她婆婆這個週末要從南部來陪她坐月子，她家會很擠。等孩子滿月以後再去吧。
lines.simplified: 这个周末先别去吧。我虽然有空，她精神也很好，可是她婆婆这个周末要从南部来陪她坐月子，她家会很挤。等孩子满月以后再去吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò xiān bié qù ba. Wǒ suīrán yǒukòng, tā jīngshén yě hěn hǎo, kěshì tā pópo zhège zhōumò yào cóng nánbù lái péi tā zuòyuèzi, tā jiā huì hěn jǐ. Děng háizi mǎnyuè yǐhòu zài qù ba.
lines.english: Let's not go this weekend. I am free, and she's feeling fine, but her mother-in-law is coming up from the south this weekend to stay with her during her month of rest, so her place will be crowded. Let's wait until the baby is a month old.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐月子要注意什麼？我只聽說不能洗頭。
lines.simplified: 坐月子要注意什么？我只听说不能洗头。
lines.pinyin: Zuòyuèzi yào zhùyì shénme? Wǒ zhǐ tīngshuō bù néng xǐ tóu.
lines.english: What do you have to be careful about during that month? I've only heard you can't wash your hair.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不能洗頭，也不能喝冷的。大家都說現在的年輕媽媽沒那麼注意了，可是我不這麼想。我覺得現在很多媽媽比以前的人還要小心，像我妹妹，連水都只喝熱的。
lines.simplified: 不能洗头，也不能喝冷的。大家都说现在的年轻妈妈没那么注意了，可是我不这么想。我觉得现在很多妈妈比以前的人还要小心，像我妹妹，连水都只喝热的。
lines.pinyin: Bù néng xǐ tóu, yě bù néng hē lěng de. Dàjiā dōu shuō xiànzài de niánqīng māma méi nàme zhùyì le, kěshì wǒ bú zhème xiǎng. Wǒ juéde xiànzài hěn duō māma bǐ yǐqián de rén hái yào xiǎoxīn, xiàng wǒ mèimei, lián shuǐ dōu zhǐ hē rè de.
lines.english: No washing your hair and no cold drinks. Everyone says young mothers today aren't so careful, but I don't think so. I think many mothers today are even more careful than people in the past. My sister, for example, only drinks hot water.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我先買一些水果，請人送過去給她吧。
lines.simplified: 那我先买一些水果，请人送过去给她吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiān mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ, qǐng rén sòng guòqù gěi tā ba.
lines.english: Then I'll buy some fruit first and have someone take it to her.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼說這個週末先別去？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么说这个周末先别去？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme shuō zhège zhōumò xiān bié qù?
prompt.english: Why does the man say they shouldn't go this weekend?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei de pópo yào lái zhù.
choices.english: The sister's mother-in-law is coming to stay.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de zhège zhōumò méi kòng.
choices.english: The man isn't free this weekend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei xiànzài xūyào xiūxí.
choices.english: The sister needs rest now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi hái zhù zài yīyuàn lǐ.
choices.english: The baby is still in hospital.

questions.why: 可是她婆婆這個週末要從南部來陪她坐月子，她家會很擠: her mother-in-law is coming that weekend, so the home will be crowded. He says he is free and his sister is feeling fine (精神也很好), and nobody mentions a hospital.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得現在的年輕媽媽坐月子怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得现在的年轻妈妈坐月子怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xiànzài de niánqīng māma zuòyuèzi zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man say about young mothers' month of rest today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu yǐqián de māma zhùyì.
choices.english: They are less careful than mothers used to be.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián de māma chàbùduō.
choices.english: They are about the same as mothers in the past.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ yǐqián de māma gèng zhùyì.
choices.english: They are more careful than mothers used to be.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǐjīng bú tài zuòyuèzi le.
choices.english: They hardly rest after the birth any more.

questions.why: 大家都說……沒那麼注意了，可是我不這麼想。我覺得現在很多媽媽比以前的人還要小心: he disagrees with what everyone says and thinks mothers today are even more careful (his sister drinks only hot water). "Less careful" is the view he rejects.

focus.zh: 可是我覺得……比以前的人還要小心

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小華，是媽媽。你上次說這個月工作很忙，所以我們就比較少打電話給你。
lines.simplified: 小华，是妈妈。你上次说这个月工作很忙，所以我们就比较少打电话给你。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎohuá, shì māma. Nǐ shàng cì shuō zhège yuè gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen jiù bǐjiào shǎo dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
lines.english: Xiaohua, it's Mom. Last time you said you were busy at work this month, so we haven't been calling you much.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 告訴你一個好消息：你姊姊找到了新工作，下個月就要搬到臺北去了。
lines.simplified: 告诉你一个好消息：你姐姐找到了新工作，下个月就要搬到台北去了。
lines.pinyin: Gàosu nǐ yí ge hǎo xiāoxí: nǐ jiějie zhǎodào le xīn gōngzuò, xià ge yuè jiù yào bān dào Táiběi qù le.
lines.english: Here's some good news: your sister has found a new job, and next month she's moving to Taipei.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你爸爸本來想開車帶她去臺北找房子，可是她說想自己去找。這幾天我們除了上班以外，就是幫她把要帶走的衣服和書放進箱子裡。
lines.simplified: 你爸爸本来想开车带她去台北找房子，可是她说想自己去找。这几天我们除了上班以外，就是帮她把要带走的衣服和书放进箱子里。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba běnlái xiǎng kāichē dài tā qù Táiběi zhǎo fángzi, kěshì tā shuō xiǎng zìjǐ qù zhǎo. Zhè jǐ tiān wǒmen chúle shàngbān yǐwài, jiùshì bāng tā bǎ yào dài zǒu de yīfu hé shū fàng jìn xiāngzi lǐ.
lines.english: Your dad wanted to drive her to Taipei to look for a place to live, but she said she wants to look on her own. These days, apart from going to work, all we do is help her put the clothes and books she is taking into boxes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你工作忙，不用特地回來。等你有空的時候，打個電話給你姊姊，跟她說聲恭喜，祝她工作順利吧。
lines.simplified: 你工作忙，不用特地回来。等你有空的时候，打个电话给你姐姐，跟她说声恭喜，祝她工作顺利吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gōngzuò máng, búyòng tèdì huílái. Děng nǐ yǒukòng de shíhòu, dǎ ge diànhuà gěi nǐ jiějie, gēn tā shuō shēng gōngxǐ, zhù tā gōngzuò shùnlì ba.
lines.english: You're busy at work, so there's no need to come home specially. When you have time, give your sister a call, congratulate her and wish her well in her new job.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位媽媽這幾天下班以後常做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这位妈妈这几天下班以后常做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi māma zhè jǐ tiān xiàbān yǐhòu cháng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the mother usually do after work these days?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bāng nǚ'ér zhǔnbèi xínglǐ.
choices.english: She helps her daughter pack her things.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dài nǚ'ér qù zhǎo fángzi.
choices.english: She takes her daughter to look for a place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bāng nǚ'ér mǎi xīn xiāngzi.
choices.english: She buys new boxes for her daughter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péi nǚ'ér qù kàn xīn gōngsī.
choices.english: She goes with her daughter to see the new company.

passage.traditional: 同事的女兒滿月，請我去她家吃飯。這是我第一次參加這樣的活動，我因為不{1}臺灣的習慣，就先問了一位臺灣朋友。她說滿月的禮物{2}紅包，就是小孩的衣服。紅包裡的錢最好是雙數，不過要{3}「四」，因為「四」聽起來像「死」。她還說，去別人家吃飯，要到得{4}：太早到，別人還在忙；太晚到，大家得等你。這次的經驗不僅讓我認識了臺灣的文化，{5}讓我跟同事變得更熟了。現在，我{6}知道怎麼送禮了。

passage.pinyin: Tóngshì de nǚ'ér mǎnyuè, qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā chīfàn. Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì cānjiā zhèyàng de huódòng, wǒ yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ Táiwān de xíguàn, jiù xiān wèn le yí wèi Táiwān péngyǒu. Tā shuō mǎnyuè de lǐwù bú shì hóngbāo, jiùshì xiǎohái de yīfu. Hóngbāo lǐ de qián zuìhǎo shì shuāngshù, búguò yào bìmiǎn “sì”, yīnwèi “sì” tīngqǐlái xiàng “sǐ”. Tā hái shuō, qù biérén jiā chīfàn, yào dào de bù zǎo bù wǎn: tài zǎo dào, biérén hái zài máng; tài wǎn dào, dàjiā děi děng nǐ. Zhè cì de jīngyàn bù jǐn ràng wǒ rènshì le Táiwān de wénhuà, hái ràng wǒ gēn tóngshì biàn de gèng shóu le. Xiànzài, wǒ zhōngyú zhīdào zěnme sònglǐ le.
passage.english: My colleague's baby girl turned one month old, and she invited me to a meal at her home. It was my first time at such an event, and because I wasn't clear about Taiwanese customs, I first asked a Taiwanese friend. She said a full-month gift is either a red envelope or baby clothes. The money in a red envelope should be an even number, but you must avoid "four", because "four" sounds like "death". She also said that when you go to someone's home for a meal, you should arrive neither early nor late: too early and they are still busy; too late and everyone has to wait for you. This experience not only taught me about Taiwanese culture but also brought me closer to my colleague. Now I finally know how to give gifts.

passage.traditional: 結婚以後，我跟先生的父母住在一起。剛開始，我做的菜{1}太鹹，就是太甜。公公每次都吃得很少，可是婆婆總是笑著說：「{2}做得不好也沒關係，多做幾次就會了。」後來我才知道，公公的身體不太好，醫生要他{3}吃太鹹、太甜的東西。婆婆還教我，醬油和糖放太多不行，放太少也不行，要放得{4}，菜才會好吃。我練習了半年，{5}做出了公公說好吃的魚。現在，公公{6}剩下我做的魚，一次都沒有過。
passage.simplified: 结婚以后，我跟先生的父母住在一起。刚开始，我做的菜{1}太咸，就是太甜。公公每次都吃得很少，可是婆婆总是笑着说：「{2}做得不好也没关系，多做几次就会了。」后来我才知道，公公的身体不太好，医生要他{3}吃太咸、太甜的东西。婆婆还教我，酱油和糖放太多不行，放太少也不行，要放得{4}，菜才会好吃。我练习了半年，{5}做出了公公说好吃的鱼。现在，公公{6}剩下我做的鱼，一次都没有过。
passage.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐhòu, wǒ gēn xiānshēng de fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ zuò de cài bú shì tài xián, jiùshì tài tián. Gōnggōng měi cì dōu chī de hěn shǎo, kěshì pópo zǒngshì xiào zhe shuō: “Jiùsuàn zuò de bù hǎo yě méi guānxì, duō zuò jǐ cì jiù huì le.” Hòulái wǒ cái zhīdào, gōnggōng de shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, yīshēng yào tā bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài tián de dōngxi. Pópo hái jiāo wǒ, jiàngyóu hé táng fàng tài duō bù xíng, fàng tài shǎo yě bù xíng, yào fàng de bù duō bù shǎo, cài cái huì hǎochī. Wǒ liànxí le bàn nián, zhōngyú zuò chū le gōnggōng shuō hǎochī de yú. Xiànzài, gōnggōng cóngbù shèngxià wǒ zuò de yú, yí cì dōu méiyǒu guo.
passage.english: After we married, I lived with my husband's parents. At first my cooking was either too salty or too sweet. My father-in-law always ate very little, but my mother-in-law always said with a smile, "Even if it isn't good, it doesn't matter. Cook it a few more times and you'll get it." Later I learned that my father-in-law's health is not good, and his doctor wants him to avoid food that is too salty or too sweet. My mother-in-law also taught me that too much soy sauce or sugar is no good, and too little is no good either: you must put in neither too much nor too little, and then the food tastes good. After practising for half a year, I finally made a fish my father-in-law called delicious. Now my father-in-law never leaves any of my fish, not even once.

text.traditional:
親愛的朋友：
謝謝大家這個月的祝福和禮物！我們家安安這個星期六滿月，我們準備了油飯和紅蛋要送給大家。
請大家星期六下午兩點到五點來我家拿。那天沒空的人，跟我說一聲，我先生星期天晚上會開車送過去。
安安還小，怕吵，所以這次就不請大家進來坐了。等安安大一點，再請大家來家裡吃飯！
安安媽媽
text.simplified:
亲爱的朋友：
谢谢大家这个月的祝福和礼物！我们家安安这个星期六满月，我们准备了油饭和红蛋要送给大家。
请大家星期六下午两点到五点来我家拿。那天没空的人，跟我说一声，我先生星期天晚上会开车送过去。
安安还小，怕吵，所以这次就不请大家进来坐了。等安安大一点，再请大家来家里吃饭！
安安妈妈
text.pinyin:
Qīn'ài de péngyǒu:
Xièxie dàjiā zhège yuè de zhùfú hé lǐwù! Wǒmen jiā Ān'ān zhège xīngqíliù mǎnyuè, wǒmen zhǔnbèi le yóufàn hé hóngdàn yào sòng gěi dàjiā.
Qǐng dàjiā xīngqíliù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn dào wǔ diǎn lái wǒ jiā ná. Nà tiān méi kòng de rén, gēn wǒ shuō yì shēng, wǒ xiānshēng xīngqítiān wǎnshàng huì kāichē sòng guòqù.
Ān'ān hái xiǎo, pà chǎo, suǒyǐ zhè cì jiù bù qǐng dàjiā jìnlái zuò le. Děng Ān'ān dà yìdiǎn, zài qǐng dàjiā lái jiā lǐ chīfàn!
Ān'ān māma
text.english:
Dear friends,
Thank you all for your good wishes and gifts this month! Our An'an turns one month old this Saturday, and we have made oil rice and red eggs for all of you.
Please come to our home on Saturday between 2 and 5 p.m. to pick them up. If you are not free that day, just tell me, and my husband will drive them over on Sunday evening.
An'an is still small and is bothered by noise, so this time we won't ask you in. When An'an is a bit bigger, we'll invite you all over for a meal!
An'an's mom

text.traditional: 大學四年，我跟我的室友住在同一個房間。我們常一塊去夜市吃東西，考試以前也一起在圖書館念書，還常常討論畢業以後要做什麼。她是個很開朗的人，跟她在一起的時候，我總是笑個不停。有一次我考得很不好，難過得一直哭，她什麼也沒說，只是一張一張地抽面紙給我。畢業以後，她回她的國家工作了，我們已經三年沒見面了。不過，我們每個星期都會在網路上聊天，好像她還住在我隔壁。她說，大學的這些回憶，對她來說也很珍貴。我覺得，好朋友就算離得很遠，關係也不會變。
text.simplified: 大学四年，我跟我的室友住在同一个房间。我们常一块去夜市吃东西，考试以前也一起在图书馆念书，还常常讨论毕业以后要做什么。她是个很开朗的人，跟她在一起的时候，我总是笑个不停。有一次我考得很不好，难过得一直哭，她什么也没说，只是一张一张地抽面纸给我。毕业以后，她回她的国家工作了，我们已经三年没见面了。不过，我们每个星期都会在网路上聊天，好像她还住在我隔壁。她说，大学的这些回忆，对她来说也很珍贵。我觉得，好朋友就算离得很远，关系也不会变。
text.pinyin: Dàxué sì nián, wǒ gēn wǒ de shìyǒu zhù zài tóng yí ge fángjiān. Wǒmen cháng yíkuài qù yèshì chī dōngxi, kǎoshì yǐqián yě yìqǐ zài túshūguǎn niànshū, hái chángcháng tǎolùn bìyè yǐhòu yào zuò shénme. Tā shì ge hěn kāilǎng de rén, gēn tā zài yìqǐ de shíhòu, wǒ zǒngshì xiào ge bù tíng. Yǒu yí cì wǒ kǎo de hěn bù hǎo, nánguò de yìzhí kū, tā shénme yě méi shuō, zhǐshì yì zhāng yì zhāng de chōu miànzhǐ gěi wǒ. Bìyè yǐhòu, tā huí tā de guójiā gōngzuò le, wǒmen yǐjīng sān nián méi jiànmiàn le. Búguò, wǒmen měi ge xīngqí dōu huì zài wǎnglù shàng liáotiān, hǎoxiàng tā hái zhù zài wǒ gébì. Tā shuō, dàxué de zhèxiē huíyì, duì tā lái shuō yě hěn zhēnguì. Wǒ juéde, hǎo péngyǒu jiùsuàn lí de hěn yuǎn, guānxì yě bú huì biàn.
text.english: For four years at university, my roommate and I shared a room. We often went to the night market together, studied together in the library before exams, and often talked about what to do after graduating. She is very cheerful; when I was with her, I could never stop laughing. Once I did very badly in an exam and couldn't stop crying. She didn't say a word; she just pulled out tissues for me, one after another. After graduating she went back to her own country to work, and we haven't seen each other for three years. But we chat online every week, as if she still lived next door. She says these university memories are precious to her too. I think that even when good friends live far apart, their friendship does not change.

title.english: After the Baby Turned One Month

text.traditional: 我跟我先生都要上班，所以孩子滿月以後，就請我媽媽來幫忙照顧。我媽媽養大了三個孩子，經驗比我們多，孩子一哭，她抱一抱就好了。不過，我們也有不同的想法。我媽媽覺得孩子胖一點才健康，常常餵他喝很多奶；可是醫生說，孩子不胖不瘦最好，吃太多對身體沒有好處。剛開始，我們常常為了這件事不高興。後來我想，媽媽是因為愛孩子才這樣做的，所以我不再跟她吵了，帶她一起去看醫生，請醫生跟她說明。現在，媽媽終於了解了，家裡也不再因為這件事吵架了。
text.simplified: 我跟我先生都要上班，所以孩子满月以后，就请我妈妈来帮忙照顾。我妈妈养大了三个孩子，经验比我们多，孩子一哭，她抱一抱就好了。不过，我们也有不同的想法。我妈妈觉得孩子胖一点才健康，常常喂他喝很多奶；可是医生说，孩子不胖不瘦最好，吃太多对身体没有好处。刚开始，我们常常为了这件事不高兴。后来我想，妈妈是因为爱孩子才这样做的，所以我不再跟她吵了，带她一起去看医生，请医生跟她说明。现在，妈妈终于了解了，家里也不再因为这件事吵架了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ xiānshēng dōu yào shàngbān, suǒyǐ háizi mǎnyuè yǐhòu, jiù qǐng wǒ māma lái bāngmáng zhàogù. Wǒ māma yǎng dà le sān ge háizi, jīngyàn bǐ wǒmen duō, háizi yì kū, tā bào yí bào jiù hǎo le. Búguò, wǒmen yě yǒu bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ māma juéde háizi pàng yìdiǎn cái jiànkāng, chángcháng wèi tā hē hěn duō nǎi; kěshì yīshēng shuō, háizi bú pàng bú shòu zuì hǎo, chī tài duō duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒmen chángcháng wèile zhè jiàn shì bù gāoxìng. Hòulái wǒ xiǎng, māma shì yīnwèi ài háizi cái zhèyàng zuò de, suǒyǐ wǒ bú zài gēn tā chǎo le, dài tā yìqǐ qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng yīshēng gēn tā shuōmíng. Xiànzài, māma zhōngyú liǎojiě le, jiā lǐ yě bú zài yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì chǎojià le.
text.english: My husband and I both work, so after our baby was a month old, we asked my mother to help look after him. My mother raised three children and has more experience than we do; whenever the baby cries, she holds him for a moment and he is fine. But we also had different ideas. My mother thinks a baby is healthy only if he is a bit chubby, and she often fed him a lot of milk; but the doctor said a baby is best neither fat nor thin, and eating too much is not good for the body. At first we were often upset with each other over this. Later I thought: my mother does this because she loves the baby. So I stopped arguing with her and took her with me to the doctor, and asked the doctor to explain it to her. Now my mother finally understands, and we no longer quarrel about it at home.

text.traditional: 我弟弟今年十五歲，最近非常喜歡去超商。原來，那家超商正在舉辦活動，每買一杯飲料就送一個神祕小禮物，一共有十二種，打開以後才知道是哪一種。為了拿到全部的禮物，弟弟一天要去好幾回，把零用錢都花在飲料上，喝得連飯都吃不下了。媽媽知道以後很生氣，說他白花了很多錢。弟弟本來不肯聽，可是經過一個月，他發現最後一種怎麼買都買不到，連自己都覺得太不值得了，就說：「算了，不要了。」現在，他用剩下的零用錢來買書，也很少去超商了。
text.simplified: 我弟弟今年十五岁，最近非常喜欢去超商。原来，那家超商正在举办活动，每买一杯饮料就送一个神秘小礼物，一共有十二种，打开以后才知道是哪一种。为了拿到全部的礼物，弟弟一天要去好几回，把零用钱都花在饮料上，喝得连饭都吃不下了。妈妈知道以后很生气，说他白花了很多钱。弟弟本来不肯听，可是经过一个月，他发现最后一种怎么买都买不到，连自己都觉得太不值得了，就说：「算了，不要了。」现在，他用剩下的零用钱来买书，也很少去超商了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi jīnnián shíwǔ suì, zuìjìn fēicháng xǐhuān qù chāoshāng. Yuánlái, nà jiā chāoshāng zhèngzài jǔbàn huódòng, měi mǎi yì bēi yǐnliào jiù sòng yí ge shénmì xiǎo lǐwù, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng, dǎkāi yǐhòu cái zhīdào shì nǎ yì zhǒng. Wèile nádào quánbù de lǐwù, dìdi yì tiān yào qù hǎo jǐ huí, bǎ língyòngqián dōu huā zài yǐnliào shàng, hē de lián fàn dōu chī bú xià le. Māma zhīdào yǐhòu hěn shēngqì, shuō tā bái huā le hěn duō qián. Dìdi běnlái bù kěn tīng, kěshì jīngguò yí ge yuè, tā fāxiàn zuìhòu yì zhǒng zěnme mǎi dōu mǎi bú dào, lián zìjǐ dōu juéde tài bù zhídé le, jiù shuō: 「Suàn le, bú yào le.」 Xiànzài, tā yòng shèngxià de língyòngqián lái mǎi shū, yě hěn shǎo qù chāoshāng le.
text.english: My younger brother is fifteen, and lately he loves going to the convenience store. It turns out the store is running a promotion: every drink comes with a mystery gift, twelve kinds in all, and you only find out which one when you open it. To collect them all he went several times a day and spent all his pocket money on drinks, drinking so much he couldn't even eat his meals. When Mom found out she was angry and said he had wasted a lot of money. At first he wouldn't listen, but after a month he found that however many he bought he could never get the last kind; even he felt it wasn't worth it and said, 'Forget it, I don't want it.' Now he uses his leftover pocket money to buy books, and he rarely goes to the store.

text.traditional: 我奶奶很會說故事。小時候，我每天晚上都要聽她說一個故事才肯睡覺。她的故事都是她自己想出來的，有會說話的貓，也有住在月亮上的老人。去年奶奶八十歲了，常常忘了事情，我怕以後聽不到這些故事，就請她再說一遍，用手機把她說的故事都錄了下來。後來，我把這些故事寫下來，每一個故事都配上我自己畫的圖，做出了一本小書。奶奶生日那天，我把這本書送給她。她一頁一頁地看，笑著說：「我說的故事，現在都在一本書裡了！多麼好啊！」現在，家裡的小孩睡覺以前，也都要聽這些故事。
text.simplified: 我奶奶很会说故事。小时候，我每天晚上都要听她说一个故事才肯睡觉。她的故事都是她自己想出来的，有会说话的猫，也有住在月亮上的老人。去年奶奶八十岁了，常常忘了事情，我怕以后听不到这些故事，就请她再说一遍，用手机把她说的故事都录了下来。后来，我把这些故事写下来，每一个故事都配上我自己画的图，做出了一本小书。奶奶生日那天，我把这本书送给她。她一页一页地看，笑着说：「我说的故事，现在都在一本书里了！多么好啊！」现在，家里的小孩睡觉以前，也都要听这些故事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai hěn huì shuō gùshì. Xiǎoshíhòu, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu yào tīng tā shuō yí ge gùshì cái kěn shuìjiào. Tā de gùshì dōu shì tā zìjǐ xiǎng chūlái de, yǒu huì shuōhuà de māo, yě yǒu zhù zài yuèliàng shàng de lǎorén. Qùnián nǎinai bāshí suì le, chángcháng wàng le shìqíng, wǒ pà yǐhòu tīng bú dào zhèxiē gùshì, jiù qǐng tā zài shuō yí biàn, yòng shǒujī bǎ tā shuō de gùshì dōu lù le xiàlái. Hòulái, wǒ bǎ zhèxiē gùshì xiě xiàlái, měi yí ge gùshì dōu pèi shàng wǒ zìjǐ huà de tú, zuò chū le yì běn xiǎo shū. Nǎinai shēngrì nà tiān, wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū sòng gěi tā. Tā yí yè yí yè de kàn, xiào zhe shuō: 「Wǒ shuō de gùshì, xiànzài dōu zài yì běn shū lǐ le! Duóme hǎo a!」 Xiànzài, jiā lǐ de xiǎohái shuìjiào yǐqián, yě dōu yào tīng zhèxiē gùshì.
text.english: My grandma is great at telling stories. When I was little I wouldn't go to sleep until she had told me one. She made them all up herself: a cat that could talk, an old man who lived on the moon. Last year Grandma turned eighty and often forgot things. Afraid I would never hear the stories again, I asked her to tell them once more and recorded them all on my phone. Then I wrote them down, matched each one with a picture I drew, and made a little book. On her birthday I gave it to her. She looked through it page by page and said with a smile, 'The stories I told are all in a book now! How wonderful!' Now the children in our family want to hear them before bed too.

choices.english: She doesn't have to walk home at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiàkè hòu huì qí chē huí jiā.
choices.english: She will ride home after class.

questions.why: 這幾天我都在天黑以前就到家了……那我就坐公車，公車站就在我家門口: she is home before dark, and on late days the bus stops at her door, so she never walks home at night. The man says the lamps are broken, and she takes the bus, not a bike.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個星期每天下雨，房間裡出現了好多螞蟻，我每天打掃都沒有用。
lines.simplified: 这个星期每天下雨，房间里出现了好多蚂蚁，我每天打扫都没有用。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqí měi tiān xià yǔ, fángjiān lǐ chūxiàn le hǎo duō mǎyǐ, wǒ měi tiān dǎsǎo dōu méiyǒu yòng.
lines.english: It has rained every day this week, and lots of ants have shown up in my room. Cleaning every day doesn't help.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下雨天螞蟻特別多。你是不是把吃的東西放在桌子上了？
lines.simplified: 下雨天蚂蚁特别多。你是不是把吃的东西放在桌子上了？
lines.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān mǎyǐ tèbié duō. Nǐ shì bú shì bǎ chī de dōngxi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le?
lines.english: There are lots of ants on rainy days. Did you leave food on your desk?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有，吃的我都放進冰箱了，窗戶也關好了。
lines.simplified: 没有，吃的我都放进冰箱了，窗户也关好了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, chī de wǒ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng le, chuānghù yě guān hǎo le.
lines.english: No, I've put all my food in the fridge, and I've shut the window too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那可能是垃圾的問題。你還是每天晚上把垃圾拿出去丟吧。
lines.simplified: 那可能是垃圾的问题。你还是每天晚上把垃圾拿出去丢吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà kěnéng shì lèsè de wèntí. Nǐ háishì měi tiān wǎnshàng bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū ba.
lines.english: Then it may be your rubbish. You'd better take the rubbish out every evening.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議男的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议男的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì nán de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman suggest the man do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo hǎo.
choices.english: Clean his room every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shuìjiào qián bǎ chuānghù guān hǎo.
choices.english: Shut the window before bed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ shíwù fàng jìn bīngxiāng lǐ.
choices.english: Put the food in the fridge.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bié bǎ lèsè liú zài fángjiān lǐ.
choices.english: Not keep rubbish in his room.

questions.why: 你還是每天晚上把垃圾拿出去丟吧: she thinks the rubbish brings the ants. He already cleans every day, keeps his food in the fridge and has shut the window, so those are not her advice.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你要去超商嗎？可以順便幫我買一把傘嗎？我的傘昨天被風吹壞了。
lines.simplified: 你要去超商吗？可以顺便帮我买一把伞吗？我的伞昨天被风吹坏了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yào qù chāoshāng ma? Kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yì bǎ sǎn ma? Wǒ de sǎn zuótiān bèi fēng chuī huài le.
lines.english: Are you going to the convenience store? Could you get me an umbrella while you're there? The wind broke mine yesterday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒問題。要不要也幫妳買點吃的？
lines.simplified: 没问题。要不要也帮你买点吃的？
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Yào bú yào yě bāng nǐ mǎi diǎn chī de?
lines.english: No problem. Shall I get you something to eat too?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不用了，我吃過了。算了，傘也先別買了，新聞說明天就不下雨了，下次要用再買吧。
lines.simplified: 不用了，我吃过了。算了，伞也先别买了，新闻说明天就不下雨了，下次要用再买吧。
lines.pinyin: Búyòng le, wǒ chī guo le. Suànle, sǎn yě xiān bié mǎi le, xīnwén shuō míngtiān jiù bú xià yǔ le, xià cì yào yòng zài mǎi ba.
lines.english: No thanks, I've eaten. Actually, forget it: don't buy the umbrella for now either. The news says the rain stops tomorrow. I'll buy one next time I need it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我很快就回來。
lines.simplified: 好，那我很快就回来。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ hěn kuài jiù huílái.
lines.english: OK, I'll be right back.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nán de mǎi yì bǎ sǎn.
choices.english: Ask the man to buy an umbrella.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nán de mǎi diǎn chī de.
choices.english: Ask the man to buy some food.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng yǐhòu zài mǎi sǎn.
choices.english: Buy an umbrella later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ qù chāoshāng mǎi sǎn.
choices.english: Go and buy an umbrella herself.

questions.why: 算了，傘也先別買了……下次要用再買吧: she drops the umbrella and will buy one when she next needs it. She turns down the food (不用了，我吃過了), and she does not go to the store herself either.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們的中文老師下個月要退休了，班上的同學想送她禮物。有人說送花，有人說送書，大家想來想去，還是決定不了。
lines.simplified: 我们的中文老师下个月要退休了，班上的同学想送她礼物。有人说送花，有人说送书，大家想来想去，还是决定不了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén lǎoshī xià ge yuè yào tuìxiū le, bān shàng de tóngxué xiǎng sòng tā lǐwù. Yǒu rén shuō sòng huā, yǒu rén shuō sòng shū, dàjiā xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bù liǎo.
lines.english: Our Chinese teacher retires next month, and the class wants to give her a present. Some say flowers, some say a book. We've thought and thought, but we still can't decide.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老師的書應該已經夠多了。你們不如一起寫一張大卡片，每個人都寫一些祝福的話。
lines.simplified: 老师的书应该已经够多了。你们不如一起写一张大卡片，每个人都写一些祝福的话。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī de shū yīnggāi yǐjīng gòu duō le. Nǐmen bùrú yìqǐ xiě yì zhāng dà kǎpiàn, měi ge rén dōu xiě yìxiē zhùfú de huà.
lines.english: Your teacher surely has enough books already. Why not write one big card together, each of you writing a few good wishes?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好主意！我明天就去買卡片。
lines.simplified: 好主意！我明天就去买卡片。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒ míngtiān jiù qù mǎi kǎpiàn.
lines.english: Good idea! I'll go and buy a card tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議他們送什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议他们送什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì tāmen sòng shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman suggest they give?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bān shàng tóngxué mǎi de huā.
choices.english: Flowers the whole class buys.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bān shàng tóngxué xiě de kǎpiàn.
choices.english: A card the whole class writes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bān shàng tóngxué xuǎn de shū.
choices.english: A book the whole class chooses.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bān shàng tóngxué pāi de zhàopiàn.
choices.english: A photo the whole class takes.

questions.why: 你們不如一起寫一張大卡片，每個人都寫一些祝福的話: she suggests a card the class writes together. Flowers and a book were the classmates' ideas, and she says the teacher already has enough books.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 昨天晚上的風雨真大，我整個晚上都沒睡好。你家還好吧？
lines.simplified: 昨天晚上的风雨真大，我整个晚上都没睡好。你家还好吧？
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ zhēn dà, wǒ zhěng ge wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo. Nǐ jiā hái hǎo ba?
lines.english: The storm last night was really bad. I didn't sleep well all night. Is your home all right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 屋子裡沒什麼問題，可是我停在樓下的車被水淹了一半，不知道還能不能開。
lines.simplified: 屋子里没什么问题，可是我停在楼下的车被水淹了一半，不知道还能不能开。
lines.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ méi shénme wèntí, kěshì wǒ tíng zài lóuxià de chē bèi shuǐ yān le yíbàn, bù zhīdào hái néng bù néng kāi.
lines.english: Inside the house it's fine, but my car parked downstairs was half under water. I don't know if it still runs.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真糟糕！我家門口那棵大樹也倒了，就倒在路上，車都過不去。
lines.simplified: 真糟糕！我家门口那棵大树也倒了，就倒在路上，车都过不去。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn zāogāo! Wǒ jiā ménkǒu nà kē dà shù yě dǎo le, jiù dǎo zài lù shàng, chē dōu guò bú qù.
lines.english: That's terrible! The big tree at my door fell down too, right across the road. Cars can't get past.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那得趕快找人來處理啊。
lines.simplified: 那得赶快找人来处理啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà děi gǎnkuài zhǎo rén lái chǔlǐ a.
lines.english: Then you need to get someone to deal with it quickly.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我早上就打過電話了，可是他們說今天要去的地方太多，最快明天中午以後才能來。
lines.simplified: 我早上就打过电话了，可是他们说今天要去的地方太多，最快明天中午以后才能来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshàng jiù dǎ guo diànhuà le, kěshì tāmen shuō jīntiān yào qù de dìfāng tài duō, zuì kuài míngtiān zhōngwǔ yǐhòu cái néng lái.
lines.english: I called this morning, but they said they have too many places to go today. The earliest they can come is tomorrow after noon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那這兩天妳要出門，就只好走路了。
lines.simplified: 那这两天你要出门，就只好走路了。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè liǎng tiān nǐ yào chūmén, jiù zhǐhǎo zǒulù le.
lines.english: Then for these two days you'll have to walk when you go out.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的遇到了什麼問題？
prompt.simplified: 男的遇到了什么问题？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de yùdào le shénme wèntí?
prompt.english: What problem does the man have?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiālǐ tíngdiàn le.
choices.english: His home lost power.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de chēzi jìn shuǐ le.
choices.english: Water got into his car.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiā ménkǒu de shù dǎo le.
choices.english: The tree at his door fell down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zuótiān wǎnshàng méi shuì hǎo.
choices.english: He didn't sleep well last night.

questions.why: 我停在樓下的車被水淹了一半: the flood came halfway up his parked car. He says nothing is wrong inside his home (屋子裡沒什麼問題); the fallen tree and the bad night are the woman's.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的找的人最快什麼時候能來？
prompt.simplified: 女的找的人最快什么时候能来？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zhǎo de rén zuì kuài shénme shíhòu néng lái?
prompt.english: When is the earliest the people the woman called can come?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshàng.
choices.english: This morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshàng.
choices.english: Tomorrow morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ.
choices.english: Tomorrow afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hòutiān xiàwǔ.
choices.english: The afternoon after tomorrow.

questions.why: 最快明天中午以後才能來: the earliest is after noon tomorrow, that is, tomorrow afternoon. This morning is when she phoned them, and today they have too many places to go.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳看新聞了嗎？這次的颱風在南部造成了好幾場水災，高雄以南的災情最嚴重。
lines.simplified: 你看新闻了吗？这次的台风在南部造成了好几场水灾，高雄以南的灾情最严重。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn xīnwén le ma? Zhè cì de táifēng zài nánbù zàochéng le hǎojǐ chǎng shuǐzāi, Gāoxióng yǐ nán de zāiqíng zuì yánzhòng.
lines.english: Did you see the news? This typhoon caused several floods in the south. The damage is worst south of Kaohsiung.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 看了。有一些地方的路到現在都還不通，甚至有人被困在屋頂上，等了一天才被救出來。
lines.simplified: 看了。有一些地方的路到现在都还不通，甚至有人被困在屋顶上，等了一天才被救出来。
lines.pinyin: Kàn le. Yǒu yìxiē dìfāng de lù dào xiànzài dōu hái bù tōng, shènzhì yǒu rén bèi kùn zài wūdǐng shàng, děng le yì tiān cái bèi jiù chūlái.
lines.english: I did. In some places the roads are still closed, and some people were even stuck on their roofs and rescued only after a whole day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們社團這個星期六要去災區幫忙整理房子，妳要不要一起去？
lines.simplified: 我们社团这个星期六要去灾区帮忙整理房子，你要不要一起去？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shètuán zhège xīngqíliù yào qù zāiqū bāngmáng zhěnglǐ fángzi, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
lines.english: Our club is going to the disaster area this Saturday to help clean up houses. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我很想去，可是星期六我得上班。我出錢買一些水和食物，請你們帶過去，好不好？
lines.simplified: 我很想去，可是星期六我得上班。我出钱买一些水和食物，请你们带过去，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù, kěshì xīngqíliù wǒ děi shàngbān. Wǒ chū qián mǎi yìxiē shuǐ hé shíwù, qǐng nǐmen dài guòqù, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: I'd love to, but I have to work on Saturday. How about I pay for some water and food and you take it there?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然好，災民現在最需要乾淨的水。那我星期五晚上去妳家拿。
lines.simplified: 当然好，灾民现在最需要干净的水。那我星期五晚上去你家拿。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán hǎo, zāimín xiànzài zuì xūyào gānjìng de shuǐ. Nà wǒ xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng qù nǐ jiā ná.
lines.english: Of course. Clean water is what the victims need most now. I'll come to your place on Friday evening to pick it up.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，我星期五下班就先去超市買好。
lines.simplified: 好，我星期五下班就先去超市买好。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xīngqíwǔ xiàbān jiù xiān qù chāoshì mǎi hǎo.
lines.english: OK. I'll go to the supermarket after work on Friday and buy it first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的星期六要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的星期六要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de xīngqíliù yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the woman do on Saturday?

choices.english: Go to work.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Go to the disaster area with the club.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài jiā zhěnglǐ fángzi.
choices.english: Tidy up her home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn jiārén qù Gāoxióng.
choices.english: Go to Kaohsiung with her family.

questions.why: 我很想去，可是星期六我得上班: on Saturday she has to work. The club goes to the disaster area without her, and Kaohsiung is only in the news.

prompt.traditional: 男的星期五晚上要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的星期五晚上要做什么？

prompt.english: What will the man do on Friday evening?

choices.pinyin: Qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐ hé shíwù.
choices.english: Buy water and food at the supermarket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù yínháng lǐng yìxiē qián.
choices.english: Take out some money at the bank.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kàn táifēng de zuì xīn xiāoxí.
choices.english: Follow the latest typhoon news.

choices.english: Pick up things at the woman's place.

questions.why: 那我星期五晚上去妳家拿: on Friday evening he picks up the water and food at her home. She does the shopping herself (我星期五下班就先去超市買好).

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a radio broadcast, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安，現在告訴大家最新的颱風消息。這個颱風的速度越來越快，今天半夜就會到達花蓮，明天早上會經過臺中以北的地區，下午就會離開臺灣。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安，现在告诉大家最新的台风消息。这个台风的速度越来越快，今天半夜就会到达花莲，明天早上会经过台中以北的地区，下午就会离开台湾。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān, xiànzài gàosu dàjiā zuì xīn de táifēng xiāoxí. Zhège táifēng de sùdù yuè lái yuè kuài, jīntiān bànyè jiù huì dàodá Huālián, míngtiān zǎoshàng huì jīngguò Táizhōng yǐ běi de dìqū, xiàwǔ jiù huì líkāi Táiwān.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Here is the latest typhoon news. The typhoon is moving faster and faster. It will reach Hualien at midnight tonight, pass over the area north of Taichung tomorrow morning, and leave Taiwan in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 臺中以北明天會一直下大雨，河邊的路可能會淹水，請大家明天不要到河邊去。住在海邊的民眾，今天晚上最好也不要出門。
lines.simplified: 台中以北明天会一直下大雨，河边的路可能会淹水，请大家明天不要到河边去。住在海边的民众，今天晚上最好也不要出门。
lines.pinyin: Táizhōng yǐ běi míngtiān huì yìzhí xià dàyǔ, hébiān de lù kěnéng huì yānshuǐ, qǐng dàjiā míngtiān búyào dào hébiān qù. Zhù zài hǎibiān de mínzhòng, jīntiān wǎnshàng zuìhǎo yě búyào chūmén.
lines.english: North of Taichung it will rain hard all day tomorrow, and roads by the rivers may flood, so please stay away from the rivers tomorrow. People living by the sea had better not go out tonight either.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，颱風可能會造成停電，請大家先準備好收音機和電池，家裡也要有兩三天的水和食物。萬一淹水了，得離開家，請打開收音機聽我們的廣播，我們會告訴大家，哪個學校可以讓大家去住。
lines.simplified: 还有，台风可能会造成停电，请大家先准备好收音机和电池，家里也要有两三天的水和食物。万一淹水了，得离开家，请打开收音机听我们的广播，我们会告诉大家，哪个学校可以让大家去住。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, táifēng kěnéng huì zàochéng tíngdiàn, qǐng dàjiā xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo shōuyīnjī hé diànchí, jiālǐ yě yào yǒu liǎng sān tiān de shuǐ hé shíwù. Wànyī yānshuǐ le, děi líkāi jiā, qǐng dǎkāi shōuyīnjī tīng wǒmen de guǎngbò, wǒmen huì gàosu dàjiā, nǎge xuéxiào kěyǐ ràng dàjiā qù zhù.
lines.english: Also, the typhoon may cause power cuts. Please get a radio and batteries ready, and keep two or three days of water and food at home. If your home floods and you have to leave, turn on your radio and listen to us: we will tell you which school you can go and stay at.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你好，我是房東。昨天的颱風把屋頂上的一些設備吹壞了，工人明天要來修理，所以這棟樓明天早上九點到下午五點都會停水。我會在樓下放一些水給大家用，你不用自己準備。
lines.simplified: 你好，我是房东。昨天的台风把屋顶上的一些设备吹坏了，工人明天要来修理，所以这栋楼明天早上九点到下午五点都会停水。我会在楼下放一些水给大家用，你不用自己准备。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì fángdōng. Zuótiān de táifēng bǎ wūdǐng shàng de yìxiē shèbèi chuī huài le, gōngrén míngtiān yào lái xiūlǐ, suǒyǐ zhè dòng lóu míngtiān zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn dào xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn dōu huì tíngshuǐ. Wǒ huì zài lóuxià fàng yìxiē shuǐ gěi dàjiā yòng, nǐ búyòng zìjǐ zhǔnbèi.
lines.english: Hello, this is your landlord. Yesterday's typhoon damaged some equipment on the roof, and workers are coming to fix it tomorrow, so the building will have no water from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. tomorrow. I'll leave some water downstairs for everyone, so you don't need to get your own.

lines.simplified: 工人的车明天要停在楼下，所以请你今天晚上先把车停到别的地方去。还有，你上次说房间的窗户关不好，我请工人星期四下午去看看。万一那天你不在家，就把钥匙放在楼下的便利商店，我会去拿。
lines.pinyin: Gōngrén de chē míngtiān yào tíng zài lóuxià, suǒyǐ qǐng nǐ jīntiān wǎnshàng xiān bǎ chē tíng dào biéde dìfāng qù. Háiyǒu, nǐ shàng cì shuō fángjiān de chuānghù guān bù hǎo, wǒ qǐng gōngrén xīngqísì xiàwǔ qù kànkan. Wànyī nà tiān nǐ bú zài jiā, jiù bǎ yàoshi fàng zài lóuxià de biànlì shāngdiàn, wǒ huì qù ná.
lines.english: The workers' van will park downstairs tomorrow, so please move your car somewhere else tonight. Also, you said last time that your window doesn't close properly, so I've asked the workers to look at it on Thursday afternoon. In case you're not home that day, leave the key at the convenience store downstairs and I'll pick it up.

passage.traditional: 去年夏天我去臺東旅行，碰到了強烈颱風。颱風來了以後，我{1}三天都不能出門，只好在旅館裡看電視、看書。我本來想第二天就坐火車往北回臺北，{2}臺東{3}的路都不通了，火車也停了。新聞說，有一些地方不但淹水，{4}連電話都打不通。旅館老闆每天晚上都把蠟燭準備好，放在每個房間裡。他說：「這樣{5}停電了，大家才不會什麼都看不到。」第五天，路{6}通了，我才坐上火車回到臺北。
passage.simplified: 去年夏天我去台东旅行，碰到了强烈台风。台风来了以后，我{1}三天都不能出门，只好在旅馆里看电视、看书。我本来想第二天就坐火车往北回台北，{2}台东{3}的路都不通了，火车也停了。新闻说，有一些地方不但淹水，{4}连电话都打不通。旅馆老板每天晚上都把蜡烛准备好，放在每个房间里。他说：「这样{5}停电了，大家才不会什么都看不到。」第五天，路{6}通了，我才坐上火车回到台北。
passage.pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān wǒ qù Táidōng lǚxíng, pèngdào le qiángliè táifēng. Táifēng lái le yǐhòu, wǒ yìlián sān tiān dōu bù néng chūmén, zhǐhǎo zài lǚguǎn lǐ kàn diànshì, kàn shū. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng dì èr tiān jiù zuò huǒchē wǎng běi huí Táiběi, jiéguǒ Táidōng yǐ běi de lù dōu bù tōng le, huǒchē yě tíng le. Xīnwén shuō, yǒu yìxiē dìfāng búdàn yānshuǐ, shènzhì lián diànhuà dōu dǎ bù tōng. Lǚguǎn lǎobǎn měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu bǎ làzhú zhǔnbèi hǎo, fàng zài měi ge fángjiān lǐ. Tā shuō: “Zhèyàng wànyī tíngdiàn le, dàjiā cái bú huì shénme dōu kàn bú dào.” Dì wǔ tiān, lù zhōngyú tōng le, wǒ cái zuò shàng huǒchē huí dào Táiběi.
passage.english: Last summer I travelled to Taitung and ran into a strong typhoon. Once it came, I couldn't go out for three days in a row, so I stayed in the hotel watching TV and reading. I had planned to take the train north back to Taipei the next day, but in the end the roads north of Taitung were all closed, and the trains stopped too. The news said some places were not only flooded; even the phones didn't work. Every evening the hotel owner got candles ready and put them in every room. He said, "This way, if the power happens to go out, nobody will be left in the dark." On the fifth day the road finally opened, and only then could I take the train back to Taipei.

passage.traditional: 上個星期花蓮市南邊發生了一場規模六點五的地震。那時候我在十樓上課，教室突然動了起來，{1}桌子上的書掉了滿地，還有幾個同學嚇哭了。老師要大家趕快到桌子底下去，她說：「{2}有東西掉下來打到頭，就麻煩了。」新聞說，花蓮市裡的房子都沒事，可是花蓮市{3}的地方離地震最近，災情很嚴重，一些老房子塌了，{4}連學校的牆也倒了。那天晚上，{5}發生了五次小地震，大家都不敢睡，{6}第二天很多同學上課都在睡覺。
passage.simplified: 上个星期花莲市南边发生了一场规模六点五的地震。那时候我在十楼上课，教室突然动了起来，{1}桌子上的书掉了满地，还有几个同学吓哭了。老师要大家赶快到桌子底下去，她说：「{2}有东西掉下来打到头，就麻烦了。」新闻说，花莲市里的房子都没事，可是花莲市{3}的地方离地震最近，灾情很严重，一些老房子塌了，{4}连学校的墙也倒了。那天晚上，{5}发生了五次小地震，大家都不敢睡，{6}第二天很多同学上课都在睡觉。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqí Huālián shì nánbiān fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó liù diǎn wǔ de dìzhèn. Nà shíhòu wǒ zài shí lóu shàngkè, jiàoshì túrán dòng le qǐlái, bù jǐn zhuōzi shàng de shū diào le mǎn dì, hái yǒu jǐ ge tóngxué xià kū le. Lǎoshī yào dàjiā gǎnkuài dào zhuōzi dǐxià qù, tā shuō: “Wànyī yǒu dōngxi diàoxiàlái dǎ dào tóu, jiù máfán le.” Xīnwén shuō, Huālián shì lǐ de fángzi dōu méi shì, kěshì Huālián shì yǐ nán de dìfāng lí dìzhèn zuì jìn, zāiqíng hěn yánzhòng, yìxiē lǎo fángzi tā le, shènzhì lián xuéxiào de qiáng yě dǎo le. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, yìlián fāshēng le wǔ cì xiǎo dìzhèn, dàjiā dōu bù gǎn shuì, jiéguǒ dì èr tiān hěn duō tóngxué shàngkè dōu zài shuìjiào.
passage.english: Last week a magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck south of Hualien City. I was in class on the tenth floor when the classroom suddenly began to shake: not only did the books on the desks fall all over the floor, but a few classmates were so scared they cried. The teacher told us all to get under our desks quickly. She said, "If something falls and hits your head, that would be bad." The news said that the buildings inside Hualien City were all fine, but the places south of the city, nearest the quake, were badly hit: some old houses collapsed, and even a school wall fell down. That night five small quakes came one after another, and nobody dared to sleep. As a result, the next day many classmates fell asleep in class.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，大家對地震已經很習慣了，很多人覺得小地震沒什麼，不必特別準備。我以前也這麼想。可是去年一場大地震以後，我家附近的路壞了，車開不進來，超市一連好幾天都買不到水和電池。家裡的水很快就喝完了，我們一家人只好向鄰居借。從那時候起，我家門口就放了一個箱子，裡面有水、餅乾、電池、收音機和一些藥。我每半年檢查一次，把舊的東西換掉。朋友笑我太緊張了，可是我覺得，這些東西花不了多少錢，萬一真的又發生大地震，就能幫上很大的忙。
text.simplified: 在台湾，大家对地震已经很习惯了，很多人觉得小地震没什么，不必特别准备。我以前也这么想。可是去年一场大地震以后，我家附近的路坏了，车开不进来，超市一连好几天都买不到水和电池。家里的水很快就喝完了，我们一家人只好向邻居借。从那时候起，我家门口就放了一个箱子，里面有水、饼干、电池、收音机和一些药。我每半年检查一次，把旧的东西换掉。朋友笑我太紧张了，可是我觉得，这些东西花不了多少钱，万一真的又发生大地震，就能帮上很大的忙。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, dàjiā duì dìzhèn yǐjīng hěn xíguàn le, hěn duō rén juéde xiǎo dìzhèn méi shénme, búbì tèbié zhǔnbèi. Wǒ yǐqián yě zhème xiǎng. Kěshì qùnián yì chǎng dà dìzhèn yǐhòu, wǒ jiā fùjìn de lù huài le, chē kāi bú jìnlái, chāoshì yìlián hǎo jǐ tiān dōu mǎi bú dào shuǐ hé diànchí. Jiālǐ de shuǐ hěn kuài jiù hē wán le, wǒmen yì jiā rén zhǐhǎo xiàng línjū jiè. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ jiā ménkǒu jiù fàng le yí ge xiāngzi, lǐmiàn yǒu shuǐ, bǐnggān, diànchí, shōuyīnjī hé yìxiē yào. Wǒ měi bàn nián jiǎnchá yí cì, bǎ jiù de dōngxi huàn diào. Péngyǒu xiào wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, kěshì wǒ juéde, zhèxiē dōngxi huā bù liǎo duōshǎo qián, wànyī zhēn de yòu fāshēng dà dìzhèn, jiù néng bāng shàng hěn dà de máng.
text.english: In Taiwan people are used to earthquakes, and many think small quakes are nothing and need no special preparation. I used to think so too. But after a big quake last year, the roads near my home were damaged and cars could not get in, so for several days in a row the supermarket had no water or batteries to buy. The water at home was soon gone, and my family had to borrow some from the neighbors. Since then I have kept a box by my front door with water, biscuits, batteries, a radio and some medicine. I check it every six months and replace old things. My friends laugh that I am too nervous, but I think these things cost very little, and if a big quake really happens again, they will be a great help.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，颱風來的時候，如果風雨太大，學校和公司就會放假。很多學生一聽到颱風天要放假就很高興，有的約朋友去看電影，有的在家玩一整天的遊戲。以前我也是這樣。可是有一年，外婆住的山區發生了水災，她的屋子被破壞得很嚴重，我們一家人花了一個星期才把房子整理好。從那次以後，我就不再覺得颱風天放假是一件快樂的事了。我認為，颱風天放假是為了大家的生命安全，不是讓大家出去玩的。颱風天出門很危險，萬一發生意外，還得麻煩救災人員。
text.simplified: 在台湾，台风来的时候，如果风雨太大，学校和公司就会放假。很多学生一听到台风天要放假就很高兴，有的约朋友去看电影，有的在家玩一整天的游戏。以前我也是这样。可是有一年，外婆住的山区发生了水灾，她的屋子被破坏得很严重，我们一家人花了一个星期才把房子整理好。从那次以后，我就不再觉得台风天放假是一件快乐的事了。我认为，台风天放假是为了大家的生命安全，不是让大家出去玩的。台风天出门很危险，万一发生意外，还得麻烦救灾人员。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, táifēng lái de shíhòu, rúguǒ fēngyǔ tài dà, xuéxiào hé gōngsī jiù huì fàngjià. Hěn duō xuéshēng yì tīngdào táifēng tiān yào fàngjià jiù hěn gāoxìng, yǒu de yuē péngyǒu qù kàn diànyǐng, yǒu de zài jiā wán yì zhěng tiān de yóuxì. Yǐqián wǒ yě shì zhèyàng. Kěshì yǒu yì nián, wàipó zhù de shānqū fāshēng le shuǐzāi, tā de wūzi bèi pòhuài de hěn yánzhòng, wǒmen yì jiā rén huā le yí ge xīngqí cái bǎ fángzi zhěnglǐ hǎo. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, wǒ jiù bú zài juéde táifēng tiān fàngjià shì yí jiàn kuàilè de shì le. Wǒ rènwéi, táifēng tiān fàngjià shì wèile dàjiā de shēngmìng ānquán, bú shì ràng dàjiā chūqù wán de. Táifēng tiān chūmén hěn wéixiǎn, wànyī fāshēng yìwài, hái děi máfán jiùzāi rényuán.
text.english: In Taiwan, when a typhoon brings very strong wind and rain, schools and companies close for the day. Many students are happy as soon as they hear there is a typhoon day off: some go to the movies with friends, some play games at home all day. I used to be like that. But one year there was a flood in the mountains where my grandmother lives. Her house was badly damaged, and it took my family a week to clean it up. Since then I no longer think a typhoon day off is a happy thing. I believe the day off is for everyone's safety, not for going out to play. Going out in a typhoon is dangerous, and if an accident happens, rescue workers have to come for you.

text.traditional: 我從小就喜歡演戲，夢想是當一名演員。十六歲那年，學校有一場表演，我第一次演一個重要的角色，可是因為太緊張而忘了下一句要說什麼，只演了一半就停了下來。那天回家以後，我哭了很久，覺得自己不可能成功。我媽媽對我說：「就算這次演得不好，也不代表你沒有實力。只要不斷練習，一定會有人肯定你。」後來，我每天下課都練習兩個小時，還請朋友把我演的戲錄下來，放在網路上。現在，我演的戲已經有好幾萬人看過了，也有觀眾寫信告訴我，他們很喜歡我的表演。我可以說是離夢想越來越近了。
text.simplified: 我从小就喜欢演戏，梦想是当一名演员。十六岁那年，学校有一场表演，我第一次演一个重要的角色，可是因为太紧张而忘了下一句要说什么，只演了一半就停了下来。那天回家以后，我哭了很久，觉得自己不可能成功。我妈妈对我说：「就算这次演得不好，也不代表你没有实力。只要不断练习，一定会有人肯定你。」后来，我每天下课都练习两个小时，还请朋友把我演的戏录下来，放在网路上。现在，我演的戏已经有好几万人看过了，也有观众写信告诉我，他们很喜欢我的表演。我可以说是离梦想越来越近了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuān yǎnxì, mèngxiǎng shì dāng yì míng yǎnyuán. Shíliù suì nà nián, xuéxiào yǒu yì chǎng biǎoyǎn, wǒ dì yī cì yǎn yí ge zhòngyào de jiǎosè, kěshì yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng ér wàng le xià yí jù yào shuō shénme, zhǐ yǎn le yíbàn jiù tíng le xiàlái. Nà tiān huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ kū le hěn jiǔ, juéde zìjǐ bù kěnéng chénggōng. Wǒ māma duì wǒ shuō: “Jiùsuàn zhè cì yǎn de bù hǎo, yě bú dàibiǎo nǐ méiyǒu shílì. Zhǐyào búduàn liànxí, yídìng huì yǒu rén kěndìng nǐ.” Hòulái, wǒ měi tiān xiàkè dōu liànxí liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hái qǐng péngyǒu bǎ wǒ yǎn de xì lù xiàlái, fàng zài wǎnglù shàng. Xiànzài, wǒ yǎn de xì yǐjīng yǒu hǎojǐ wàn rén kàn guo le, yě yǒu guānzhòng xiě xìn gàosu wǒ, tāmen hěn xǐhuān wǒ de biǎoyǎn. Wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì lí mèngxiǎng yuè lái yuè jìn le.
text.english: I have loved acting since I was little, and my dream is to be an actor. At sixteen, in a school show, I played an important role for the first time, but I was so nervous that I forgot my next line and stopped halfway through. When I got home that day I cried for a long time and felt I could never succeed. My mother said to me, "Even if you didn't act well this time, it doesn't mean you have no talent. If you keep practising, someone will surely see how good you are." After that I practised for two hours every day after class, and I asked friends to film my acting and put it online. Now tens of thousands of people have watched it, and some viewers have written to tell me they love my acting. You could say I am getting closer and closer to my dream.

text.traditional: 以前我買東西，看上了就買，從來不比價。上個月我想買一雙球鞋，在百貨公司的專櫃看到一雙很喜歡的，要三千八百塊。店員說今天有打折，我差點就買了，可是朋友叫我先上網看看。我上網一看，發現網路上的價錢一家比一家便宜，最便宜的只要兩千五百塊。可是買過的人都說，在那家買很容易吃虧，寄來的鞋子常常是壞掉的。所以我在一家賣兩千八百塊的網路商店買了，那家的顧客都說品質很好，兩天就送到家了。從那次以後，我買東西以前不僅會先比價，還會看看買過的人怎麼說。真是貨比三家不吃虧啊！
text.simplified: 以前我买东西，看上了就买，从来不比价。上个月我想买一双球鞋，在百货公司的专柜看到一双很喜欢的，要三千八百块。店员说今天有打折，我差点就买了，可是朋友叫我先上网看看。我上网一看，发现网路上的价钱一家比一家便宜，最便宜的只要两千五百块。可是买过的人都说，在那家买很容易吃亏，寄来的鞋子常常是坏掉的。所以我在一家卖两千八百块的网路商店买了，那家的顾客都说品质很好，两天就送到家了。从那次以后，我买东西以前不仅会先比价，还会看看买过的人怎么说。真是货比三家不吃亏啊！
text.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ mǎi dōngxi, kànshàng le jiù mǎi, cónglái bù bǐjià. Shàng ge yuè wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng qiúxié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì kàndào yì shuāng hěn xǐhuān de, yào sānqiān bābǎi kuài. Diànyuán shuō jīntiān yǒu dǎzhé, wǒ chàdiǎn jiù mǎi le, kěshì péngyǒu jiào wǒ xiān shàngwǎng kànkan. Wǒ shàngwǎng yí kàn, fāxiàn wǎnglù shàng de jiàqián yì jiā bǐ yì jiā piányí, zuì piányí de zhǐ yào liǎngqiān wǔbǎi kuài. Kěshì mǎi guo de rén dōu shuō, zài nà jiā mǎi hěn róngyì chīkuī, jì lái de xiézi chángcháng shì huài diào de. Suǒyǐ wǒ zài yì jiā mài liǎngqiān bābǎi kuài de wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎi le, nà jiā de gùkè dōu shuō pǐnzhí hěn hǎo, liǎng tiān jiù sòng dào jiā le. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, wǒ mǎi dōngxi yǐqián bù jǐn huì xiān bǐjià, hái huì kànkan mǎi guo de rén zěnme shuō. Zhēn shì huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī a!
text.english: I used to buy things as soon as I liked them and never compared prices. Last month I wanted a pair of sneakers and saw a pair I liked at a department store counter for NT$3,800. The clerk said they were on sale today, and I nearly bought them, but a friend told me to look online first. When I looked, each online shop was cheaper than the last; the cheapest was only NT$2,500. But people who had bought there all said you easily got a bad deal: the shoes it sent were often damaged. So I bought them from an online shop selling them for NT$2,800. Its customers all said the quality was good, and they reached my home in two days. Since then, before I buy anything, I not only compare prices but also read what other buyers say. It really pays to shop around!

lines.simplified: 可是她要坐十几个小时的飞机，到了应该会很累。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tā yào zuò shíjǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī, dào le yīnggāi huì hěn lèi.
lines.english: But she'll be on a plane for over ten hours. She'll probably be very tired when she arrives.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，就讓她好好休息吧，我們兩個下個星期六再吃。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，就让她好好休息吧，我们两个下个星期六再吃。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, jiù ràng tā hǎohǎo xiūxí ba, wǒmen liǎng ge xià ge xīngqíliù zài chī.
lines.english: In that case, let her rest properly. The two of us will have dinner next Saturday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這個星期六三個人一起吃
choices.simplified: 这个星期六三个人一起吃
choices.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù sān ge rén yìqǐ chī.
choices.english: The three of them eat together this Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期六陪阿姨去外面吃
choices.simplified: 星期六陪阿姨去外面吃
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù péi āyí qù wàimiàn chī.
choices.english: Take the aunt out to eat on Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下個星期六跟阿姨一起吃
choices.simplified: 下个星期六跟阿姨一起吃
choices.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù gēn āyí yìqǐ chī.
choices.english: Eat with the aunt next Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎn yí ge xīngqí zài qù chīfàn.
choices.english: Have the dinner a week later.

questions.why: His first idea was to eat with the aunt too, but once he hears she will be tired, 既然這樣……我們兩個下個星期六再吃 moves the dinner back a week, just the two of them. Eating with the aunt was the idea he dropped.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天怎麼沒來看樂團的表演？我們在門口等了你半個小時。
lines.simplified: 你昨天怎么没来看乐团的表演？我们在门口等了你半个小时。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān zěnme méi lái kàn yuètuán de biǎoyǎn? Wǒmen zài ménkǒu děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Why didn't you come to the band's show yesterday? We waited for you at the entrance for half an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真不好意思。我正要出門去買票的時候，發現廚房淹水了，只好留在家裡把水弄乾淨。
lines.simplified: 真不好意思。我正要出门去买票的时候，发现厨房淹水了，只好留在家里把水弄干净。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi. Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén qù mǎi piào de shíhòu, fāxiàn chúfáng yānshuǐ le, zhǐhǎo liú zài jiālǐ bǎ shuǐ nòng gānjìng.
lines.english: Really sorry. Just as I was about to go out and buy a ticket, I found the kitchen flooded, so I had to stay home and clear up the water.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 票我們早就幫你買好了。那現在沒問題了吧？
lines.simplified: 票我们早就帮你买好了。那现在没问题了吧？
lines.pinyin: Piào wǒmen zǎo jiù bāng nǐ mǎi hǎo le. Nà xiànzài méi wèntí le ba?
lines.english: We'd already bought you a ticket. Is everything all right now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 已經沒事了，就是弄到半夜。下次我一定去。
lines.simplified: 已经没事了，就是弄到半夜。下次我一定去。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng méi shì le, jiùshì nòng dào bànyè. Xià cì wǒ yídìng qù.
lines.english: It's fine now, it just took me till midnight. Next time I'll definitely go.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼沒去看表演？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么没去看表演？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme méi qù kàn biǎoyǎn?
prompt.english: Why didn't the man go to the show?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chūmén qián chúfáng chū le shì.
choices.english: Something went wrong in the kitchen before he left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu mǎi dào biǎoyǎn de piào.
choices.english: He couldn't get a ticket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chūmén yǐhòu yòu bèi jiào huí jiā.
choices.english: He was called home after leaving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Máng dào bànyè tài lèi le.
choices.english: He was worn out from being busy till midnight.

questions.why: 我正要出門……的時候，發現廚房淹水了: 正要 means he had not left yet when the flood stopped him. His friends had his ticket already, and dealing with the water till midnight came after the show had started.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天怎麼搭捷運來公司？腳踏車壞了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么搭捷运来公司？脚踏车坏了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme dā jiéyùn lái gōngsī? Jiǎotàchē huài le ma?
lines.english: How come you took the MRT to the office today? Is your bike broken?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是。我早上正準備騎車出門，就下起大雨來，只好改搭捷運。沒想到比平常早到了二十分鐘。
lines.simplified: 不是。我早上正准备骑车出门，就下起大雨来，只好改搭捷运。没想到比平常早到了二十分钟。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Wǒ zǎoshàng zhèng zhǔnbèi qí chē chūmén, jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái, zhǐhǎo gǎi dā jiéyùn. Méixiǎngdào bǐ píngcháng zǎo dào le èrshí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: No. This morning, just as I was getting ready to cycle out, it started pouring, so I took the MRT instead. I never expected to arrive twenty minutes earlier than usual.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 捷運真的比較快。那妳以後都搭捷運吧？
lines.simplified: 捷运真的比较快。那你以后都搭捷运吧？
lines.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhēn de bǐjiào kuài. Nà nǐ yǐhòu dōu dā jiéyùn ba?
lines.english: The MRT really is faster. So you'll take it from now on, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不一定，下雨天才搭。騎車比較自由，還可以運動。
lines.simplified: 不一定，下雨天才搭。骑车比较自由，还可以运动。
lines.pinyin: Bù yídìng, xià yǔ tiān cái dā. Qí chē bǐjiào zìyóu, hái kěyǐ yùndòng.
lines.english: Not necessarily, only on rainy days. Cycling is freer, and I get some exercise too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的今天為什麼搭捷運？
prompt.simplified: 女的今天为什么搭捷运？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jīntiān wèishénme dā jiéyùn?
prompt.english: Why did the woman take the MRT today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiǎotàchē túrán huài le.
choices.english: Her bike suddenly broke.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zǎo yìdiǎn dào gōngsī.
choices.english: She wanted to get to work earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái méi chūmén jiù xià yǔ le.
choices.english: It rained before she had left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qí dào yíbàn xià qǐ yǔ lái.
choices.english: It started raining halfway there.

questions.why: 我早上正準備騎車出門，就下起大雨來: 正準備 means she was only getting ready, so the rain came before she left, not halfway. Her bike is fine (不是), and arriving early was a surprise (沒想到).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六晚上河邊有煙火，我們一起去看吧？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六晚上河边有烟火，我们一起去看吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng hébiān yǒu yānhuǒ, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn ba?
lines.english: There are fireworks by the river this Saturday evening. Shall we go and watch together?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊。煙火八點才開始，我們七點半到就可以了吧？
lines.simplified: 好啊。烟火八点才开始，我们七点半到就可以了吧？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Yānhuǒ bā diǎn cái kāishǐ, wǒmen qī diǎn bàn dào jiù kěyǐ le ba?
lines.english: Sure. The fireworks don't start until eight, so getting there at seven thirty should be fine, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說去年人多得不得了。萬一沒有位子，就什麼都看不到了。我們還是六點就去吧，晚餐到那裡再買。
lines.simplified: 听说去年人多得不得了。万一没有位子，就什么都看不到了。我们还是六点就去吧，晚餐到那里再买。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō qùnián rén duō de bùdéliǎo. Wànyī méiyǒu wèizi, jiù shénme dōu kàn bú dào le. Wǒmen háishì liù diǎn jiù qù ba, wǎncān dào nàlǐ zài mǎi.
lines.english: I hear the crowd last year was huge. If there's no space left, we won't see a thing. We'd better go at six, and buy dinner when we get there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我五點半去妳家找妳。
lines.simplified: 好，那我五点半去你家找你。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn qù nǐ jiā zhǎo nǐ.
lines.english: OK, then I'll come to your place at five thirty.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想六點就去？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想六点就去？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng liù diǎn jiù qù?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to go at six?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zài hébiān chī wǎncān.
choices.english: She wants to eat dinner by the river.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà wǎn dào méi dìfāng kàn.
choices.english: She fears there'll be nowhere to watch if they're late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yānhuǒ liù diǎn jiù kāishǐ.
choices.english: The fireworks start at six.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà lùshàng chē tài duō.
choices.english: She fears heavy traffic.

questions.why: 萬一沒有位子，就什麼都看不到了。我們還是六點就去吧: the crowd she fears is at the river, not on the road. Buying food there is what they will do once there, not why, and the fireworks start at eight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳最近週末都在做什麼？找妳出去，妳都說沒空。我還以為妳在打工。
lines.simplified: 你最近周末都在做什么？找你出去，你都说没空。我还以为你在打工。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zhōumò dōu zài zuò shénme? Zhǎo nǐ chūqù, nǐ dōu shuō méi kòng. Wǒ hái yǐwéi nǐ zài dǎgōng.
lines.english: What have you been doing at weekends lately? Every time I ask you out, you say you're busy. I thought you had a part-time job.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 哪有時間打工？不是在家睡覺，就是去補習班上英文課，週末一下子就過去了。
lines.simplified: 哪有时间打工？不是在家睡觉，就是去补习班上英文课，周末一下子就过去了。
lines.pinyin: Nǎ yǒu shíjiān dǎgōng? Bú shì zài jiā shuìjiào, jiù shì qù bǔxíbān shàng Yīngwén kè, zhōumò yíxiàzi jiù guòqù le.
lines.english: Where would I find time for a job? If I'm not sleeping at home, I'm at cram school for English. The weekend is gone in no time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣太累了吧。這個星期天跟我們去看電影吧。
lines.simplified: 这样太累了吧。这个星期天跟我们去看电影吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng tài lèi le ba. Zhège xīngqítiān gēn wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
lines.english: That sounds exhausting. Come to a movie with us this Sunday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，剛好這個星期天補習班放假。
lines.simplified: 好啊，刚好这个星期天补习班放假。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, gānghǎo zhège xīngqítiān bǔxíbān fàngjià.
lines.english: Sure, the cram school happens to be closed this Sunday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最近的週末怎麼過？
prompt.simplified: 女的最近的周末怎么过？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìjìn de zhōumò zěnme guò?
prompt.english: How has the woman been spending her weekends lately?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xué Yīngwén huò qù dǎgōng.
choices.english: Studying English or a part-time job.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù dǎgōng huò xiūxí.
choices.english: A part-time job or resting.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shuìjiào huò kàn diànyǐng.
choices.english: Sleeping or seeing movies.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiūxí huò xué Yīngwén.
choices.english: Resting or studying English.

questions.why: 不是在家睡覺，就是去補習班上英文課: 不是 A 就是 B means always one of the two. The job was only his guess (哪有時間打工？), and the movie is his plan for this Sunday.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班的休閒活動調查做完了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们班的休闲活动调查做完了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān de xiūxián huódòng diàochá zuò wán le ma?
lines.english: Has your class finished its survey on free-time activities?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 總算做完了！本來以為兩個星期就夠了，結果花了快一個月。我們一共問了一百二十個大學生。
lines.simplified: 总算做完了！本来以为两个星期就够了，结果花了快一个月。我们一共问了一百二十个大学生。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngsuàn zuò wán le! Běnlái yǐwéi liǎng ge xīngqí jiù gòu le, jiéguǒ huā le kuài yí ge yuè. Wǒmen yígòng wèn le yìbǎi èrshí ge dàxuéshēng.
lines.english: Finally finished! I thought two weeks would be enough, but it took almost a month. We asked a hundred and twenty university students.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 結果怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 结果怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What were the results?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 三分之二的人說，週末最常在家用手機、電腦。常去戶外運動的，只有四分之一。
lines.simplified: 三分之二的人说，周末最常在家用手机、电脑。常去户外运动的，只有四分之一。
lines.pinyin: Sān fēn zhī èr de rén shuō, zhōumò zuì cháng zài jiā yòng shǒujī, diànnǎo. Cháng qù hùwài yùndòng de, zhǐyǒu sì fēn zhī yī.
lines.english: Two thirds said that at weekends they are most often at home on their phones and computers. Only a quarter often exercise outdoors.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我還以為最多人在家睡覺呢。那剩下的人呢？
lines.simplified: 我还以为最多人在家睡觉呢。那剩下的人呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐwéi zuì duō rén zài jiā shuìjiào ne. Nà shèngxià de rén ne?
lines.english: I thought most people would be sleeping at home. And the rest?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他們週末都得打工，沒時間休息。
lines.simplified: 他们周末都得打工，没时间休息。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen zhōumò dōu děi dǎgōng, méi shíjiān xiūxí.
lines.english: They all have to work part-time at weekends and have no time to rest.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 在這個調查中，週末最多人做的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 在这个调查中，周末最多人做的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zài zhège diàochá zhōng, zhōumò zuì duō rén zuò de shì shénme?
prompt.english: In this survey, what do the most students do at weekends?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài jiā shàngwǎng.
choices.english: Go online at home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào hùwài qù yùndòng.
choices.english: Exercise outdoors.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mángzhe qù dǎgōng.
choices.english: Work part-time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài jiālǐ shuìjiào.
choices.english: Sleep at home.

questions.why: 三分之二 (two thirds) spend it at home on phones and computers, more than the 四分之一 (a quarter) who go outdoors or the few left who work. Sleeping at home was only what the woman expected.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說到這個調查，下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 说到这个调查，下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Shuō dào zhège diàochá, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true about the survey?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ jìhuà zǎo yìdiǎn zuò wán.
choices.english: It was done earlier than planned.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wèn de rén bǐ jìhuà de duō.
choices.english: More people were asked than planned.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huā de shíjiān bǐ xiǎng de cháng.
choices.english: It took longer than he expected.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu yìxiē méi zuò wán.
choices.english: Some of it is still not done.

questions.why: 總算做完了 + 本來以為兩個星期就夠了，結果花了快一個月: 總算 shows a long effort is over, and it took twice the time he expected. It is finished, so not "still not done".

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳姊姊找到工作了？
lines.simplified: 听说你姐姐找到工作了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ jiějie zhǎo dào gōngzuò le?
lines.english: I hear your sister found a job?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，她找了快半年，上個月總算開始在一家旅館上班了。
lines.simplified: 对啊，她找了快半年，上个月总算开始在一家旅馆上班了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā zhǎo le kuài bàn nián, shàng ge yuè zǒngsuàn kāishǐ zài yì jiā lǚguǎn shàngbān le.
lines.english: Yes. She looked for almost half a year, and last month she finally started working at a hotel.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了。她喜歡那個工作嗎？
lines.simplified: 太好了。她喜欢那个工作吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Tā xǐhuān nàge gōngzuò ma?
lines.english: Great. Does she like the job?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很喜歡，老闆和同事都很好。只是她每個月有三分之一的錢都得付房租。
lines.simplified: 很喜欢，老板和同事都很好。只是她每个月有三分之一的钱都得付房租。
lines.pinyin: Hěn xǐhuān, lǎobǎn hé tóngshì dōu hěn hǎo. Zhǐshì tā měi ge yuè yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de qián dōu děi fù fángzū.
lines.english: She loves it; her boss and colleagues are great. It's just that a third of her money each month has to go on rent.

lines.speaker: M

lines.speaker: M

lines.simplified: 我本来想约下午，可是那里下午的风会变得很大，在海里很危险，所以我们不得不早一点开始，七点就要到海滩。冲浪板你不用买，我这里有，只要多带一套衣服来换就好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng yuē xiàwǔ, kěshì nàlǐ xiàwǔ de fēng huì biàn de hěn dà, zài hǎi lǐ hěn wéixiǎn, suǒyǐ wǒmen bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn kāishǐ, qī diǎn jiù yào dào hǎitān. Chōnglàngbǎn nǐ búyòng mǎi, wǒ zhèlǐ yǒu, zhǐyào duō dài yí tào yīfu lái huàn jiù hǎo.
lines.english: I wanted to make it the afternoon, but the wind there gets very strong then and the sea is dangerous, so we'll have to start early: be at the beach by seven. You don't need to buy a surfboard, I have one. Just bring a change of clothes.

lines.traditional: 大家好。這個月公司要辦一個活動，下個星期六帶大家去山上摘水果。
lines.simplified: 大家好。这个月公司要办一个活动，下个星期六带大家去山上摘水果。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo. Zhège yuè gōngsī yào bàn yí ge huódòng, xià ge xīngqíliù dài dàjiā qù shān shàng zhāi shuǐguǒ.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. This month the company is holding an outing: next Saturday we're taking you all up the mountain to pick fruit.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 本來我們打算跟去年一樣，在公司裡吃飯、唱歌。可是在上個月的調查中，三分之一的同事說週末最想在家睡覺，但是有一半的人希望公司多辦戶外的活動。所以這次我們改去山上。
lines.simplified: 本来我们打算跟去年一样，在公司里吃饭、唱歌。可是在上个月的调查中，三分之一的同事说周末最想在家睡觉，但是有一半的人希望公司多办户外的活动。所以这次我们改去山上。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái wǒmen dǎsuàn gēn qùnián yíyàng, zài gōngsī lǐ chīfàn, chànggē. Kěshì zài shàng ge yuè de diàochá zhōng, sān fēn zhī yī de tóngshì shuō zhōumò zuì xiǎng zài jiā shuìjiào, dànshì yǒu yíbàn de rén xīwàng gōngsī duō bàn hùwài de huódòng. Suǒyǐ zhè cì wǒmen gǎi qù shān shàng.
lines.english: We first planned to do the same as last year: dinner and singing at the office. But in last month's survey, a third of you said what you most want at weekends is to sleep at home, while half said you hope the company will hold more outdoor activities. So this time we're going up the mountain.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那裡的水果很有名，週末去摘的人很多，去晚了，好的就被摘光了。所以我們不得不早一點出發，早上七點就要在公司門口集合。山上離公司不遠，開車一個小時就到了。摘的水果大家可以帶回家。想參加的人，請在星期三以前告訴我。
lines.simplified: 那里的水果很有名，周末去摘的人很多，去晚了，好的就被摘光了。所以我们不得不早一点出发，早上七点就要在公司门口集合。山上离公司不远，开车一个小时就到了。摘的水果大家可以带回家。想参加的人，请在星期三以前告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shuǐguǒ hěn yǒumíng, zhōumò qù zhāi de rén hěn duō, qù wǎn le, hǎo de jiù bèi zhāi guāng le. Suǒyǐ wǒmen bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn chūfā, zǎoshàng qī diǎn jiù yào zài gōngsī ménkǒu jíhé. Shān shàng lí gōngsī bù yuǎn, kāichē yí ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le. Zhāi de shuǐguǒ dàjiā kěyǐ dài huí jiā. Xiǎng cānjiā de rén, qǐng zài xīngqísān yǐqián gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: The fruit there is famous and lots of people go picking at weekends; get there late and the good fruit has all been picked. So we have no choice but to leave early: meet at the company entrance at 7 a.m. The mountain isn't far from the office, only an hour's drive. You can take the fruit you pick home. If you want to come, tell me before Wednesday.

passage.traditional: 去年冬天，我和朋友去日本滑雪。我從來沒滑過雪，一直很怕受傷，後來朋友說那裡的教練很有耐心，我才答應去。出發前，那裡{1}好幾天都下大雪。第一天我們{2}要上課時，教練就說雪太大了，我們只好在室內等。前兩天我常常一站起來就倒下去，到了第三天，我{3}能自己從山上滑下來了，那種感覺{4}得不得了。這次的旅行讓我{5}了對滑雪的心理障礙。回臺灣以前，朋友說：「{6}你這麼喜歡，明年我們就再來一次吧！」
passage.simplified: 去年冬天，我和朋友去日本滑雪。我从来没滑过雪，一直很怕受伤，后来朋友说那里的教练很有耐心，我才答应去。出发前，那里{1}好几天都下大雪。第一天我们{2}要上课时，教练就说雪太大了，我们只好在室内等。前两天我常常一站起来就倒下去，到了第三天，我{3}能自己从山上滑下来了，那种感觉{4}得不得了。这次的旅行让我{5}了对滑雪的心理障碍。回台湾以前，朋友说：「{6}你这么喜欢，明年我们就再来一次吧！」
passage.pinyin: Qùnián dōngtiān, wǒ hé péngyǒu qù Rìběn huáxuě. Wǒ cónglái méi huá guo xuě, yìzhí hěn pà shòushāng, hòulái péngyǒu shuō nàlǐ de jiàoliàn hěn yǒu nàixīn, wǒ cái dāyìng qù. Chūfā qián, nàlǐ yìlián hǎojǐ tiān dōu xià dà xuě. Dì yī tiān wǒmen zhèng yào shàngkè shí, jiàoliàn jiù shuō xuě tài dà le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zài shìnèi děng. Qián liǎng tiān wǒ chángcháng yí zhàn qǐlái jiù dǎo xiàqù, dào le dì sān tiān, wǒ zǒngsuàn néng zìjǐ cóng shān shàng huá xiàlái le, nà zhǒng gǎnjué cìjī de bùdéliǎo. Zhè cì de lǚxíng ràng wǒ kèfú le duì huáxuě de xīnlǐ zhàng'ài. Huí Táiwān yǐqián, péngyǒu shuō: “Jìrán nǐ zhème xǐhuān, míngnián wǒmen jiù zài lái yí cì ba!”
passage.english: Last winter a friend and I went skiing in Japan. I had never skied and was always afraid of getting hurt; then my friend said the coaches there were very patient, and only then did I agree to go. Before we left, it snowed heavily there for several days in a row. On the first day, just as we were about to start our lesson, the coach said the snow was too heavy, so we had to wait indoors. For the first two days I kept falling over as soon as I stood up, but on the third day I could finally ski down the mountain by myself, and it was so exciting. This trip helped me get over my fear of skiing. Before we went back to Taiwan, my friend said, "Since you love it this much, let's come again next year!"

passage.traditional: 我妹妹從小就喜歡打籃球，每天從學校回來以後{1}在球場練球，就是在家看球賽。爸媽覺得運動好{2}好，可是怕她因為練球而沒時間念書，所以一直不讓她參加比賽。後來教練來我們家，說妹妹很有實力，爸爸才說：「{3}教練都這麼說了，我們就讓妳去。不過，功課也得寫完。」為了念書和練球，妹妹{4}了很多玩的時間，每天{5}早上五點就起床。上個星期，她{6}要出門去比賽時，爸媽說要一起去替她加油，她高興得不得了。
passage.simplified: 我妹妹从小就喜欢打篮球，每天从学校回来以后{1}在球场练球，就是在家看球赛。爸妈觉得运动好{2}好，可是怕她因为练球而没时间念书，所以一直不让她参加比赛。后来教练来我们家，说妹妹很有实力，爸爸才说：「{3}教练都这么说了，我们就让你去。不过，功课也得写完。」为了念书和练球，妹妹{4}了很多玩的时间，每天{5}早上五点就起床。上个星期，她{6}要出门去比赛时，爸妈说要一起去替她加油，她高兴得不得了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei cóng xiǎo jiù xǐhuān dǎ lánqiú, měi tiān cóng xuéxiào huílái yǐhòu bú shì zài qiúchǎng liàn qiú, jiù shì zài jiā kàn qiúsài. Bàmā juéde yùndòng hǎo dàoshì hǎo, kěshì pà tā yīnwèi liàn qiú ér méi shíjiān niànshū, suǒyǐ yìzhí bú ràng tā cānjiā bǐsài. Hòulái jiàoliàn lái wǒmen jiā, shuō mèimei hěn yǒu shílì, bàba cái shuō: “Jìrán jiàoliàn dōu zhème shuō le, wǒmen jiù ràng nǐ qù. Búguò, gōngkè yě děi xiě wán.” Wèile niànshū hé liàn qiú, mèimei xīshēng le hěn duō wán de shíjiān, měi tiān bùdébù zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng. Shàng ge xīngqí, tā zhèng yào chūmén qù bǐsài shí, bàmā shuō yào yìqǐ qù tì tā jiāyóu, tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo.
passage.english: My younger sister has loved basketball since she was little: every day when she gets back from school she is either practising on the court or watching games at home. My parents think sport is good, all right, but they worried that training would leave her no time to study, so they never let her play in games. Then her coach came to our home and said she was really talented, and only then did Dad say, "Since even the coach says so, we'll let you go. But your homework still has to get done." To study and train, my sister gave up a lot of free time, and now she has no choice but to get up at five every morning. Last week, just as she was about to leave for a game, my parents said they would come and cheer for her, and she was thrilled.

text.traditional: 去年我搬到學校附近，房子離捷運站很近，房租也不貴。沒想到住進去以後才發現，樓下有一家夜店。每天晚上十一點以後，音樂就開得很大聲，關上窗戶也聽得很清楚，到了早上四點才停。我跟老闆說了好幾次，請他把音樂關小聲一點，可是都沒有用。因為晚上睡不好，我上課的時候常常沒精神，成績也越來越差。在朋友的眼中，我是一個不怕吵的人，以前住宿舍的時候，室友半夜聊天，我也睡得很好，可是這次我真的受不了了。上個月，我不得不再找房子，搬到了離學校比較遠的地方。現在每天要多花四十分鐘坐車，不過晚上能好好休息，我覺得很值得。
text.simplified: 去年我搬到学校附近，房子离捷运站很近，房租也不贵。没想到住进去以后才发现，楼下有一家夜店。每天晚上十一点以后，音乐就开得很大声，关上窗户也听得很清楚，到了早上四点才停。我跟老板说了好几次，请他把音乐关小声一点，可是都没有用。因为晚上睡不好，我上课的时候常常没精神，成绩也越来越差。在朋友的眼中，我是一个不怕吵的人，以前住宿舍的时候，室友半夜聊天，我也睡得很好，可是这次我真的受不了了。上个月，我不得不再找房子，搬到了离学校比较远的地方。现在每天要多花四十分钟坐车，不过晚上能好好休息，我觉得很值得。
text.pinyin: Qùnián wǒ bān dào xuéxiào fùjìn, fángzi lí jiéyùn zhàn hěn jìn, fángzū yě bú guì. Méixiǎngdào zhù jìnqù yǐhòu cái fāxiàn, lóuxià yǒu yì jiā yèdiàn. Měi tiān wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn yǐhòu, yīnyuè jiù kāi de hěn dàshēng, guān shàng chuānghù yě tīng de hěn qīngchǔ, dào le zǎoshàng sì diǎn cái tíng. Wǒ gēn lǎobǎn shuō le hǎojǐ cì, qǐng tā bǎ yīnyuè guān xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn, kěshì dōu méiyǒu yòng. Yīnwèi wǎnshàng shuì bù hǎo, wǒ shàngkè de shíhòu chángcháng méi jīngshén, chéngjī yě yuè lái yuè chà. Zài péngyǒu de yǎn zhōng, wǒ shì yí ge bú pà chǎo de rén, yǐqián zhù sùshè de shíhòu, shìyǒu bànyè liáotiān, wǒ yě shuì de hěn hǎo, kěshì zhè cì wǒ zhēn de shòubùliǎo le. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ bùdébù zài zhǎo fángzi, bān dào le lí xuéxiào bǐjiào yuǎn de dìfāng. Xiànzài měi tiān yào duō huā sìshí fēnzhōng zuò chē, búguò wǎnshàng néng hǎohǎo xiūxí, wǒ juéde hěn zhídé.
text.english: Last year I moved near my school. The flat was close to an MRT station and the rent wasn't high. But once I moved in, I found there was a nightclub downstairs. Every night after eleven the music was so loud I could hear it clearly even with the windows shut, and it only stopped at four in the morning. I asked the owner several times to turn it down, but it never helped. Because I slept badly, I was often tired in class and my grades kept getting worse. In my friends' eyes I'm someone who doesn't mind noise: back in the dorm I slept well even when my roommate chatted in the middle of the night. But this time I really couldn't stand it. Last month I had no choice but to find another place, and I moved somewhere farther from school. Now I spend forty more minutes a day on the road, but I can rest properly at night, and I think it's worth it.
