choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā gōngsī lóuxià kěyǐ tíng le.
choices.english: He can now park under his own office.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yào bāng tā fù sānbǎi kuài.
choices.english: The woman will pay the three hundred for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的下班要請他喝咖啡
choices.simplified: 女的下班要请他喝咖啡
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de xiàbān yào qǐng tā hē kāfēi.
choices.english: The woman will buy him a coffee after work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 可以把車停在女的公司樓下
choices.simplified: 可以把车停在女的公司楼下
choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng zài nǚ de gōngsī lóuxià.
choices.english: He can park the bike downstairs at the woman's office.

questions.why: After 只不過 comes his worry: nowhere to park near his office, and a bike by the road may be stolen. Her building across the road solves both, so he will ride. It is her building, not his; the 300 a month is the fee, and nothing says she pays it; and he is the one buying the coffee.

focus.en: it's just that…; a changed plan

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳昨天怎麼沒來上課？老師還問妳去哪裡了。
lines.simplified: 你昨天怎么没来上课？老师还问你去哪里了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān zěnme méi lái shàngkè? Lǎoshī hái wèn nǐ qù nǎlǐ le.
lines.english: Why weren't you in class yesterday? The teacher even asked where you were.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別提了。前天晚上我室友買了一大包炸雞回來，我吃了好幾塊，結果半夜肚子痛得不得了。
lines.simplified: 别提了。前天晚上我室友买了一大包炸鸡回来，我吃了好几块，结果半夜肚子痛得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Bié tí le. Qiántiān wǎnshàng wǒ shìyǒu mǎi le yí dà bāo zhájī huílái, wǒ chī le hǎojǐ kuài, jiéguǒ bànyè dùzi tòng de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Don't ask. The night before last my roommate brought back a big bag of fried chicken. I ate several pieces, and in the middle of the night my stomach hurt terribly.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳室友呢？她也不舒服嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你室友呢？她也不舒服吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ shìyǒu ne? Tā yě bù shūfú ma?
lines.english: And your roommate? Was she sick too?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她說她最近不吃太油的東西，一塊都沒吃，都給我吃了。害我吃太多，痛了一整天，連下床都沒辦法。
lines.simplified: 她说她最近不吃太油的东西，一块都没吃，都给我吃了。害我吃太多，痛了一整天，连下床都没办法。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zuìjìn bù chī tài yóu de dōngxi, yí kuài dōu méi chī, dōu gěi wǒ chī le. Hài wǒ chī tài duō, tòng le yì zhěng tiān, lián xià chuáng dōu méi bànfǎ.
lines.english: She says she's off oily food lately, so she didn't eat a single piece and gave it all to me. Because of her I ate too much, and I was in pain all day; I couldn't even get out of bed.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒去上課？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没去上课？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme méi qù shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why did the woman miss class?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 室友病了，她得在家照顧
choices.simplified: 室友病了，她得在家照顾
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bìng le, tā děi zài jiā zhàogù.
choices.english: Her roommate was ill and she had to look after her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟室友一起吃壞了肚子
choices.simplified: 跟室友一起吃坏了肚子
choices.pinyin: Gēn shìyǒu yìqǐ chī huài le dùzi.
choices.english: She and her roommate both got an upset stomach.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 吃了室友買的東西，身體不舒服
choices.simplified: 吃了室友买的东西，身体不舒服
choices.pinyin: Chī le shìyǒu mǎi de dōngxi, shēntǐ bù shūfú.
choices.english: She ate what her roommate bought and felt ill.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 半夜吃東西，早上起不來
choices.simplified: 半夜吃东西，早上起不来
choices.pinyin: Bànyè chī dōngxi, zǎoshàng qǐ bù lái.
choices.english: She ate at midnight and couldn't get up.

questions.why: The fried chicken her roommate bought gave her the stomach ache, and 害我吃太多，痛了一整天 says the roommate left her eating it all, which kept her in bed all day. The roommate ate none (一塊都沒吃), so she was not ill, and the chicken came the evening before; the pain is what kept her home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的眼睛怎麼這麼紅？昨天沒睡好嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的眼睛怎么这么红？昨天没睡好吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de yǎnjīng zěnme zhème hóng? Zuótiān méi shuì hǎo ma?
lines.english: Why are your eyes so red? Didn't you sleep well?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 樓上鄰居家的狗叫了一整夜，害我到早上都睡不著。
lines.simplified: 楼上邻居家的狗叫了一整夜，害我到早上都睡不着。
lines.pinyin: Lóushàng línjū jiā de gǒu jiào le yì zhěng yè, hài wǒ dào zǎoshàng dōu shuì bù zháo.
lines.english: The dog upstairs at my neighbour's barked all night. It kept me awake till morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那隻狗平常很安靜啊。怎麼了？
lines.simplified: 那只狗平常很安静啊。怎么了？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu píngcháng hěn ānjìng a. Zěnme le?
lines.english: That dog is usually so quiet. What happened?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我早上去問了。鄰居說他昨天工作到半夜，狗自己在家很害怕，才一直叫。他說以後會早點回家。
lines.simplified: 我早上去问了。邻居说他昨天工作到半夜，狗自己在家很害怕，才一直叫。他说以后会早点回家。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshàng qù wèn le. Línjū shuō tā zuótiān gōngzuò dào bànyè, gǒu zìjǐ zài jiā hěn hàipà, cái yìzhí jiào. Tā shuō yǐhòu huì zǎo diǎn huíjiā.
lines.english: I went and asked this morning. My neighbour says he worked until midnight yesterday; the dog was scared at home alone, so it kept barking. He says he'll come home earlier from now on.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 鄰居為什麼說以後會早點回家？
prompt.simplified: 邻居为什么说以后会早点回家？
prompt.pinyin: Línjū wèishénme shuō yǐhòu huì zǎo diǎn huíjiā?
prompt.english: Why does the neighbour say he will come home earlier from now on?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他昨天回家時吵醒了男的
choices.simplified: 他昨天回家时吵醒了男的
choices.pinyin: Tā zuótiān huíjiā shí chǎo xǐng le nán de.
choices.english: He woke the man up when he came home yesterday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的一再要他早點回家
choices.simplified: 男的一再要他早点回家
choices.pinyin: Nán de yízài yào tā zǎo diǎn huíjiā.
choices.english: The man kept asking him to come home earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 狗自己在家時才會一直叫
choices.simplified: 狗自己在家时才会一直叫
choices.pinyin: Gǒu zìjǐ zài jiā shí cái huì yìzhí jiào.
choices.english: The dog only barks like that when it is home alone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他的工作昨天就做完了
choices.simplified: 他的工作昨天就做完了
choices.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò zuótiān jiù zuò wán le.
choices.english: He finished his work yesterday.

questions.why: The barking that 害我到早上都睡不著 came because he worked until midnight and the dog, alone, was scared (才一直叫), so coming home earlier stops it. The dog, not the neighbour, kept the man awake; the man went to ask only once; and working until midnight means the work was not done early.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你以前一天要喝三杯咖啡，現在怎麼都喝茶了？
lines.simplified: 你以前一天要喝三杯咖啡，现在怎么都喝茶了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǐqián yì tiān yào hē sān bēi kāfēi, xiànzài zěnme dōu hē chá le?
lines.english: You used to drink three cups of coffee a day. Why is it all tea now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上次健康檢查，醫生說我晚上睡不好，是因為咖啡喝太多了。所以我現在以茶代替咖啡。
lines.simplified: 上次健康检查，医生说我晚上睡不好，是因为咖啡喝太多了。所以我现在以茶代替咖啡。
lines.pinyin: Shàng cì jiànkāng jiǎnchá, yīshēng shuō wǒ wǎnshàng shuì bù hǎo, shì yīnwèi kāfēi hē tài duō le. Suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài yǐ chá dàitì kāfēi.
lines.english: At my last checkup the doctor said I slept badly because I drank too much coffee. So now I drink tea instead of coffee.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是喝茶也會讓人睡不著啊。
lines.simplified: 可是喝茶也会让人睡不着啊。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì hē chá yě huì ràng rén shuì bù zháo a.
lines.english: But tea keeps you awake too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道，所以下午三點以後，我就只喝水了。現在晚上十一點就睡得著。
lines.simplified: 我知道，所以下午三点以后，我就只喝水了。现在晚上十一点就睡得着。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, suǒyǐ xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐhòu, wǒ jiù zhǐ hē shuǐ le. Xiànzài wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn jiù shuì de zháo.
lines.english: I know, so after three in the afternoon I only drink water. Now I can fall asleep by eleven.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「喝茶也會讓人睡不著」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「喝茶也会让人睡不着」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "hē chá yě huì ràng rén shuì bù zháo", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "tea keeps you awake too"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 建議他三點以後只喝水
choices.simplified: 建议他三点以后只喝水
choices.pinyin: Jiànyì tā sān diǎn yǐhòu zhǐ hē shuǐ.
choices.english: She suggests he drink only water after three.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde hē chá bǐ kāfēi gèng zāo.
choices.english: She thinks tea is worse than coffee.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得改喝水也不一定好
choices.simplified: 觉得改喝水也不一定好
choices.pinyin: Juéde gǎi hē shuǐ yě bù yídìng hǎo.
choices.english: She thinks switching to water may not help either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得改喝茶也不一定好
choices.simplified: 觉得改喝茶也不一定好
choices.pinyin: Juéde gǎi hē chá yě bù yídìng hǎo.
choices.english: She thinks switching to tea may not help either.

questions.why: She answers his 以茶代替咖啡 with 喝茶也會…: 也 means tea has the same problem, so the swap may not fix his sleep. She is doubting the tea, not water: water after three is his own answer (我知道，所以…), not her idea, and 也 says "too", not "worse".

focus.en: use… in place of…; what someone means

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳牙痛了一個星期了，怎麼還不去看牙醫？
lines.simplified: 你牙痛了一个星期了，怎么还不去看牙医？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yá tòng le yí ge xīngqí le, zěnme hái bú qù kàn yáyī?
lines.english: Your tooth has hurt for a week. Why haven't you seen a dentist yet?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我最怕看牙醫了。再痛我也不想去，吃點藥就好了吧。
lines.simplified: 我最怕看牙医了。再痛我也不想去，吃点药就好了吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì pà kàn yáyī le. Zài tòng wǒ yě bù xiǎng qù, chī diǎn yào jiù hǎo le ba.
lines.english: I'm terrified of dentists. However much it hurts I don't want to go. Some medicine will do, won't it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次妳非去不可。我妹妹以前也是一直不去，後來痛得連飯都吃不下，看牙醫花的錢也多了很多。
lines.simplified: 这次你非去不可。我妹妹以前也是一直不去，后来痛得连饭都吃不下，看牙医花的钱也多了很多。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì nǐ fēi qù bù kě. Wǒ mèimei yǐqián yě shì yìzhí bú qù, hòulái tòng de lián fàn dōu chī bú xià, kàn yáyī huā de qián yě duō le hěn duō.
lines.english: This time you have to go. My younger sister kept putting it off too; in the end it hurt so much she couldn't even eat, and the dentist cost her a lot more too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那你明天陪我去。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那你明天陪我去。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà nǐ míngtiān péi wǒ qù.
lines.english: All right. Then come with me tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼說女的非去看牙醫不可？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么说女的非去看牙医不可？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme shuō nǚ de fēi qù kàn yáyī bù kě?
prompt.english: Why does the man say the woman must see a dentist?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 越晚去，問題可能越嚴重
choices.simplified: 越晚去，问题可能越严重
choices.pinyin: Yuè wǎn qù, wèntí kěnéng yuè yánzhòng.
choices.english: The longer she waits, the worse it may get.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的已經痛得吃不下飯
choices.simplified: 女的已经痛得吃不下饭
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yǐjīng tòng de chī bú xià fàn.
choices.english: She is already in too much pain to eat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 越晚去，花的錢可能越少
choices.simplified: 越晚去，花的钱可能越少
choices.pinyin: Yuè wǎn qù, huā de qián kěnéng yuè shǎo.
choices.english: The longer she waits, the less it may cost.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 越吃藥，問題可能越嚴重
choices.simplified: 越吃药，问题可能越严重
choices.pinyin: Yuè chī yào, wèntí kěnéng yuè yánzhòng.
choices.english: The more medicine she takes, the worse it may get.

questions.why: He backs 非去不可 with his sister's story: she put it off, the pain grew until she couldn't eat, and it cost far more. That happened to the sister, not to the woman; waiting cost the sister more, not less; and it is putting it off, not the medicine, that he says made things worse.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你爸爸上個星期住院了？現在怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 听说你爸爸上个星期住院了？现在怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ bàba shàng ge xīngqí zhùyuàn le? Xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I hear your dad was in hospital last week. How is he now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 已經回家了。他肚子不舒服了好幾個月，我們一再叫他去看醫生，他都說沒什麼。
lines.simplified: 已经回家了。他肚子不舒服了好几个月，我们一再叫他去看医生，他都说没什么。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng huíjiā le. Tā dùzi bù shūfú le hǎojǐ ge yuè, wǒmen yízài jiào tā qù kàn yīshēng, tā dōu shuō méi shénme.
lines.english: He's home now. His stomach had been bad for months. We told him again and again to see a doctor, and he always said it was nothing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那後來怎麼會去？
lines.simplified: 那后来怎么会去？
lines.pinyin: Nà hòulái zěnme huì qù?
lines.english: So how did he end up going?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 直到上星期痛得站不起來，他才肯讓我們送他去醫院。
lines.simplified: 直到上星期痛得站不起来，他才肯让我们送他去医院。
lines.pinyin: Zhídào shàng xīngqí tòng de zhàn bù qǐlái, tā cái kěn ràng wǒmen sòng tā qù yīyuàn.
lines.english: Not until last week, when it hurt so much he couldn't stand up, did he let us take him to hospital.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 醫生怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 医生怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng zěnme shuō?
lines.english: What did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還好不算太嚴重。好好吃藥，一兩個月就會好，只不過以後一杯酒都不能喝了。
lines.simplified: 还好不算太严重。好好吃药，一两个月就会好，只不过以后一杯酒都不能喝了。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo bú suàn tài yánzhòng. Hǎohǎo chī yào, yì liǎng ge yuè jiù huì hǎo, zhǐbúguò yǐhòu yì bēi jiǔ dōu bù néng hē le.
lines.english: Luckily it's not too serious. If he takes his medicine he'll be fine in a month or two; it's just that he can never drink a drop of alcohol again.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他做生意，常常要跟客人喝酒吧？
lines.simplified: 他做生意，常常要跟客人喝酒吧？
lines.pinyin: Tā zuò shēngyì, chángcháng yào gēn kèrén hē jiǔ ba?
lines.english: He's in business. He has to drink with clients a lot, doesn't he?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。他說不能喝酒，以後怎麼跟客人談生意。
lines.simplified: 对啊。他说不能喝酒，以后怎么跟客人谈生意。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Tā shuō bù néng hē jiǔ, yǐhòu zěnme gēn kèrén tán shēngyì.
lines.english: Yes. He says if he can't drink, how is he supposed to do business with clients?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 身體比生意重要。你們全家要多跟他溝通。
lines.simplified: 身体比生意重要。你们全家要多跟他沟通。
lines.pinyin: Shēntǐ bǐ shēngyì zhòngyào. Nǐmen quánjiā yào duō gēn tā gōutōng.
lines.english: His health matters more than business. Your whole family needs to talk it through with him.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的爸爸後來為什麼去了醫院？
prompt.simplified: 男的爸爸后来为什么去了医院？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de bàba hòulái wèishénme qù le yīyuàn?
prompt.english: Why did the man's father finally go to hospital?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 家人一再叫他去看醫生
choices.simplified: 家人一再叫他去看医生
choices.pinyin: Jiārén yízài jiào tā qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: His family kept urging him to see a doctor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 肚子痛得沒辦法走路了
choices.simplified: 肚子痛得没办法走路了
choices.pinyin: Dùzi tòng de méi bànfǎ zǒulù le.
choices.english: His stomach hurt too much to walk.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī yào tā zuò jiànkāng jiǎnchá.
choices.english: His company made him have a checkup.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kèrén péi tā qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: A client took him to see a doctor.

questions.why: 直到上星期痛得站不起來，他才肯…: the pain, not the family, got him there. 一再叫他去 is what had failed for months (他都說沒什麼), and no company checkup or client is mentioned.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的爸爸為什麼擔心以後的工作？
prompt.simplified: 男的爸爸为什么担心以后的工作？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de bàba wèishénme dānxīn yǐhòu de gōngzuò?
prompt.english: Why is the man's father worried about his work from now on?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 談生意常常得陪客人喝酒
choices.simplified: 谈生意常常得陪客人喝酒
choices.pinyin: Tán shēngyì chángcháng děi péi kèrén hē jiǔ.
choices.english: Doing business often means drinking with clients.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 還得在醫院住一兩個月
choices.simplified: 还得在医院住一两个月
choices.pinyin: Hái děi zài yīyuàn zhù yì liǎng ge yuè.
choices.english: He still has to stay in hospital a month or two.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 醫生要他少跟客人吃飯
choices.simplified: 医生要他少跟客人吃饭
choices.pinyin: Yīshēng yào tā shǎo gēn kèrén chīfàn.
choices.english: The doctor wants him to eat out with clients less.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 家人要他少做一點生意
choices.simplified: 家人要他少做一点生意
choices.pinyin: Jiārén yào tā shǎo zuò yìdiǎn shēngyì.
choices.english: His family wants him to do less business.

questions.why: After 只不過 the doctor adds the lasting rule, no alcohol ever again, and the father asks how he can do business without drinking with clients. He is already home (一兩個月 is how long the medicine takes), the doctor said nothing about meals, and the family is only asked to talk with him.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後說的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后说的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by what she says last?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 好好跟客人談，讓爸爸少喝酒
choices.simplified: 好好跟客人谈，让爸爸少喝酒
choices.pinyin: Hǎohǎo gēn kèrén tán, ràng bàba shǎo hē jiǔ.
choices.english: Talk it over with the clients so Dad drinks less.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓爸爸換一個不用喝酒的工作
choices.simplified: 让爸爸换一个不用喝酒的工作
choices.pinyin: Ràng bàba huàn yí ge bú yòng hē jiǔ de gōngzuò.
choices.english: Get Dad to change to a job without drinking.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 好好跟醫生談，讓爸爸多注意健康
choices.simplified: 好好跟医生谈，让爸爸多注意健康
choices.pinyin: Hǎohǎo gēn yīshēng tán, ràng bàba duō zhùyì jiànkāng.
choices.english: Talk it over with the doctor so Dad pays more attention to his health.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 好好跟爸爸談，讓他多注意健康
choices.simplified: 好好跟爸爸谈，让他多注意健康
choices.pinyin: Hǎohǎo gēn bàba tán, ràng tā duō zhùyì jiànkāng.
choices.english: Talk it over with Dad properly so he pays more attention to his health.

questions.why: 身體比生意重要。你們全家要多跟他溝通: talk with him until he puts health before business. 跟他 is Dad himself, not the doctor or the clients (the clients are his worry), and putting health first does not mean giving up his business.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼戴起眼鏡來了？你眼睛不是很好嗎？
lines.simplified: 你怎么戴起眼镜来了？你眼睛不是很好吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme dài qǐ yǎnjìng lái le? Nǐ yǎnjīng bú shì hěn hǎo ma?
lines.english: Since when do you wear glasses? Aren't your eyes good?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月開始，黑板上的字越來越看不清楚。我以為只是太累了，直到上星期去檢查，才知道眼睛真的變差了。
lines.simplified: 上个月开始，黑板上的字越来越看不清楚。我以为只是太累了，直到上星期去检查，才知道眼睛真的变差了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè kāishǐ, hēibǎn shàng de zì yuè lái yuè kàn bù qīngchǔ. Wǒ yǐwéi zhǐ shì tài lèi le, zhídào shàng xīngqí qù jiǎnchá, cái zhīdào yǎnjīng zhēn de biàn chà le.
lines.english: From last month the writing on the board got harder and harder to read. I thought I was just tired; not until I had my eyes checked last week did I find out they had really got worse.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是不是手機看太多了？
lines.simplified: 是不是手机看太多了？
lines.pinyin: Shì bú shì shǒujī kàn tài duō le?
lines.english: Is it from looking at your phone too much?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生也這麼說。我每天躺在床上看影片，常常看到半夜兩三點。我媽一再說這樣對眼睛不好，我都沒聽。
lines.simplified: 医生也这么说。我每天躺在床上看影片，常常看到半夜两三点。我妈一再说这样对眼睛不好，我都没听。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng yě zhème shuō. Wǒ měi tiān tǎng zài chuáng shàng kàn yǐngpiàn, chángcháng kàn dào bànyè liǎng sān diǎn. Wǒ mā yízài shuō zhèyàng duì yǎnjīng bù hǎo, wǒ dōu méi tīng.
lines.english: That's what the doctor said too. Every day I lie in bed watching videos, often until two or three in the morning. My mom told me again and again it was bad for my eyes, and I never listened.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你現在還看嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你现在还看吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ xiànzài hái kàn ma?
lines.english: So do you still watch?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生說要是不改，眼睛會越來越差。所以我現在十二點以前就把手機放到客廳去。
lines.simplified: 医生说要是不改，眼睛会越来越差。所以我现在十二点以前就把手机放到客厅去。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō yàoshì bù gǎi, yǎnjīng huì yuè lái yuè chà. Suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài shí'èr diǎn yǐqián jiù bǎ shǒujī fàng dào kètīng qù.
lines.english: The doctor said if I don't change, my eyes will keep getting worse. So now I put my phone in the living room before twelve.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你媽一定很高興吧？
lines.simplified: 你妈一定很高兴吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mā yídìng hěn gāoxìng ba?
lines.english: Your mom must be pleased.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她說她講了三年都沒用，醫生才說一次就有用了。
lines.simplified: 她说她讲了三年都没用，医生才说一次就有用了。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō tā jiǎng le sān nián dōu méi yòng, yīshēng cái shuō yí cì jiù yǒu yòng le.
lines.english: She says she told me for three years and it did nothing, and the doctor said it just once and it worked.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼時候知道眼睛真的變差的？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么时候知道眼睛真的变差的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme shíhòu zhīdào yǎnjīng zhēn de biàn chà de?
prompt.english: When did the man find out his eyes had really got worse?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí zuò le jiǎnchá yǐhòu.
choices.english: After his eye check last week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 上個月覺得很累的時候
choices.simplified: 上个月觉得很累的时候
choices.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè juéde hěn lèi de shíhòu.
choices.english: Last month, when he felt very tired.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 看影片看到半夜的時候
choices.simplified: 看影片看到半夜的时候
choices.pinyin: Kàn yǐngpiàn kàn dào bànyè de shíhòu.
choices.english: When he watched videos until late at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 開始看不清楚黑板的時候
choices.simplified: 开始看不清楚黑板的时候
choices.pinyin: Kāishǐ kàn bù qīngchǔ hēibǎn de shíhòu.
choices.english: When he first couldn't read the board.

questions.why: 我以為只是太累了，直到上星期去檢查，才知道…: when the board got blurry he blamed tiredness, and only the check last week showed the truth. The late-night videos are the cause, not the moment he learned it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼把手機放到客廳去？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么把手机放到客厅去？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bǎ shǒujī fàng dào kètīng qù?
prompt.english: Why does the man put his phone in the living room?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 才不會在床上看到半夜
choices.simplified: 才不会在床上看到半夜
choices.pinyin: Cái bú huì zài chuáng shàng kàn dào bànyè.
choices.english: So that he won't watch in bed until late at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de jiào tā shǎo kàn shǒujī.
choices.english: The woman told him to use his phone less.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 醫生叫他把手機放在客廳
choices.simplified: 医生叫他把手机放在客厅
choices.pinyin: Yīshēng jiào tā bǎ shǒujī fàng zài kètīng.
choices.english: The doctor told him to keep his phone in the living room.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在客廳看影片眼睛比較不累
choices.simplified: 在客厅看影片眼睛比较不累
choices.pinyin: Zài kètīng kàn yǐngpiàn yǎnjīng bǐjiào bú lèi.
choices.english: Watching videos in the living room is easier on his eyes.

questions.why: He used to lie in bed watching videos until two or three; once the doctor warned 要是不改…, he moved the phone out of the bedroom so he can't do that. The woman only asked a question, the doctor said to change but not where to put the phone, and he puts the phone away rather than watching in another room.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的媽媽說的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的妈妈说的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de māma shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man's mother mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā hěn gǎnxiè nà wèi yīshēng.
choices.english: She is very grateful to the doctor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兒子三年前眼睛就不好了
choices.simplified: 儿子三年前眼睛就不好了
choices.pinyin: Érzi sān nián qián yǎnjīng jiù bù hǎo le.
choices.english: Her son's eyes went bad three years ago.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得醫生說得太嚴重
choices.simplified: 她觉得医生说得太严重
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde yīshēng shuō de tài yánzhòng.
choices.english: She thinks the doctor exaggerated.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Érzi bǐjiào tīng yīshēng de huà.
choices.english: Her son listens to the doctor more than to her.

questions.why: She 一再 said it was bad for his eyes and he 都沒聽, so 她講了三年都沒用，醫生才說一次就有用了 is a half-joking complaint: he ignored her and obeyed the doctor at once. The three years are how long she nagged, not how long his eyes were bad, and she agrees with the doctor.

focus.en: again and again; what someone means

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 社區的各位朋友大家好，這裡是社區服務中心。
lines.simplified: 社区的各位朋友大家好，这里是社区服务中心。
lines.pinyin: Shèqū de gèwèi péngyǒu dàjiā hǎo, zhèlǐ shì shèqū fúwù zhōngxīn.
lines.english: Hello, everyone in the community. This is the community service centre.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個星期我們說過，為了讓大家更了解自己的健康情況，社區這個月跟附近的醫院合作，舉辦基本健康檢查。
lines.simplified: 上个星期我们说过，为了让大家更了解自己的健康情况，社区这个月跟附近的医院合作，举办基本健康检查。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqí wǒmen shuō guo, wèile ràng dàjiā gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ de jiànkāng qíngkuàng, shèqū zhège yuè gēn fùjìn de yīyuàn hézuò, jǔbàn jīběn jiànkāng jiǎnchá.
lines.english: Last week we told you that, to help everyone know more about their health, the community is working with a nearby hospital this month to hold basic health checkups.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 因為醫院那天醫生不夠，所以檢查從二十號星期六，改到二十一號星期天。
lines.simplified: 因为医院那天医生不够，所以检查从二十号星期六，改到二十一号星期天。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi yīyuàn nà tiān yīshēng bú gòu, suǒyǐ jiǎnchá cóng èrshí hào xīngqíliù, gǎi dào èrshíyī hào xīngqítiān.
lines.english: Because the hospital is short of doctors that day, the checkup is moving from Saturday the 20th to Sunday the 21st.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 時間一樣是上午八點到十一點，地點也一樣在一樓的活動中心。
lines.simplified: 时间一样是上午八点到十一点，地点也一样在一楼的活动中心。
lines.pinyin: Shíjiān yíyàng shì shàngwǔ bā diǎn dào shíyī diǎn, dìdiǎn yě yíyàng zài yī lóu de huódòng zhōngxīn.
lines.english: The time is still 8 to 11 a.m., and the place is still the activity room on the ground floor.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 滿四十歲的人免費；不到四十歲的，一個人付三百塊就可以參加。
lines.simplified: 满四十岁的人免费；不到四十岁的，一个人付三百块就可以参加。
lines.pinyin: Mǎn sìshí suì de rén miǎnfèi; bú dào sìshí suì de, yí ge rén fù sānbǎi kuài jiù kěyǐ cānjiā.
lines.english: It's free for those aged forty and over; those under forty can take part for three hundred dollars each.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 檢查前一天晚上十點以後，請不要再吃東西。
lines.simplified: 检查前一天晚上十点以后，请不要再吃东西。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎnchá qián yì tiān wǎnshàng shí diǎn yǐhòu, qǐng bú yào zài chī dōngxi.
lines.english: Please don't eat anything after 10 p.m. the night before.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 假如星期天沒辦法來，請在十五號以前到服務中心填表，我們會幫您改到下個月。謝謝大家。
lines.simplified: 假如星期天没办法来，请在十五号以前到服务中心填表，我们会帮您改到下个月。谢谢大家。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎrú xīngqítiān méi bànfǎ lái, qǐng zài shíwǔ hào yǐqián dào fúwù zhōngxīn tián biǎo, wǒmen huì bāng nín gǎi dào xià ge yuè. Xièxie dàjiā.
lines.english: If you can't come on Sunday, please fill in a form at the service centre by the 15th, and we'll move you to next month. Thank you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位三十五歲的太太星期天要上班，她應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位三十五岁的太太星期天要上班，她应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi sānshíwǔ suì de tàitai xīngqítiān yào shàngbān, tā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A 35-year-old woman works on Sunday. What should she do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 十五號前填表，下個月免費檢查
choices.simplified: 十五号前填表，下个月免费检查
choices.pinyin: Shíwǔ hào qián tián biǎo, xià ge yuè miǎnfèi jiǎnchá.
choices.english: Fill in the form by the 15th and have a free checkup next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 二十號前填表，下個月付三百塊
choices.simplified: 二十号前填表，下个月付三百块
choices.pinyin: Èrshí hào qián tián biǎo, xià ge yuè fù sānbǎi kuài.
choices.english: Fill in the form by the 20th and pay three hundred next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 十五號前填表，下個月付三百塊
choices.simplified: 十五号前填表，下个月付三百块
choices.pinyin: Shíwǔ hào qián tián biǎo, xià ge yuè fù sānbǎi kuài.
choices.english: Fill in the form by the 15th and pay three hundred next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 二十號那天付三百塊去檢查
choices.simplified: 二十号那天付三百块去检查
choices.pinyin: Èrshí hào nà tiān fù sānbǎi kuài qù jiǎnchá.
choices.english: Pay three hundred and go on the 20th.

questions.why: Two rules apply to her: 假如星期天沒辦法來 means a form by the 15th and a checkup next month, and being under forty means she pays 三百塊. Free is only for forty and over, the 20th is the old date, and there is no checkup on the 20th now.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 要參加這次健檢的人，最晚什麼時候要吃完東西？
prompt.simplified: 要参加这次健检的人，最晚什么时候要吃完东西？
prompt.pinyin: Yào cānjiā zhè cì jiànjiǎn de rén, zuì wǎn shénme shíhòu yào chī wán dōngxi?
prompt.english: For people having this checkup, what is the latest they can finish eating?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng shí diǎn
choices.english: Friday, 10 p.m.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng shí diǎn
choices.english: Saturday, 10 p.m.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn
choices.english: Saturday, 11 p.m.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqítiān zǎoshàng bā diǎn
choices.english: Sunday, 8 a.m.

questions.why: The checkup is now on Sunday, and 前一天晚上十點以後 means nothing after 10 p.m. on Saturday. Friday night belongs to the old Saturday date, and eleven and eight are the checkup's own hours.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是要告訴大家什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是要告诉大家什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào shì yào gàosu dàjiā shénme?
prompt.english: What is this announcement mainly telling people?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shèqū zhège yuè yào bàn jiànjiǎn.
choices.english: The community is holding checkups this month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Méi kòng de rén zěnme gǎi shíjiān.
choices.english: How people who are busy can change their time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīyuàn nà tiān de yīshēng bú gòu.
choices.english: The hospital is short of doctors that day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè cì jiànjiǎn gǎi chéng xīngqítiān.

passage.traditional: 我爸爸以前很少運動，下班就坐在沙發上看電視。醫生{1}提醒他要多運動，他每次都只說「好」，從來沒做到。直到今年他爬到三樓就累得要休息，才開始每天去公園跑步。剛開始，他跑十分鐘就想{2}，可是他說，{3}是自己決定的事，就要堅持到底。我媽也{4}讓他跑完就有飯吃，特地把晚餐時間改到八點。半年後，他的身體好了很多，{5}晚上睡得比以前好：以前常常睡不著，現在一躺下就睡著了。他常說，{6}他早幾年開始運動，身體就不會變得那麼差。
passage.simplified: 我爸爸以前很少运动，下班就坐在沙发上看电视。医生{1}提醒他要多运动，他每次都只说「好」，从来没做到。直到今年他爬到三楼就累得要休息，才开始每天去公园跑步。刚开始，他跑十分钟就想{2}，可是他说，{3}是自己决定的事，就要坚持到底。我妈也{4}让他跑完就有饭吃，特地把晚餐时间改到八点。半年后，他的身体好了很多，{5}晚上睡得比以前好：以前常常睡不着，现在一躺下就睡着了。他常说，{6}他早几年开始运动，身体就不会变得那么差。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián hěn shǎo yùndòng, xiàbān jiù zuò zài shāfā shàng kàn diànshì. Yīshēng yízài tíxǐng tā yào duō yùndòng, tā měi cì dōu zhǐ shuō "hǎo", cónglái méi zuò dào. Zhídào jīnnián tā pá dào sān lóu jiù lèi de yào xiūxí, cái kāishǐ měi tiān qù gōngyuán pǎobù. Gāng kāishǐ, tā pǎo shí fēnzhōng jiù xiǎng tíng xiàlái xiūxí, kěshì tā shuō, jìrán shì zìjǐ juédìng de shì, jiù yào jiānchí dàodǐ. Wǒ mā yě wèile ràng tā pǎo wán jiù yǒu fàn chī, tèdì bǎ wǎncān shíjiān gǎi dào bā diǎn. Bàn nián hòu, tā de shēntǐ hǎo le hěn duō, yóuqí wǎnshàng shuì de bǐ yǐqián hǎo: yǐqián chángcháng shuì bù zháo, xiànzài yì tǎng xià jiù shuìzháo le. Tā cháng shuō, jiǎrú tā zǎo jǐ nián kāishǐ yùndòng, shēntǐ jiù bú huì biàn de nàme chà.
passage.english: My dad used to hardly exercise; after work he would just sit on the sofa watching TV. The doctor reminded him again and again to exercise more, and every time he just said "OK" and never did it. Not until this year, when climbing to the third floor left him needing a rest, did he start running in the park every day. At first he wanted to stop for a rest after ten minutes, but he said that since it was his own decision, he had to stick with it to the end. So that he would have dinner ready as soon as he finished running, my mom made a point of moving dinner to eight. Six months on, his health is much better, especially his sleep at night: he used to have trouble sleeping, and now he falls asleep as soon as he lies down. He often says that if he had started exercising a few years earlier, his health would never have got so bad.

passage.traditional: 我姊姊在一家電腦公司上班，常常忙到晚上十點才吃晚餐，週末也在家工作。她也想早點下班，{1}老闆一直給她新的工作，她實在走不開。上個月她下班走到捷運站時，突然覺得頭很重，全身都不舒服，連路都走不動了。她本來以為只是沒睡好，{2}醫生說，這都是工作太累害的，要她馬上{3}生活作息。所以她跟老闆好好{4}了一次，現在每天六點就下班，晚上還會去公園走走。她說，以前她為了{5}而不管自己的身體，現在才知道，工作再重要，{6}沒有健康重要。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài yì jiā diànnǎo gōngsī shàngbān, chángcháng máng dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái chī wǎncān, zhōumò yě zài jiā gōngzuò. Tā yě xiǎng zǎo diǎn xiàbān, zhǐbúguò lǎobǎn yìzhí gěi tā xīn de gōngzuò, tā shízài zǒu bù kāi. Shàng ge yuè tā xiàbān zǒu dào jiéyùn zhàn shí, túrán juéde tóu hěn zhòng, quánshēn dōu bù shūfú, lián lù dōu zǒu bú dòng le. Tā běnlái yǐwéi zhǐ shì méi shuì hǎo, méixiǎngdào yīshēng shuō, zhè dōu shì gōngzuò tài lèi hài de, yào tā mǎshàng tiáozhěng shēnghuó zuòxí. Suǒyǐ tā gēn lǎobǎn hǎohǎo gōutōng le yí cì, xiànzài měi tiān liù diǎn jiù xiàbān, wǎnshàng hái huì qù gōngyuán zǒuzou. Tā shuō, yǐqián tā wèile bǎ gōngzuò zuò wán ér bù guǎn zìjǐ de shēntǐ, xiànzài cái zhīdào, gōngzuò zài zhòngyào, yě méiyǒu jiànkāng zhòngyào.
passage.english: My older sister works at a computer company. She is often so busy she doesn't eat dinner until ten at night, and she works at home at weekends too. She would like to leave work earlier too; it's just that her boss keeps giving her new work, and she really can't get away. Last month, walking to the MRT station after work, her head suddenly felt heavy, she felt ill all over, and she couldn't even walk. She thought she just hadn't slept well, but to her surprise the doctor said it was all caused by overwork and told her to adjust her daily schedule at once. So she had a proper talk with her boss, and now she leaves at six every day and goes for a walk in the park in the evening. She says that she used to ignore her health to get her work done, and now she knows that however important work is, it is not as important as health.

text.traditional: 我媽媽在市場賣菜，一天要站十幾個小時。去年她的腳常常痛，醫生說她得多運動，最好去游泳，因為游泳對腳的負擔比較小。可是媽媽小時候在河邊玩水，差一點出了意外，從那時候起就很怕水。我一再叫她去學，她都說：「我都五十幾歲了，還學什麼游泳？」後來，我發現社區的游泳池有一個給年紀比較大的人上的班，就陪她去看了一次。她看到班上有幾位七十幾歲的老太太游得很開心，才答應試試看。剛開始，她連把頭放進水裡都不敢，上了三次課就不想學了。老師對她說：「既然來了，就學到底吧！我也一定會一直教到妳會。」媽媽為了不讓老師白教，每個星期都去上兩次課，一次也沒請過假。半年以後，她已經能游五十公尺了，腳也不那麼痛了。現在她每天早上都去游泳，還交了好幾個新朋友。她常說，學游泳不難，最難的是第一次走進游泳池。
text.simplified: 我妈妈在市场卖菜，一天要站十几个小时。去年她的脚常常痛，医生说她得多运动，最好去游泳，因为游泳对脚的负担比较小。可是妈妈小时候在河边玩水，差一点出了意外，从那时候起就很怕水。我一再叫她去学，她都说：「我都五十几岁了，还学什么游泳？」后来，我发现社区的游泳池有一个给年纪比较大的人上的班，就陪她去看了一次。她看到班上有几位七十几岁的老太太游得很开心，才答应试试看。刚开始，她连把头放进水里都不敢，上了三次课就不想学了。老师对她说：「既然来了，就学到底吧！我也一定会一直教到你会。」妈妈为了不让老师白教，每个星期都去上两次课，一次也没请过假。半年以后，她已经能游五十公尺了，脚也不那么痛了。现在她每天早上都去游泳，还交了好几个新朋友。她常说，学游泳不难，最难的是第一次走进游泳池。
text.pinyin: Wǒ māma zài shìchǎng mài cài, yì tiān yào zhàn shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí. Qùnián tā de jiǎo chángcháng tòng, yīshēng shuō tā děi duō yùndòng, zuì hǎo qù yóuyǒng, yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì jiǎo de fùdān bǐjiào xiǎo. Kěshì māma xiǎo shíhòu zài hébiān wán shuǐ, chàyìdiǎn chū le yìwài, cóng nà shíhòu qǐ jiù hěn pà shuǐ. Wǒ yízài jiào tā qù xué, tā dōu shuō: "Wǒ dōu wǔshí jǐ suì le, hái xué shénme yóuyǒng?" Hòulái, wǒ fāxiàn shèqū de yóuyǒngchí yǒu yí ge gěi niánjì bǐjiào dà de rén shàng de bān, jiù péi tā qù kàn le yí cì. Tā kàndào bān shàng yǒu jǐ wèi qīshí jǐ suì de lǎo tàitai yóu de hěn kāixīn, cái dāyìng shìshi kàn. Gāng kāishǐ, tā lián bǎ tóu fàng jìn shuǐ lǐ dōu bù gǎn, shàng le sān cì kè jiù bù xiǎng xué le. Lǎoshī duì tā shuō: "Jìrán lái le, jiù xué dàodǐ ba! Wǒ yě yídìng huì yìzhí jiāo dào nǐ huì." Māma wèile bú ràng lǎoshī bái jiāo, měi ge xīngqí dōu qù shàng liǎng cì kè, yí cì yě méi qǐng guo jià. Bàn nián yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng néng yóu wǔshí gōngchǐ le, jiǎo yě bú nàme tòng le. Xiànzài tā měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù yóuyǒng, hái jiāo le hǎojǐ ge xīn péngyǒu. Tā cháng shuō, xué yóuyǒng bù nán, zuì nán de shì dì yī cì zǒu jìn yóuyǒngchí.
text.english: My mother sells vegetables at the market and stands for over ten hours a day. Last year her feet often hurt. The doctor said she needed more exercise, ideally swimming, because swimming puts less strain on the feet. But when she was little she nearly had an accident playing in a river, and she has been afraid of water ever since. I told her to learn again and again, and she always said, "I'm already in my fifties. Why would I learn to swim now?" Later I found that the community pool had a class for older people, and I took her to have a look. When she saw several women in their seventies in the class swimming happily, she agreed to give it a try. At first she didn't even dare put her head under the water, and after three lessons she wanted to stop. The teacher told her, "Since you've come, see it through! And I'll keep teaching you until you can do it." So that the teacher's work wouldn't be wasted, she went to two lessons every week and never once took a day off. Six months later she could swim fifty metres, and her feet didn't hurt so much. Now she swims every morning and has made several new friends. She often says learning to swim isn't hard; the hardest part is walking into the pool the first time.

text.traditional: 我一個人在臺北工作，因為很忙，三餐都在外面吃，不是小吃就是泡麵。去年公司做健康檢查，報告上好幾個數字都不太好。醫生一再提醒我，外面的東西又油又鹹，假如不改變飲食習慣，以後毛病會越來越多。我這才決定自己煮飯。剛開始我什麼都不會，第一次煮的湯淡得沒有味道，第二次又鹹得沒辦法喝，我差一點就不想做了。我媽知道以後，每個星期天晚上都打電話來，很有耐心地教我做一道菜。她說：「學做菜跟做別的事一樣，要學就學到底。」三個月以後，我已經會做十幾道菜了。今年再去健檢，那些數字都好多了。現在我每天帶自己做的午餐上班，同事都說我的菜看起來比餐廳的還好吃，還常常問我是怎麼做的。對我來說，自己煮飯的好處不只是身體變好了，還讓我跟媽媽多了很多可以聊的話題。
text.simplified: 我一个人在台北工作，因为很忙，三餐都在外面吃，不是小吃就是泡面。去年公司做健康检查，报告上好几个数字都不太好。医生一再提醒我，外面的东西又油又咸，假如不改变饮食习惯，以后毛病会越来越多。我这才决定自己煮饭。刚开始我什么都不会，第一次煮的汤淡得没有味道，第二次又咸得没办法喝，我差一点就不想做了。我妈知道以后，每个星期天晚上都打电话来，很有耐心地教我做一道菜。她说：「学做菜跟做别的事一样，要学就学到底。」三个月以后，我已经会做十几道菜了。今年再去健检，那些数字都好多了。现在我每天带自己做的午餐上班，同事都说我的菜看起来比餐厅的还好吃，还常常问我是怎么做的。对我来说，自己煮饭的好处不只是身体变好了，还让我跟妈妈多了很多可以聊的话题。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge rén zài Táiběi gōngzuò, yīnwèi hěn máng, sān cān dōu zài wàimiàn chī, bú shì xiǎochī jiù shì pàomiàn. Qùnián gōngsī zuò jiànkāng jiǎnchá, bàogào shàng hǎojǐ ge shùzì dōu bú tài hǎo. Yīshēng yízài tíxǐng wǒ, wàimiàn de dōngxi yòu yóu yòu xián, jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn, yǐhòu máobìng huì yuè lái yuè duō. Wǒ zhè cái juédìng zìjǐ zhǔ fàn. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ shénme dōu bú huì, dì yī cì zhǔ de tāng dàn de méiyǒu wèidào, dì èr cì yòu xián de méi bànfǎ hē, wǒ chàyìdiǎn jiù bù xiǎng zuò le. Wǒ mā zhīdào yǐhòu, měi ge xīngqítiān wǎnshàng dōu dǎ diànhuà lái, hěn yǒu nàixīn de jiāo wǒ zuò yí dào cài. Tā shuō: "Xué zuò cài gēn zuò bié de shì yíyàng, yào xué jiù xué dàodǐ." Sān ge yuè yǐhòu, wǒ yǐjīng huì zuò shí jǐ dào cài le. Jīnnián zài qù jiànjiǎn, nàxiē shùzì dōu hǎo duō le. Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān dài zìjǐ zuò de wǔcān shàngbān, tóngshì dōu shuō wǒ de cài kàn qǐlái bǐ cāntīng de hái hǎochī, hái chángcháng wèn wǒ shì zěnme zuò de. Duì wǒ lái shuō, zìjǐ zhǔ fàn de hǎochù bù zhǐ shì shēntǐ biàn hǎo le, hái ràng wǒ gēn māma duō le hěn duō kěyǐ liáo de huàtí.
text.english: I work in Taipei on my own. Because I'm busy, I eat all three meals out: if it's not street snacks, it's instant noodles. Last year my company held health checkups, and several numbers on my report weren't good. The doctor reminded me again and again that food outside is oily and salty, and that if I didn't change my eating habits I would have more and more health problems. Only then did I decide to cook for myself. At first I couldn't do anything: the first soup I made was so bland it had no taste, the second so salty I couldn't drink it, and I nearly gave up. When my mom found out, she started phoning every Sunday evening to teach me one dish, very patiently. She said, "Learning to cook is like anything else: if you're going to learn, learn it properly to the end." Three months later I could cook over a dozen dishes. At this year's checkup those numbers were much better. Now I bring a lunch I made myself to work every day, and my colleagues say my food looks better than a restaurant's and often ask how I make it. For me, cooking for myself hasn't just made me healthier; it has also given me and my mom lots more to talk about.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來很肯定他，現在看不起他
choices.simplified: 本来很肯定他，现在看不起他
choices.pinyin: Běnlái hěn kěndìng tā, xiànzài kànbùqǐ tā.
choices.english: They rated him; now they look down on him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來覺得他不好，現在很肯定他
choices.simplified: 本来觉得他不好，现在很肯定他
choices.pinyin: Běnlái juéde tā bù hǎo, xiànzài hěn kěndìng tā.
choices.english: They thought little of him; now they rate him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來看不起他，現在想去店裡打工
choices.simplified: 本来看不起他，现在想去店里打工
choices.pinyin: Běnlái kànbùqǐ tā, xiànzài xiǎng qù diàn lǐ dǎgōng.
choices.english: They looked down on him; now they want to work at his stall.

questions.why: The neighbours 看不起他 at first, and now they want their own kids to work for him, so they think highly of him. It is their kids, not the neighbours themselves, who would work at the stall. Being angry was the parents' reaction, not the neighbours', and the turn goes from bad to good, not the other way.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆要我下個月去日本，跟那邊的客人開會。
lines.simplified: 老板要我下个月去日本，跟那边的客人开会。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yào wǒ xià ge yuè qù Rìběn, gēn nàbiān de kèrén kāihuì.
lines.english: My boss wants me to go to Japan next month to meet our customers there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳才來公司半年，老闆就這麼看得起妳！
lines.simplified: 你才来公司半年，老板就这么看得起你！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ cái lái gōngsī bàn nián, lǎobǎn jiù zhème kàndeqǐ nǐ!
lines.english: You've only been at the company six months and the boss already thinks that highly of you!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我本來也很高興。後來才知道，會說日文的同事那幾天都請假了。
lines.simplified: 我本来也很高兴。后来才知道，会说日文的同事那几天都请假了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě hěn gāoxìng. Hòulái cái zhīdào, huì shuō Rìwén de tóngshì nà jǐ tiān dōu qǐngjià le.
lines.english: I was pleased too, at first. Then I found out that the colleagues who speak Japanese have all taken those days off.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那也沒關係啊。不管老闆為什麼選妳，妳好好表現，下次他就知道妳的能力了。
lines.simplified: 那也没关系啊。不管老板为什么选你，你好好表现，下次他就知道你的能力了。
lines.pinyin: Nà yě méi guānxi a. Bùguǎn lǎobǎn wèishénme xuǎn nǐ, nǐ hǎohǎo biǎoxiàn, xià cì tā jiù zhīdào nǐ de nénglì le.
lines.english: That doesn't matter. Whatever the reason he picked you, do a good job, and next time he'll know what you can do.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後那句話主要是想告訴女的什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后那句话主要是想告诉女的什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu nà jù huà zhǔyào shì xiǎng gàosu nǚ de shénme?
prompt.english: What is the man mainly telling the woman with his last words?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆選她，是因為看得起她的能力
choices.simplified: 老板选她，是因为看得起她的能力
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xuǎn tā, shì yīnwèi kàndeqǐ tā de nénglì.
choices.english: The boss chose her because he rates her ability.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先等同事回來，再一起去日本
choices.simplified: 先等同事回来，再一起去日本
choices.pinyin: Xiān děng tóngshì huílái, zài yìqǐ qù Rìběn.
choices.english: Wait for the colleagues to return and go together.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先把日文學好，下次再去日本
choices.simplified: 先把日文学好，下次再去日本
choices.pinyin: Xiān bǎ Rìwén xué hǎo, xià cì zài qù Rìběn.
choices.english: Learn Japanese properly first and go next time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這次做得好，老闆以後就會肯定她
choices.simplified: 这次做得好，老板以后就会肯定她
choices.pinyin: Zhè cì zuò de hǎo, lǎobǎn yǐhòu jiù huì kěndìng tā.
choices.english: If she does well this time, the boss will come to rate her.

questions.why: His last line turns this trip into a chance: whatever the reason, do well and the boss will know her ability next time. "He chose her because he rates her" was his first idea, which her news about the colleagues on leave undid, and 下次 is when the boss will know her, not when she should go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我爸爸一再說自己身體很好，怎麼樣都不肯去做健康檢查。
lines.simplified: 我爸爸一再说自己身体很好，怎么样都不肯去做健康检查。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yízài shuō zìjǐ shēntǐ hěn hǎo, zěnmeyàng dōu bù kěn qù zuò jiànkāng jiǎnchá.
lines.english: My dad kept saying he was perfectly healthy and wouldn't go for a checkup no matter what.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那他後來怎麼去了？
lines.simplified: 那他后来怎么去了？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā hòulái zěnme qù le?
lines.english: So how come he went in the end?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 直到上個月爬山的時候突然很不舒服，他才答應去。我媽媽說他只是太累了，我哥哥說是他平常吃得太鹹。
lines.simplified: 直到上个月爬山的时候突然很不舒服，他才答应去。我妈妈说他只是太累了，我哥哥说是他平常吃得太咸。
lines.pinyin: Zhídào shàng ge yuè páshān de shíhòu túrán hěn bù shūfú, tā cái dāyìng qù. Wǒ māma shuō tā zhǐshì tài lèi le, wǒ gēge shuō shì tā píngcháng chī de tài xián.
lines.english: Not until he suddenly felt very unwell hiking last month did he agree. My mum said he was just too tired; my brother said it's because he usually eats too salty.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那檢查的結果呢？
lines.simplified: 那检查的结果呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà jiǎnchá de jiéguǒ ne?
lines.english: And what did the checkup find?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 醫生說他沒什麼大毛病，只不過鹹的東西吃太多了，對身體很不好，以後得少吃。
lines.simplified: 医生说他没什么大毛病，只不过咸的东西吃太多了，对身体很不好，以后得少吃。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā méi shénme dà máobìng, zhǐbúguò xián de dōngxi chī tài duō le, duì shēntǐ hěn bù hǎo, yǐhòu děi shǎo chī.
lines.english: The doctor said there's nothing seriously wrong; it's just that he eats too much salty food, which is bad for him, and he has to cut down.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從檢查的結果看，哪一個說法是對的？
prompt.simplified: 从检查的结果看，哪一个说法是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng jiǎnchá de jiéguǒ kàn, nǎ yí ge shuōfǎ shì duì de?
prompt.english: Judging by the checkup, which view is right?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸的問題跟他的飲食有關
choices.simplified: 爸爸的问题跟他的饮食有关
choices.pinyin: Bàba de wèntí gēn tā de yǐnshí yǒuguān.
choices.english: Dad's trouble has to do with what he eats.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸的問題跟他太累有關
choices.simplified: 爸爸的问题跟他太累有关
choices.pinyin: Bàba de wèntí gēn tā tài lèi yǒuguān.
choices.english: Dad's trouble has to do with being too tired.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸的身體跟他說的一樣好
choices.simplified: 爸爸的身体跟他说的一样好
choices.pinyin: Bàba de shēntǐ gēn tā shuō de yíyàng hǎo.
choices.english: Dad is as healthy as he said.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸爸的問題跟他吃得太少有關
choices.simplified: 爸爸的问题跟他吃得太少有关
choices.pinyin: Bàba de wèntí gēn tā chī de tài shǎo yǒuguān.
choices.english: Dad's trouble has to do with eating too little.

questions.why: Three people explain why he fell ill; the doctor's 只不過 sentence backs the brother: too much salty food is what is hurting him. Too tired was the mother's guess, which the doctor does not back; the doctor says he eats too much salty food, not too little; and he is not as fit as he claimed, since he has to change how he eats.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是在學游泳嗎？怎麼才去了兩次就不去了？
lines.simplified: 你不是在学游泳吗？怎么才去了两次就不去了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì zài xué yóuyǒng ma? Zěnme cái qù le liǎng cì jiù bú qù le?
lines.english: Weren't you learning to swim? Why did you stop after just two lessons?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那個教練一直罵我，害我越來越怕水。
lines.simplified: 那个教练一直骂我，害我越来越怕水。
lines.pinyin: Nàge jiàoliàn yìzhí mà wǒ, hài wǒ yuè lái yuè pà shuǐ.
lines.english: The coach kept scolding me, and it made me more and more scared of the water.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 換一個教練試試看吧。既然開始學了，就學到底嘛。
lines.simplified: 换一个教练试试看吧。既然开始学了，就学到底嘛。
lines.pinyin: Huàn yí ge jiàoliàn shìshì kàn ba. Jìrán kāishǐ xué le, jiù xué dàodǐ ma.
lines.english: Try a different coach. Since you've started, see it through.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，下個月我換一個女教練。要是她也這樣，我就真的不學了。
lines.simplified: 好吧，下个月我换一个女教练。要是她也这样，我就真的不学了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, xià ge yuè wǒ huàn yí ge nǚ jiàoliàn. Yàoshì tā yě zhèyàng, wǒ jiù zhēn de bù xué le.
lines.english: All right, next month I'll switch to a woman coach. If she's the same, I really will quit.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的對繼續學游泳是什麼態度？
prompt.simplified: 女的对继续学游泳是什么态度？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de duì jìxù xué yóuyǒng shì shénme tàidù?
prompt.english: What is the woman's attitude to going on with swimming?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 願意再試，但要換一個男教練
choices.simplified: 愿意再试，但要换一个男教练
choices.pinyin: Yuànyì zài shì, dàn yào huàn yí ge nán jiàoliàn.
choices.english: Willing to try again, but with a male coach.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等自己不怕水了，才願意再學
choices.simplified: 等自己不怕水了，才愿意再学
choices.pinyin: Děng zìjǐ bú pà shuǐ le, cái yuànyì zài xué.
choices.english: She will learn again only once she isn't afraid of water.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 只有女教練教，她才肯繼續學
choices.simplified: 只有女教练教，她才肯继续学
choices.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǚ jiàoliàn jiāo, tā cái kěn jìxù xué.
choices.english: She will go on only if a woman teaches her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 願意再試，但要看新教練怎麼教
choices.simplified: 愿意再试，但要看新教练怎么教
choices.pinyin: Yuànyì zài shì, dàn yào kàn xīn jiàoliàn zěnme jiāo.
choices.english: Willing to try again, depending on how the new coach teaches.

questions.why: She agrees to try a new coach (好吧), but 要是她也這樣 she will quit: whether she goes on depends on how the coach treats her. She picks a 女教練, not a male one, and that choice is not her condition either, since a woman who scolds her too ends it.

focus.en: to cause (something bad); see it through

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我在網路上加入了一個語言交換的社團，這個星期六要辦第一次見面的活動。要不要一起去？
lines.simplified: 我在网路上加入了一个语言交换的社团，这个星期六要办第一次见面的活动。要不要一起去？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng jiārù le yí ge yǔyán jiāohuàn de shètuán, zhège xīngqíliù yào bàn dì yī cì jiànmiàn de huódòng. Yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
lines.english: I joined a language exchange group online, and this Saturday they're having their first meet-up. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊！要錢嗎？
lines.simplified: 好啊！要钱吗？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Yào qián ma?
lines.english: Sure! Does it cost anything?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一個人兩百塊，有點心和飲料。不過只有十八歲以上的人才能參加。
lines.simplified: 一个人两百块，有点心和饮料。不过只有十八岁以上的人才能参加。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge rén liǎngbǎi kuài, yǒu diǎnxīn hé yǐnliào. Búguò zhǐyǒu shíbā suì yǐshàng de rén cái néng cānjiā.
lines.english: Two hundred each, with snacks and drinks. But only people eighteen and over can come.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我上個月剛滿十八歲，沒問題。不過我星期六下午三點以前要打工。在哪裡見面？
lines.simplified: 我上个月刚满十八岁，没问题。不过我星期六下午三点以前要打工。在哪里见面？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge yuè gāng mǎn shíbā suì, méi wèntí. Búguò wǒ xīngqíliù xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐqián yào dǎgōng. Zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn?
lines.english: I just turned eighteen last month, so that's fine. But I work until three on Saturday afternoon. Where are you meeting?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 在學校附近的一家咖啡店。至於幾點開始，他們說星期四會在網站上通知。
lines.simplified: 在学校附近的一家咖啡店。至于几点开始，他们说星期四会在网站上通知。
lines.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā kāfēi diàn. Zhìyú jǐ diǎn kāishǐ, tāmen shuō xīngqísì huì zài wǎngzhàn shàng tōngzhī.
lines.english: It's at a café near school. As for what time it starts, they say they'll post it on the website on Thursday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 跟一群陌生人見面，我還是有點擔心。
lines.simplified: 跟一群陌生人见面，我还是有点担心。
lines.pinyin: Gēn yì qún mòshēng rén jiànmiàn, wǒ háishì yǒu diǎn dānxīn.
lines.english: Meeting a bunch of strangers still worries me a bit.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別擔心，店裡人很多。而且第一次見面，大家都不說自己住哪裡。
lines.simplified: 别担心，店里人很多。而且第一次见面，大家都不说自己住哪里。
lines.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, diàn lǐ rén hěn duō. Érqiě dì yī cì jiànmiàn, dàjiā dōu bù shuō zìjǐ zhù nǎlǐ.
lines.english: Don't worry, the café is full of people. And at a first meeting nobody says where they live.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣我就放心了。
lines.simplified: 这样我就放心了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.
lines.english: Then I'm not worried.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說了一個參加的條件，男的為什麼說沒問題？
prompt.simplified: 女的说了一个参加的条件，男的为什么说没问题？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō le yí ge cānjiā de tiáojiàn, nán de wèishénme shuō méi wèntí?
prompt.english: The woman mentions a condition for taking part. Why does the man say that's no problem?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經加入那個社團了
choices.simplified: 他已经加入那个社团了
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng jiārù nàge shètuán le.
choices.english: He has already joined the group.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de niánlíng gānghǎo gòu.
choices.english: He is just old enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng fù le liǎngbǎi kuài le.
choices.english: He has already paid the two hundred.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiù zhù zài kāfēi diàn fùjìn.
choices.english: He lives right by the café.

questions.why: 十八歲以上 includes eighteen itself, and he 剛滿十八歲, so the age rule is no problem for him (his work hours still are). It is the woman who joined the group, nobody has paid yet, and the café is near the school, not his home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的能不能去這次活動，還要看什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的能不能去这次活动，还要看什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de néng bù néng qù zhè cì huódòng, hái yào kàn shénme?
prompt.english: What does whether the man can go still depend on?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期四才知道的開始時間
choices.simplified: 星期四才知道的开始时间
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísì cái zhīdào de kāishǐ shíjiān.
choices.english: The start time, known only on Thursday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén yào fù duōshǎo qián.
choices.english: How much each person pays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kāfēi diàn lí xuéxiào yuǎn bù yuǎn.
choices.english: How far the café is from school.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de xīngqíliù yǒu méiyǒu kòng.
choices.english: Whether the woman is free on Saturday.

questions.why: He works until three on Saturday, and 至於幾點開始 leaves the time open until Thursday: only the start time can still rule him out. The price (兩百塊) and the place are already known, and it is the woman who invited him, so her Saturday is not in doubt.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的主要說了什麼，讓男的放心？
prompt.simplified: 女的主要说了什么，让男的放心？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zhǔyào shuō le shénme, ràng nán de fàngxīn?
prompt.english: What does the woman mainly say to put the man at ease?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她已經跟那些人見過面了
choices.simplified: 她已经跟那些人见过面了
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng gēn nàxiē rén jiàn guo miàn le.
choices.english: She has already met those people.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 只有十八歲以上的人能去
choices.simplified: 只有十八岁以上的人能去
choices.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shíbā suì yǐshàng de rén néng qù.
choices.english: Only people eighteen and over can go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在熱鬧的地方見，也不用給地址
choices.simplified: 在热闹的地方见，也不用给地址
choices.pinyin: Zài rènào de dìfāng jiàn, yě búyòng gěi dìzhǐ.
choices.english: They meet somewhere busy and give no address.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 活動時間會先在網站上通知
choices.simplified: 活动时间会先在网站上通知
choices.pinyin: Huódòng shíjiān huì xiān zài wǎngzhàn shàng tōngzhī.
choices.english: The time is announced online first.

questions.why: After his worry about strangers she gives two points: 店裡人很多 and nobody says where they live, so a busy place and no address. This is the group's first meet-up, so she has not met them, and the age rule and the Thursday post are facts about the event, not her answer to his worry.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 有個網友要賣他用過的筆電，只要三千塊。我想跟他買。
lines.simplified: 有个网友要卖他用过的笔电，只要三千块。我想跟他买。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu ge wǎngyǒu yào mài tā yòng guo de bǐdiàn, zhǐ yào sānqiān kuài. Wǒ xiǎng gēn tā mǎi.
lines.english: Someone online is selling his used laptop for just three thousand. I want to buy it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 三千塊？新的不是都要兩萬塊以上嗎？會不會是騙子？
lines.simplified: 三千块？新的不是都要两万块以上吗？会不会是骗子？
lines.pinyin: Sānqiān kuài? Xīn de bú shì dōu yào liǎngwàn kuài yǐshàng ma? Huì bú huì shì piànzi?
lines.english: Three thousand? Don't new ones cost twenty thousand or more? Could he be a scammer?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼想過。可是他說那台筆電已經用了五年，所以才賣得這麼便宜。
lines.simplified: 我也这么想过。可是他说那台笔电已经用了五年，所以才卖得这么便宜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng guo. Kěshì tā shuō nà tái bǐdiàn yǐjīng yòng le wǔ nián, suǒyǐ cái mài de zhème piányí.
lines.english: I wondered that too. But he says it's five years old, which is why it's so cheap.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你見過他本人嗎？
lines.simplified: 你见过他本人吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiàn guo tā běnrén ma?
lines.english: Have you met him in person?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還沒。他要我先付錢，他再把筆電寄過來。我本來打算今天晚上就付。
lines.simplified: 还没。他要我先付钱，他再把笔电寄过来。我本来打算今天晚上就付。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Tā yào wǒ xiān fù qián, tā zài bǎ bǐdiàn jì guòlái. Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn jīntiān wǎnshàng jiù fù.
lines.english: Not yet. He wants me to pay first, and then he'll post it to me. I was going to pay tonight.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣太危險了！最好當面看過東西，再把錢給他。
lines.simplified: 这样太危险了！最好当面看过东西，再把钱给他。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng tài wéixiǎn le! Zuìhǎo dāngmiàn kàn guo dōngxi, zài bǎ qián gěi tā.
lines.english: That's far too risky! Better to see it face to face first, then give him the money.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，我問他能不能約在捷運站見面。至於他肯不肯，我就不知道了。
lines.simplified: 好，我问他能不能约在捷运站见面。至于他肯不肯，我就不知道了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ wèn tā néng bù néng yuē zài jiéyùn zhàn jiànmiàn. Zhìyú tā kěn bù kěn, wǒ jiù bù zhīdào le.
lines.english: OK, I'll ask if we can meet at an MRT station. As for whether he'll agree, I don't know.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要是他不肯見面，你就別買了。
lines.simplified: 要是他不肯见面，你就别买了。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshì tā bù kěn jiànmiàn, nǐ jiù bié mǎi le.
lines.english: If he won't meet, don't buy it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的一開始為什麼覺得那個網友可能是騙子？
prompt.simplified: 女的一开始为什么觉得那个网友可能是骗子？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yì kāishǐ wèishénme juéde nàge wǎngyǒu kěnéng shì piànzi?
prompt.english: Why does the woman first suspect the seller is a scammer?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐdiàn bǐ xīn de piányí hěn duō.
choices.english: It is far cheaper than a new one.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào nán de xiān fù qián.
choices.english: He wants the man to pay first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐdiàn yǐjīng yòng le wǔ nián.
choices.english: The laptop is five years old.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù kěn gēn nán de jiànmiàn.
choices.english: He refuses to meet the man.

questions.why: Her first reaction sets 三千塊 against new ones at 兩萬塊以上: the price gap is what makes her ask 會不會是騙子. Paying first comes up only later, five years is the seller's own explanation, and nobody knows yet whether he will meet.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 跟女的談過以後，男的現在打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 跟女的谈过以后，男的现在打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Gēn nǚ de tán guo yǐhòu, nán de xiànzài dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: After talking with the woman, what does the man now plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 已經跟對方約好在捷運站見面
choices.simplified: 已经跟对方约好在捷运站见面
choices.pinyin: Yǐjīng gēn duìfāng yuē hǎo zài jiéyùn zhàn jiànmiàn.
choices.english: He has already fixed a meeting at the MRT station.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想先約對方見面，可是對方不肯
choices.simplified: 想先约对方见面，可是对方不肯
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng xiān yuē duìfāng jiànmiàn, kěshì duìfāng bù kěn.
choices.english: He wants to meet the seller first, but the seller refuses.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 還是今天晚上先把錢付給對方
choices.simplified: 还是今天晚上先把钱付给对方
choices.pinyin: Háishì jīntiān wǎnshàng xiān bǎ qián fù gěi duìfāng.
choices.english: He will still pay the seller tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想先約對方見面，可是還沒約好
choices.simplified: 想先约对方见面，可是还没约好
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng xiān yuē duìfāng jiànmiàn, kěshì hái méi yuē hǎo.
choices.english: He wants to meet the seller first, but nothing is fixed.

questions.why: He drops paying tonight and will ask to meet at the MRT station, but 至於他肯不肯，我就不知道了: nothing is agreed yet. "Already fixed" misses that 至於 line, and "the seller refuses" claims an answer he does not have yet (我就不知道了). The new-laptop price was only the woman's reason for doubt.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得怎麼買最合適？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得怎么买最合适？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zěnme mǎi zuì héshì?
prompt.english: What does the woman think is the best way to buy?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 見面的時候先付錢，再看筆電
choices.simplified: 见面的时候先付钱，再看笔电
choices.pinyin: Jiànmiàn de shíhòu xiān fù qián, zài kàn bǐdiàn.
choices.english: Pay on meeting, then look at the laptop.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 見面看過筆電，沒問題再付錢
choices.simplified: 见面看过笔电，没问题再付钱
choices.pinyin: Jiànmiàn kàn guo bǐdiàn, méi wèntí zài fù qián.
choices.english: Meet, check the laptop, then pay if it's fine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請他寄過來，收到以後再付
choices.simplified: 请他寄过来，收到以后再付
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tā jì guòlái, shōu dào yǐhòu zài fù.
choices.english: Have it posted and pay once it arrives.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請他傳照片，看過沒問題再付錢
choices.simplified: 请他传照片，看过没问题再付钱
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tā chuán zhàopiàn, kàn guo méi wèntí zài fù qián.
choices.english: Ask for photos, then pay if they look fine.

questions.why: Two of her lines combine: 當面看過東西，再把錢給他, and 要是他不肯見面，你就別買了. So meet, look, then pay. Paying on meeting gets the order wrong, and posting it or checking photos both skip the meeting: she says 當面, and no meeting means 別買了.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安。最近有不少人透過社群網站買演唱會的票，卻上了當。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安。最近有不少人透过社群网站买演唱会的票，却上了当。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān. Zuìjìn yǒu bù shǎo rén tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn mǎi yǎnchànghuì de piào, què shàng le dàng.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Lately quite a few people have bought concert tickets through social media and been tricked.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 騙子常常假裝是買了票、有事不能去的人，用比自己買的時候便宜的價錢賣票。等對方付了錢，就寄假的票給他。
lines.simplified: 骗子常常假装是买了票、有事不能去的人，用比自己买的时候便宜的价钱卖票。等对方付了钱，就寄假的票给他。
lines.pinyin: Piànzi chángcháng jiǎzhuāng shì mǎi le piào, yǒu shì bù néng qù de rén, yòng bǐ zìjǐ mǎi de shíhòu piányí de jiàqián mài piào. Děng duìfāng fù le qián, jiù jì jiǎ de piào gěi tā.
lines.english: Scammers often pretend to be someone who bought a ticket but can't go, and sell it for less than they paid. Once the buyer pays, they post a fake ticket.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月有一位大學生，花了五千塊買了兩張票，到了門口才發現票是假的。
lines.simplified: 上个月有一位大学生，花了五千块买了两张票，到了门口才发现票是假的。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yǒu yí wèi dàxuéshēng, huā le wǔqiān kuài mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào, dào le ménkǒu cái fāxiàn piào shì jiǎ de.
lines.english: Last month a university student paid five thousand for two tickets and only found out at the entrance that they were fake.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 警察說，大家買票的時候最好透過正式的賣票網站，別相信太便宜的票。
lines.simplified: 警察说，大家买票的时候最好透过正式的卖票网站，别相信太便宜的票。
lines.pinyin: Jǐngchá shuō, dàjiā mǎi piào de shíhòu zuìhǎo tòuguò zhèngshì de mài piào wǎngzhàn, bié xiāngxìn tài piányí de piào.
lines.english: The police say it is best to buy through official ticket websites and not to trust tickets that are too cheap.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，也有人把買到的票用貴很多的價錢賣出去。這雖然不算騙人，可是也對不起那些真正想去、卻買不到票的人。
lines.simplified: 还有，也有人把买到的票用贵很多的价钱卖出去。这虽然不算骗人，可是也对不起那些真正想去、却买不到票的人。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, yě yǒu rén bǎ mǎi dào de piào yòng guì hěn duō de jiàqián mài chūqù. Zhè suīrán bú suàn piàn rén, kěshì yě duìbùqǐ nàxiē zhēnzhèng xiǎng qù, què mǎi bú dào piào de rén.
lines.english: Also, some people resell the tickets they bought for much more. That may not count as cheating, but it lets down the people who really want to go and can't get tickets.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那位大學生最可能是怎麼買到假票的？
prompt.simplified: 那位大学生最可能是怎么买到假票的？
prompt.pinyin: Nà wèi dàxuéshēng zuì kěnéng shì zěnme mǎi dào jiǎ piào de?
prompt.english: How did the student most likely end up with fake tickets?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tòuguò zhèngshì de wǎngzhàn mǎi de.
choices.english: Through an official website.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在演唱會門口跟人買的
choices.simplified: 在演唱会门口跟人买的
choices.pinyin: Zài yǎnchànghuì ménkǒu gēn rén mǎi de.
choices.english: From someone at the concert entrance.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 用很貴的價錢跟別人買的
choices.simplified: 用很贵的价钱跟别人买的
choices.pinyin: Yòng hěn guì de jiàqián gēn biérén mǎi de.
choices.english: From someone, at a very high price.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在社群網站上跟陌生人買的
choices.simplified: 在社群网站上跟陌生人买的
choices.pinyin: Zài shèqún wǎngzhàn shàng gēn mòshēng rén mǎi de.
choices.english: From a stranger on social media.

questions.why: His case comes right after the scam is described: tickets 透過社群網站, sold cheap by a stranger who 假裝 he can't go. Official sites are what the police recommend, the entrance is where he found out, and very high prices belong to the resellers, who sell real tickets.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 騙子為什麼要說自己有事不能去？
prompt.simplified: 骗子为什么要说自己有事不能去？
prompt.pinyin: Piànzi wèishénme yào shuō zìjǐ yǒu shì bù néng qù?
prompt.english: Why do the scammers say something has come up so they can't go?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓人以為他是正式網站的人
choices.simplified: 让人以为他是正式网站的人
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén yǐwéi tā shì zhèngshì wǎngzhàn de rén.
choices.english: So people think he is from an official site.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén yǐwéi piào hái méi mài wán.
choices.english: So people think tickets haven't sold out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓他便宜賣票聽起來很合理
choices.simplified: 让他便宜卖票听起来很合理
choices.pinyin: Ràng tā piányí mài piào tīng qǐlái hěn hélǐ.
choices.english: So his selling cheap sounds reasonable.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓買不到票的人同情他
choices.simplified: 让买不到票的人同情他
choices.pinyin: Ràng mǎi bú dào piào de rén tóngqíng tā.
choices.english: So people without tickets feel sorry for him.

questions.why: Someone who bought a ticket and suddenly can't go has a reason to sell for less than he paid, so the cheap offer sounds reasonable instead of suspicious. He is selling a ticket he says is his own, which says nothing about tickets being left, and people who can't get tickets come up only with the resellers.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人覺得，賣假票的人跟把票賣得很貴的人有什麼不同？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人觉得，卖假票的人跟把票卖得很贵的人有什么不同？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén juéde, mài jiǎ piào de rén gēn bǎ piào mài de hěn guì de rén yǒu shénme bù tóng?
prompt.english: How does the speaker see the difference between people who sell fake tickets and people who sell tickets very dear?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一個騙錢，一個讓人很難買到票
choices.simplified: 一个骗钱，一个让人很难买到票
choices.pinyin: Yí ge piàn qián, yí ge ràng rén hěn nán mǎi dào piào.
choices.english: One cheats, the other makes tickets hard to get for real fans.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兩種都是騙人，一樣可惡
choices.simplified: 两种都是骗人，一样可恶
choices.pinyin: Liǎng zhǒng dōu shì piàn rén, yíyàng kěwù.
choices.english: Both are cheating and equally hateful.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一個票是假的，一個賣得比較便宜
choices.simplified: 一个票是假的，一个卖得比较便宜
choices.pinyin: Yí ge piào shì jiǎ de, yí ge mài de bǐjiào piányí.
choices.english: One ticket is fake; the other is sold cheaper.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一個騙學生，一個騙想去的人
choices.simplified: 一个骗学生，一个骗想去的人
choices.pinyin: Yí ge piàn xuéshēng, yí ge piàn xiǎng qù de rén.
choices.english: One cheats students; the other cheats fans.

questions.why: 雖然不算騙人，可是也對不起那些真正想去、卻買不到票的人: resellers do not cheat, but they let down real fans who can't get tickets. "Both cheating" misses 不算騙人, cheap is the scammers' price, not the resellers', and the student is just one scam victim.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a talk, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，我開了一家網路蛋糕店。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我开了一家网路蛋糕店。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ kāi le yì jiā wǎnglù dàngāo diàn.
lines.english: Hello everyone. I run an online cake shop.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 三年前，我還在銀行上班，週末常在家做蛋糕送朋友。
lines.simplified: 三年前，我还在银行上班，周末常在家做蛋糕送朋友。
lines.pinyin: Sān nián qián, wǒ hái zài yínháng shàngbān, zhōumò cháng zài jiā zuò dàngāo sòng péngyǒu.
lines.english: Three years ago I still worked at a bank, and at weekends I often baked cakes at home for friends.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 朋友把照片放上社群網站以後，很多陌生人傳訊息來，問我能不能買。
lines.simplified: 朋友把照片放上社群网站以后，很多陌生人传讯息来，问我能不能买。
lines.pinyin: Péngyǒu bǎ zhàopiàn fàng shàng shèqún wǎngzhàn yǐhòu, hěn duō mòshēng rén chuán xùnxī lái, wèn wǒ néng bù néng mǎi.
lines.english: After my friends put photos of them on social media, lots of strangers messaged me asking if they could buy one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 就這樣，我開始透過網站賣蛋糕，一年以後就不在銀行上班了。
lines.simplified: 就这样，我开始透过网站卖蛋糕，一年以后就不在银行上班了。
lines.pinyin: Jiù zhèyàng, wǒ kāishǐ tòuguò wǎngzhàn mài dàngāo, yì nián yǐhòu jiù bú zài yínháng shàngbān le.
lines.english: That's how I started selling cakes through a website, and a year later I left the bank.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 常有客人問我，為什麼我的蛋糕比別家貴一百塊。因為我只用最新鮮的水果，一天也只做二十個。
lines.simplified: 常有客人问我，为什么我的蛋糕比别家贵一百块。因为我只用最新鲜的水果，一天也只做二十个。
lines.pinyin: Cháng yǒu kèrén wèn wǒ, wèishénme wǒ de dàngāo bǐ bié jiā guì yìbǎi kuài. Yīnwèi wǒ zhǐ yòng zuì xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ, yì tiān yě zhǐ zuò èrshí ge.
lines.english: Customers often ask why my cakes cost a hundred more than other shops'. It's because I use only the freshest fruit, and I make only twenty a day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也有朋友要我一天多做一點，可是做太多，我就沒辦法每個都做得一樣好。

passage.traditional: 我的祖父母住在鄉下，以前我一年只回去看他們兩次。去年我教他們用手機，{1}網路，我們每個星期都能看到對方。祖母一下子就學會了，祖父剛開始卻{2}說手機太難用，不想學。後來他看到我傳的小狗影片，{3}學得比祖母還認真。現在他每天都傳訊息問候我，{4}是下雨的時候，一定叫我出門記得帶傘。不過，祖母說在手機上看得到我，{5}抱不到我，所以還是希望我放假多回家。至於祖父，他{6}不太在意，說每天看得到我的照片就夠了。
passage.simplified: 我的祖父母住在乡下，以前我一年只回去看他们两次。去年我教他们用手机，{1}网路，我们每个星期都能看到对方。祖母一下子就学会了，祖父刚开始却{2}说手机太难用，不想学。后来他看到我传的小狗影片，{3}学得比祖母还认真。现在他每天都传讯息问候我，{4}是下雨的时候，一定叫我出门记得带伞。不过，祖母说在手机上看得到我，{5}抱不到我，所以还是希望我放假多回家。至于祖父，他{6}不太在意，说每天看得到我的照片就够了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de zǔfùmǔ zhù zài xiāngxià, yǐqián wǒ yì nián zhǐ huíqù kàn tāmen liǎng cì. Qùnián wǒ jiāo tāmen yòng shǒujī, tòuguò wǎnglù, wǒmen měi ge xīngqí dōu néng kàn dào duìfāng. Zǔmǔ yíxiàzi jiù xué huì le, zǔfù gāng kāishǐ què yízài shuō shǒujī tài nán yòng, bù xiǎng xué. Hòulái tā kàn dào wǒ chuán de xiǎo gǒu yǐngpiàn, fǎn'ér xué de bǐ zǔmǔ hái rènzhēn. Xiànzài tā měi tiān dōu chuán xùnxī wènhòu wǒ, yóuqí shì xià yǔ de shíhòu, yídìng jiào wǒ chūmén jìde dài sǎn. Búguò, zǔmǔ shuō zài shǒujī shàng kàn de dào wǒ, què bào bú dào wǒ, suǒyǐ háishì xīwàng wǒ fàngjià duō huíjiā. Zhìyú zǔfù, tā dàoshì bú tài zàiyì, shuō měi tiān kàn de dào wǒ de zhàopiàn jiù gòu le.
passage.english: My grandparents live in the countryside, and I used to visit them only twice a year. Last year I taught them to use a phone, and through the internet we now see each other every week. Grandma learned in no time, but at first Grandpa kept saying phones were too hard and he didn't want to learn. Then he saw a video of a puppy I sent, and after that he actually studied harder than Grandma. Now he messages me every day to see how I am, and especially when it rains he always tells me to take an umbrella when I go out. Still, Grandma says she can see me on the phone but can't hug me, so she still hopes I'll come home more in the holidays. As for Grandpa, he doesn't mind much; he says seeing my photos every day is enough.

passage.traditional: 我妹妹十六歲，在網路上認識了一個網友。對方說自己是大學生，常傳浪漫的訊息給她。媽媽很擔心，說網路上有些人會{1}自己是大學生，其實年紀大很多。妹妹卻覺得我們{2}她，以為她什麼都不懂。她說她已經長大了，而且他們每天聊天，對方一點也不{3}。後來對方說他出了車禍，要跟她借五千塊。妹妹本來想借，可是他們{4}沒見過面，就先來問我。我們上網一查，發現他用同樣的方法騙過好幾個人，{5}他總是說很忙，不能見面。妹妹說她覺得很{6}媽媽，因為她以前一直說媽媽想太多。
passage.simplified: 我妹妹十六岁，在网路上认识了一个网友。对方说自己是大学生，常传浪漫的讯息给她。妈妈很担心，说网路上有些人会{1}自己是大学生，其实年纪大很多。妹妹却觉得我们{2}她，以为她什么都不懂。她说她已经长大了，而且他们每天聊天，对方一点也不{3}。后来对方说他出了车祸，要跟她借五千块。妹妹本来想借，可是他们{4}没见过面，就先来问我。我们上网一查，发现他用同样的方法骗过好几个人，{5}他总是说很忙，不能见面。妹妹说她觉得很{6}妈妈，因为她以前一直说妈妈想太多。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei shíliù suì, zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì le yí ge wǎngyǒu. Duìfāng shuō zìjǐ shì dàxuéshēng, cháng chuán làngmàn de xùnxī gěi tā. Māma hěn dānxīn, shuō wǎnglù shàng yǒuxiē rén huì jiǎzhuāng zìjǐ shì dàxuéshēng, qíshí niánjì dà hěn duō. Mèimei què juéde wǒmen kànbùqǐ tā, yǐwéi tā shénme dōu bù dǒng. Tā shuō tā yǐjīng zhǎng dà le, érqiě tāmen měi tiān liáotiān, duìfāng yìdiǎn yě bú mòshēng. Hòulái duìfāng shuō tā chū le chēhuò, yào gēn tā jiè wǔqiān kuài. Mèimei běnlái xiǎng jiè, kěshì tāmen bìjìng méi jiàn guo miàn, jiù xiān lái wèn wǒ. Wǒmen shàngwǎng yì chá, fāxiàn tā yòng tóngyàng de fāngfǎ piàn guo hǎojǐ ge rén, nánguài tā zǒngshì shuō hěn máng, bù néng jiànmiàn. Mèimei shuō tā juéde hěn duìbùqǐ māma, yīnwèi tā yǐqián yìzhí shuō māma xiǎng tài duō.
passage.english: My younger sister is sixteen. She got to know someone online. He said he was a university student and often sent her romantic messages. Mom was worried: she said some people online pretend to be university students when they are actually much older. But my sister felt we were looking down on her, thinking she understood nothing. She said she was grown up, and that they chatted every day, so he was no stranger at all. Later he said he had been in a car accident and asked to borrow five thousand. She was going to lend it, but they had never met after all, so she asked me first. We looked online and found that he had cheated several people the same way. No wonder he always said he was too busy to meet. My sister said she felt she had wronged Mom, because she had kept saying Mom worried too much.

text.traditional:
我祖母今年七十歲。祖父去世以後，她一個人住在鄉下，每天除了種花，就是看電視，很少出門。去年我幫她在社群網站上加入了一個種花的社團，本來只是想讓她看看別人種的花，沒想到她很快就交了不少網友。他們每天互相傳照片、問候對方，有時候一聊就是兩個小時。
我爸爸剛開始很不放心。他常在新聞上看到老人被網友騙錢，怕祖母也會上當。祖母卻說，她從來不在網路上說自己住在哪裡，也不跟網友談錢的事。上個月，這個社團在臺中辦了一個種花活動，六十五歲以上的人可以免費參加。祖母很想去，爸爸只好陪她一起去。
回來以後，爸爸的看法完全改變了。他說那些網友本人跟網路上一樣親切，有的還帶了自己種的花送給祖母。現在祖母每天都很開心，身體也比以前好。爸爸說，以前他總是忙著上班，很少打電話給祖母，覺得很對不起她。至於網路交友，他說在哪裡認識不重要，重要的是有沒有花時間了解對方。
text.simplified:
我祖母今年七十岁。祖父去世以后，她一个人住在乡下，每天除了种花，就是看电视，很少出门。去年我帮她在社群网站上加入了一个种花的社团，本来只是想让她看看别人种的花，没想到她很快就交了不少网友。他们每天互相传照片、问候对方，有时候一聊就是两个小时。
我爸爸刚开始很不放心。他常在新闻上看到老人被网友骗钱，怕祖母也会上当。祖母却说，她从来不在网路上说自己住在哪里，也不跟网友谈钱的事。上个月，这个社团在台中办了一个种花活动，六十五岁以上的人可以免费参加。祖母很想去，爸爸只好陪她一起去。
回来以后，爸爸的看法完全改变了。他说那些网友本人跟网路上一样亲切，有的还带了自己种的花送给祖母。现在祖母每天都很开心，身体也比以前好。爸爸说，以前他总是忙着上班，很少打电话给祖母，觉得很对不起她。至于网路交友，他说在哪里认识不重要，重要的是有没有花时间了解对方。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǔmǔ jīnnián qīshí suì. Zǔfù qùshì yǐhòu, tā yí ge rén zhù zài xiāngxià, měi tiān chúle zhòng huā, jiù shì kàn diànshì, hěn shǎo chūmén. Qùnián wǒ bāng tā zài shèqún wǎngzhàn shàng jiārù le yí ge zhòng huā de shètuán, běnlái zhǐ shì xiǎng ràng tā kànkàn biérén zhòng de huā, méixiǎngdào tā hěn kuài jiù jiāo le bù shǎo wǎngyǒu. Tāmen měi tiān hùxiāng chuán zhàopiàn, wènhòu duìfāng, yǒu shíhòu yì liáo jiù shì liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ bàba gāng kāishǐ hěn bú fàngxīn. Tā cháng zài xīnwén shàng kàn dào lǎorén bèi wǎngyǒu piàn qián, pà zǔmǔ yě huì shàngdàng. Zǔmǔ què shuō, tā cónglái bú zài wǎnglù shàng shuō zìjǐ zhù zài nǎlǐ, yě bù gēn wǎngyǒu tán qián de shì. Shàng ge yuè, zhège shètuán zài Táizhōng bàn le yí ge zhòng huā huódòng, liùshíwǔ suì yǐshàng de rén kěyǐ miǎnfèi cānjiā. Zǔmǔ hěn xiǎng qù, bàba zhǐhǎo péi tā yìqǐ qù. Huílái yǐhòu, bàba de kànfǎ wánquán gǎibiàn le. Tā shuō nàxiē wǎngyǒu běnrén gēn wǎnglù shàng yíyàng qīnqiè, yǒu de hái dài le zìjǐ zhòng de huā sòng gěi zǔmǔ. Xiànzài zǔmǔ měi tiān dōu hěn kāixīn, shēntǐ yě bǐ yǐqián hǎo. Bàba shuō, yǐqián tā zǒngshì máng zhe shàngbān, hěn shǎo dǎ diànhuà gěi zǔmǔ, juéde hěn duìbùqǐ tā. Zhìyú wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, tā shuō zài nǎlǐ rènshì bú zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì yǒu méiyǒu huā shíjiān liǎojiě duìfāng.
text.english:
My grandmother is seventy. Since my grandfather died she has lived alone in the countryside; apart from growing flowers she just watched TV and rarely went out. Last year I helped her join a flower-growing group on social media. I only meant for her to look at other people's flowers, but she quickly made quite a few friends there. They swap photos every day and ask after each other, and sometimes they chat for two hours at a time.
At first my dad wasn't at ease about it. He often saw news about old people being cheated of money by people they met online, and he feared she'd be tricked too. But Grandma said she never says online where she lives and never talks about money with them. Last month the group held a flower event in Taichung, free for anyone sixty-five or over. Grandma really wanted to go, so Dad had no choice but to go with her.
When they came back, Dad's view had changed completely. He said those friends were as warm in person as online, and some even brought flowers they had grown as gifts for Grandma. Now she's happy every day and healthier than before. Dad says he was always busy with work and seldom phoned her, and he feels he let her down. As for making friends online, he says where you meet doesn't matter; what matters is whether you take the time to understand the other person.
