choices.traditional: 晚上關窗戶，開冷氣睡覺
choices.simplified: 晚上关窗户，开冷气睡觉
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng guān chuānghù, kāi lěngqì shuìjiào.
choices.english: She shuts the windows and sleeps with the air conditioner on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下個月換到同一棟的樓上
choices.simplified: 下个月换到同一栋的楼上
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè huàn dào tóng yí dòng de lóushàng.
choices.english: Next month she moves upstairs in the same building.

questions.why: She likes the flat and finds the landlord 好得沒話說, so when the man says she must move again, she answers with the landlord's offer: a quieter room upstairs next month, kept for her. Moving elsewhere is HIS idea, and "fixed the same day" was the air conditioner, not the noise.

focus.zh: Vs 得沒話說；兩句合起來
focus.en: couldn't be better; combining two turns

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天的報告差一點就交不出去了。
lines.simplified: 我昨天的报告差一点就交不出去了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān de bàogào chà yìdiǎn jiù jiāo bù chūqù le.
lines.english: Yesterday I very nearly couldn't hand in my report.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 怎麼了？妳不是早就寫好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 怎么了？你不是早就写好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme le? Nǐ bú shì zǎo jiù xiě hǎo le ma?
lines.english: What happened? Hadn't you finished it long ago?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要交的前一個小時，電腦突然開不了機了。
lines.simplified: 要交的前一个小时，电脑突然开不了机了。
lines.pinyin: Yào jiāo de qián yí ge xiǎoshí, diànnǎo tūrán kāi bù liǎo jī le.
lines.english: An hour before it was due, my computer suddenly wouldn't turn on.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: So what did you do?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 幸虧上星期寫好的部分放在雲端，要不然得全部重寫。不過最後三頁是這兩天寫的，只好再寫一次。
lines.simplified: 幸亏上星期写好的部分放在云端，要不然得全部重写。不过最后三页是这两天写的，只好再写一次。
lines.pinyin: Xìngkuī shàng xīngqí xiě hǎo de bùfèn fàng zài yúnduān, yàobùrán děi quánbù chóng xiě. Búguò zuìhòu sān yè shì zhè liǎng tiān xiě de, zhǐhǎo zài xiě yí cì.
lines.english: Luckily the part I finished last week was in the cloud, otherwise I'd have had to rewrite everything. But the last three pages were written in the past two days, so I had to write them again.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這下子妳知道自動上傳有多重要了吧。
lines.simplified: 这下子你知道自动上传有多重要了吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhè xiàzi nǐ zhīdào zìdòng shàngchuán yǒu duō zhòngyào le ba.
lines.english: Now you see how important automatic uploading is.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。以前我總是覺得寫完再上傳就好。
lines.simplified: 对啊。以前我总是觉得写完再上传就好。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Yǐqián wǒ zǒngshì juéde xiě wán zài shàngchuán jiù hǎo.
lines.english: Yes. I used to think uploading once I'd finished was enough.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這件事讓女的有什麼新的想法？
prompt.simplified: 这件事让女的有什么新的想法？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng nǚ de yǒu shénme xīn de xiǎngfǎ?
prompt.english: What new view has this given the woman?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 報告寫完以後再上傳就好
choices.simplified: 报告写完以后再上传就好
choices.pinyin: Bàogào xiě wán yǐhòu zài shàngchuán jiù hǎo.
choices.english: Uploading the report after finishing it is enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 雲端也不安全，得自己再存一份
choices.simplified: 云端也不安全，得自己再存一份
choices.pinyin: Yúnduān yě bù ānquán, děi zìjǐ zài cún yí fèn.
choices.english: The cloud isn't safe either; she must keep her own copy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 報告應該一邊寫一邊自動上傳
choices.simplified: 报告应该一边写一边自动上传
choices.pinyin: Bàogào yīnggāi yìbiān xiě yìbiān zìdòng shàngchuán.
choices.english: A report should upload by itself while she writes it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 報告應該每星期上傳一次
choices.simplified: 报告应该每星期上传一次
choices.pinyin: Bàogào yīnggāi měi xīngqí shàngchuán yí cì.
choices.english: A report should be uploaded once a week.

questions.why: The cloud saved what was in it (幸虧…要不然…); she lost only the pages written since her last upload. So 這下子 and 對啊 mean she now sees the point of uploading automatically. Her last upload was a week old (上星期寫好的部分) and she still lost three pages, so once a week is exactly what failed her; "upload when finished" is her OLD view (以前我總覺得), and the cloud itself did not fail.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 週末去爬那座高山好不好？聽說山上的風景美極了。
lines.simplified: 周末去爬那座高山好不好？听说山上的风景美极了。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò qù pá nà zuò gāo shān hǎo bù hǎo? Tīngshuō shān shàng de fēngjǐng měi jí le.
lines.english: Shall we climb that high mountain this weekend? I hear the view at the top is stunning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我連學校後面的小山都爬不上去，更別說那麼高的山了。
lines.simplified: 我连学校后面的小山都爬不上去，更别说那么高的山了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lián xuéxiào hòumiàn de xiǎo shān dōu pá bú shàngqù, gèng bié shuō nàme gāo de shān le.
lines.english: I can't even get up the little hill behind the school, let alone a mountain that high.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們先從小山開始練，每個星期爬兩次，一個月以後再去。
lines.simplified: 那我们先从小山开始练，每个星期爬两次，一个月以后再去。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān cóng xiǎo shān kāishǐ liàn, měi ge xīngqí pá liǎng cì, yí ge yuè yǐhòu zài qù.
lines.english: Then let's start by training on the hill, twice a week, and go in a month.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧。可是我晚上要打工，只有早上有空。
lines.simplified: 好吧。可是我晚上要打工，只有早上有空。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Kěshì wǒ wǎnshàng yào dǎgōng, zhǐyǒu zǎoshàng yǒu kòng.
lines.english: All right. But I work in the evenings; I'm only free in the mornings.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我星期一到星期五早上都有課，只有星期二和星期四沒有。
lines.simplified: 我星期一到星期五早上都有课，只有星期二和星期四没有。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xīngqíyī dào xīngqíwǔ zǎoshàng dōu yǒu kè, zhǐyǒu xīngqí'èr hé xīngqísì méiyǒu.
lines.english: I have class every weekday morning except Tuesday and Thursday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就那兩天吧。
lines.simplified: 那就那两天吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù nà liǎng tiān ba.
lines.english: Those two days, then.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是下星期四早上，我得帶我媽去看醫生。
lines.simplified: 可是下星期四早上，我得带我妈去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì xià xīngqísì zǎoshàng, wǒ děi dài wǒ mā qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: But next Thursday morning I have to take my mom to the doctor.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那下星期四就改到星期六早上吧。妳得先打電話叫我起床。
lines.simplified: 那下星期四就改到星期六早上吧。你得先打电话叫我起床。
lines.pinyin: Nà xià xīngqísì jiù gǎi dào xīngqíliù zǎoshàng ba. Nǐ děi xiān dǎ diànhuà jiào wǒ qǐchuáng.
lines.english: Then move next Thursday to Saturday morning. You'll have to phone and wake me up first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下個星期，他們會在哪兩天去爬小山？
prompt.simplified: 下个星期，他们会在哪两天去爬小山？
prompt.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí, tāmen huì zài nǎ liǎng tiān qù pá xiǎo shān?
prompt.english: On which two days next week will they climb the hill?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr hé xīngqísì zǎoshàng
choices.english: Tuesday and Thursday mornings

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr hé xīngqíliù zǎoshàng
choices.english: Tuesday and Saturday mornings

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísì hé xīngqíliù zǎoshàng
choices.english: Thursday and Saturday mornings

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr hé xīngqísì wǎnshàng
choices.english: Tuesday and Thursday evenings

questions.why: He is free only in the mornings (晚上要打工) and she only on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, so the usual days are those two; but next Thursday she takes her mother to the doctor, so that day moves to Saturday. Tuesday and Thursday is the usual plan before the change, Thursday and Saturday drops the wrong day, and the evenings are when he works.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下星期要交的報告，主題是我們城市的古蹟。你決定寫哪裡了嗎？
lines.simplified: 下星期要交的报告，主题是我们城市的古迹。你决定写哪里了吗？
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqí yào jiāo de bàogào, zhǔtí shì wǒmen chéngshì de gǔjī. Nǐ juédìng xiě nǎlǐ le ma?
lines.english: The report due next week is on our city's historic sites. Have you decided which one to write about?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來想寫火車站旁邊那棟老房子，可是那裡從上個月開始在修，不開放了。
lines.simplified: 我本来想写火车站旁边那栋老房子，可是那里从上个月开始在修，不开放了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng xiě huǒchē zhàn pángbiān nà dòng lǎo fángzi, kěshì nàlǐ cóng shàng ge yuè kāishǐ zài xiū, bù kāifàng le.
lines.english: I meant to write about the old house next to the train station, but it has been under repair since last month and is closed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那河邊那座廟呢？聽說牆上的圖畫十分生動。
lines.simplified: 那河边那座庙呢？听说墙上的图画十分生动。
lines.pinyin: Nà hébiān nà zuò miào ne? Tīngshuō qiáng shàng de túhuà shífēn shēngdòng.
lines.english: What about the temple by the river? I hear the pictures on its walls are very vivid.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 已經有三組要寫那裡了，老師希望我們別寫一樣的。
lines.simplified: 已经有三组要写那里了，老师希望我们别写一样的。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng yǒu sān zǔ yào xiě nàlǐ le, lǎoshī xīwàng wǒmen bié xiě yíyàng de.
lines.english: Three groups are already writing about it, and the teacher would rather we didn't all write the same.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你打算怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那你打算怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme bàn?
lines.english: So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想先去問問我爺爺。他從小住在這裡，知道不少以前的故事。
lines.simplified: 我想先去问问我爷爷。他从小住在这里，知道不少以前的故事。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān qù wèn wen wǒ yéye. Tā cóngxiǎo zhù zài zhèlǐ, zhīdào bù shǎo yǐqián de gùshì.
lines.english: I want to ask my grandfather first. He's lived here since he was little and knows lots of old stories.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好主意。老人家口中的歷史，書上不一定有。
lines.simplified: 好主意。老人家口中的历史，书上不一定有。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì. Lǎorénjiā kǒu zhōng de lìshǐ, shū shàng bù yídìng yǒu.
lines.english: Good idea. The history old people tell isn't always in books.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。總之，這個週末我一定要把地方決定好。
lines.simplified: 对啊。总之，这个周末我一定要把地方决定好。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Zǒngzhī, zhège zhōumò wǒ yídìng yào bǎ dìfāng juédìng hǎo.
lines.english: Right. Anyway, this weekend I have to settle on the place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼建議寫河邊的廟？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么建议写河边的庙？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme jiànyì xiě hébiān de miào?
prompt.english: Why does the woman suggest the temple by the river?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā qù kàn guo, juéde huà hěn měi.
choices.english: She has been and found the pictures beautiful.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師說牆上的圖畫值得寫
choices.simplified: 老师说墙上的图画值得写
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō qiáng shàng de túhuà zhídé xiě.
choices.english: The teacher said the wall pictures are worth writing about.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有人跟她說廟剛剛修好
choices.simplified: 有人跟她说庙刚刚修好
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén gēn tā shuō miào gānggāng xiū hǎo.
choices.english: Someone told her the temple has just been repaired.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有人跟她說牆上很值得看
choices.simplified: 有人跟她说墙上很值得看
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén gēn tā shuō qiáng shàng hěn zhídé kàn.
choices.english: Someone told her the walls are well worth seeing.

questions.why: 聽說牆上的圖畫十分生動 means other people told her the wall pictures are worth seeing; she has not been herself, so "she has been" misses 聽說. What she heard is about the pictures, not repairs: the repairs belong to the house by the station, which is still closed. The teacher said nothing about the pictures, only asked groups NOT to write the same place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得問爺爺有什麼好處？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得问爷爷有什么好处？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde wèn yéye yǒu shénme hǎochù?
prompt.english: What does the woman think is good about asking his grandfather?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 能聽到書裡找不到的歷史
choices.simplified: 能听到书里找不到的历史
choices.pinyin: Néng tīng dào shū lǐ zhǎo bú dào de lìshǐ.
choices.english: He can hear history that books don't have.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爺爺能帶他去看那棟房子
choices.simplified: 爷爷能带他去看那栋房子
choices.pinyin: Yéye néng dài tā qù kàn nà dòng fángzi.
choices.english: His grandfather can take him to see the house.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 能聽到書上已經寫過的歷史
choices.simplified: 能听到书上已经写过的历史
choices.pinyin: Néng tīng dào shū shàng yǐjīng xiě guo de lìshǐ.
choices.english: He can hear history that is already in books.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yéye kàn guo hěn duō lìshǐ shū.
choices.english: His grandfather has read many history books.

questions.why: His grandfather knows 不少以前的故事, and she adds 老人家口中的歷史，書上不一定有: what he tells may not be in any book. "History already in books" turns her point around (書上不一定有); the house is closed for repairs; and books are what she contrasts him with, not what he has read.

focus.zh: 說話人的看法；兩句合起來
focus.en: a speaker's view; combining two turns

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的這個週末要選的地方，得是什麼樣的？
prompt.simplified: 男的这个周末要选的地方，得是什么样的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zhège zhōumò yào xuǎn de dìfāng, děi shì shénme yàng de?
prompt.english: What kind of place must the man choose this weekend?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qiáng shàng yǒu shēngdòng túhuà de miào.
choices.english: A temple with vivid pictures on its walls.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 現在能進去、別組沒寫的
choices.simplified: 现在能进去、别组没写的
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài néng jìnqù, bié zǔ méi xiě de.
choices.english: One that is open now and that no other group has.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爺爺從小住過的老房子
choices.simplified: 爷爷从小住过的老房子
choices.pinyin: Yéye cóngxiǎo zhù guo de lǎo fángzi.
choices.english: The old house his grandfather grew up in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiū hǎo yǐhòu cái kāifàng de.
choices.english: One that opens only once its repairs are done.

questions.why: Two places failed for two reasons: the house is closed (不開放了) and the temple is taken (老師希望我們別寫一樣的), and 總之 he must choose by this weekend. So he needs a site open now that nobody else has. The temple is the one already taken, and a site still under repair cannot be visited in time.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我爸媽下星期從美國來看我，我想帶他們去淡水玩一天，妳覺得怎麼安排好？
lines.simplified: 我爸妈下星期从美国来看我，我想带他们去淡水玩一天，你觉得怎么安排好？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bà mā xià xīngqí cóng Měiguó lái kàn wǒ, wǒ xiǎng dài tāmen qù Dànshuǐ wán yì tiān, nǐ juéde zěnme ānpái hǎo?
lines.english: My parents are coming from America next week. I want to take them to Tamsui for a day. How do you think I should plan it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 早上先去紅毛城。那裡下午人很多，早上去比較好照相。
lines.simplified: 早上先去红毛城。那里下午人很多，早上去比较好照相。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshàng xiān qù Hóngmáochéng. Nàlǐ xiàwǔ rén hěn duō, zǎoshàng qù bǐjiào hǎo zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: Go to Fort San Domingo first, in the morning. It's crowded in the afternoon; it's easier to take photos in the morning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我爸喜歡看古蹟，我媽只想逛街、買東西。
lines.simplified: 可是我爸喜欢看古迹，我妈只想逛街、买东西。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bà xǐhuān kàn gǔjī, wǒ mā zhǐ xiǎng guàngjiē, mǎi dōngxi.
lines.english: But my dad likes historic sites and my mom only wants to shop.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 紅毛城旁邊就是老街。你爸參觀古蹟的同時，你媽可以去那裡逛逛，中午再一起吃飯。
lines.simplified: 红毛城旁边就是老街。你爸参观古迹的同时，你妈可以去那里逛逛，中午再一起吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Hóngmáochéng pángbiān jiù shì lǎo jiē. Nǐ bà cānguān gǔjī de tóngshí, nǐ mā kěyǐ qù nàlǐ guàng guang, zhōngwǔ zài yìqǐ chīfàn.
lines.english: The old street is right next to the fort. While your dad tours the site, your mom can look round there, and you all have lunch together at noon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那吃完午餐以後呢？
lines.simplified: 那吃完午餐以后呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà chī wán wǔcān yǐhòu ne?
lines.english: And after lunch?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 慢慢走到碼頭等著看夕陽，美得沒話說。不過週末那裡人擠人，最好平日去。
lines.simplified: 慢慢走到码头等着看夕阳，美得没话说。不过周末那里人挤人，最好平日去。
lines.pinyin: Mànman zǒu dào mǎtóu děng zhe kàn xīyáng, měi de méi huà shuō. Búguò zhōumò nàlǐ rén jǐ rén, zuìhǎo píngrì qù.
lines.english: Stroll down to the pier and wait for the sunset; it's beautiful beyond words. But at weekends it's packed, so go on a weekday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他們星期三晚上才到，星期五早上就要去臺南，星期天才回來。
lines.simplified: 他们星期三晚上才到，星期五早上就要去台南，星期天才回来。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen xīngqísān wǎnshàng cái dào, xīngqíwǔ zǎoshàng jiù yào qù Táinán, xīngqítiān cái huílái.
lines.english: They only arrive on Wednesday evening, leave for Tainan on Friday morning, and won't be back until Sunday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議，男的媽媽早上可以做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议，男的妈妈早上可以做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì, nán de māma zǎoshàng kěyǐ zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman suggest the man's mother can do in the morning?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟爸爸一起在紅毛城照相
choices.simplified: 跟爸爸一起在红毛城照相
choices.pinyin: Gēn bàba yìqǐ zài Hóngmáochéng zhàoxiàng.
choices.english: Taking photos in the fort with his father.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一個人先去碼頭等夕陽
choices.simplified: 一个人先去码头等夕阳
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén xiān qù mǎtóu děng xīyáng.
choices.english: Going ahead alone to wait for the sunset at the pier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在紅毛城旁的老街逛街
choices.simplified: 在红毛城旁的老街逛街
choices.pinyin: Zài Hóngmáochéng páng de lǎo jiē guàngjiē.
choices.english: Shopping on the old street beside the fort.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiàwǔ rén shǎo le zài qù guàngjiē.
choices.english: Shopping in the afternoon, once it is quieter.

questions.why: The morning is the fort, and 你爸參觀古蹟的同時，你媽可以去那裡逛逛 puts the mother on the old street next door at the same time. Missing 同時 gives "with his father in the fort"; it is the fort, not the street, that gets crowded in the afternoon.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說到紅毛城和碼頭的時候，都要男的注意什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说到红毛城和码头的时候，都要男的注意什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō dào Hóngmáochéng hé mǎtóu de shíhòu, dōu yào nán de zhùyì shénme?
prompt.english: When the woman talks about the fort and about the pier, what does she tell the man to watch out for both times?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zǎo yìdiǎn qù bǐjiào hǎo zhàoxiàng.
choices.english: Go early; photos are easier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuǎn xīyáng zuì měi de shíhòu qù.
choices.english: Pick the time when the sunset is prettiest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 選週末大家有空的時候去
choices.simplified: 选周末大家有空的时候去
choices.pinyin: Xuǎn zhōumò dàjiā yǒu kòng de shíhòu qù.
choices.english: Pick a weekend, when everyone is free.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuǎn rén bǐjiào shǎo de shíhòu qù.
choices.english: Pick a time when there are fewer people.

questions.why: Both warnings are about crowds: the fort 下午人很多, so go in the morning, and the pier 週末人擠人, so go on a weekday. Early photos is only the fort's reason, the sunset belongs only to the pier (and she says it is beautiful anyway), and the weekend is exactly when she says the pier is packed.

focus.zh: 兩句合起來；說話人的意思
focus.en: combining two turns; what the speaker means

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最可能哪一天帶爸媽去淡水？
prompt.simplified: 男的最可能哪一天带爸妈去淡水？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuì kěnéng nǎ yì tiān dài bà mā qù Dànshuǐ?
prompt.english: Which day is the man most likely to take his parents to Tamsui?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísì
choices.english: Thursday

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān
choices.english: Wednesday

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ
choices.english: Friday

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù
choices.english: Saturday

questions.why: She says go on a weekday (週末那裡人擠人); they land on Wednesday evening, too late for a day out, and leave early Friday for Tainan until Sunday. That leaves Thursday. Saturday is both a weekend and a Tainan day.

focus.zh: Vs 得沒話說；兩句合起來看
focus.en: couldn't be better; combining two turns

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位遊客大家好，歡迎來到這座三百多年前蓋的古城。
lines.simplified: 各位游客大家好，欢迎来到这座三百多年前盖的古城。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi yóukè dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng lái dào zhè zuò sān bǎi duō nián qián gài de gǔchéng.
lines.english: Good day, visitors, and welcome to this fort, built over three hundred years ago.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 城裡的地下隧道修了兩年，從今天起重新開放。
lines.simplified: 城里的地下隧道修了两年，从今天起重新开放。
lines.pinyin: Chéng lǐ de dìxià suìdào xiū le liǎng nián, cóng jīntiān qǐ chóngxīn kāifàng.
lines.english: The underground tunnel inside the fort has been under repair for two years and reopens from today.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 每天上午十點及下午三點，有工作人員免費帶大家參觀，請在開始前十分鐘到隧道門口集合。
lines.simplified: 每天上午十点及下午三点，有工作人员免费带大家参观，请在开始前十分钟到隧道门口集合。
lines.pinyin: Měi tiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn jí xiàwǔ sān diǎn, yǒu gōngzuò rényuán miǎnfèi dài dàjiā cānguān, qǐng zài kāishǐ qián shí fēnzhōng dào suìdào ménkǒu jíhé.
lines.english: Every day at 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. a member of staff leads a free tour; please gather at the tunnel entrance ten minutes before it starts.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 隧道裡又暗又小，十二歲以下的兒童及七十歲以上的老人，必須有家人陪著才能進去。
lines.simplified: 隧道里又暗又小，十二岁以下的儿童及七十岁以上的老人，必须有家人陪着才能进去。
lines.pinyin: Suìdào lǐ yòu àn yòu xiǎo, shí'èr suì yǐxià de értóng jí qīshí suì yǐshàng de lǎorén, bìxū yǒu jiārén péi zhe cái néng jìnqù.
lines.english: The tunnel is dark and narrow. Children under twelve and elderly people over seventy must be accompanied by family.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為了保護古蹟，隧道裡不可以照相，同時也請不要用手碰牆上的文字。
lines.simplified: 为了保护古迹，隧道里不可以照相，同时也请不要用手碰墙上的文字。
lines.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù gǔjī, suìdào lǐ bù kěyǐ zhàoxiàng, tóngshí yě qǐng bú yào yòng shǒu pèng qiáng shàng de wénzì.
lines.english: To protect the site, no photos in the tunnel, and please also do not touch the writing on the walls.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 參觀完以後，可以到旁邊的廣場休息，那裡每天下午四點有藝術表演。謝謝大家。
lines.simplified: 参观完以后，可以到旁边的广场休息，那里每天下午四点有艺术表演。谢谢大家。
lines.pinyin: Cānguān wán yǐhòu, kěyǐ dào pángbiān de guǎngchǎng xiūxí, nàlǐ měi tiān xiàwǔ sì diǎn yǒu yìshù biǎoyǎn. Xièxie dàjiā.
lines.english: After your visit you can rest in the square next door, where there is an arts performance at 4 p.m. every day. Thank you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位遊客想下午跟著工作人員參觀隧道，他應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位游客想下午跟着工作人员参观隧道，他应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi yóukè xiǎng xiàwǔ gēn zhe gōngzuò rényuán cānguān suìdào, tā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A visitor wants to tour the tunnel with the staff in the afternoon. What should he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng diǎn wǔshí dào guǎngchǎng jíhé.
choices.english: Gather in the square at 2:50.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng diǎn wǔshí dào suìdào ménkǒu.
choices.english: Be at the tunnel entrance at 2:50.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān diǎn wǔshí dào suìdào ménkǒu.
choices.english: Be at the tunnel entrance at 3:50.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān diǎn zhěng dào suìdào ménkǒu.
choices.english: Be at the tunnel entrance at 3:00 sharp.

questions.why: The afternoon tour is the second time in 上午十點及下午三點, and visitors gather ten minutes earlier at the tunnel entrance: 2:50. The square is for resting afterwards, 3:50 mixes the tour up with the 4:00 show, and 3:00 forgets the ten minutes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一位遊客得改變他的安排？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一位游客得改变他的安排？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí wèi yóukè děi gǎibiàn tā de ānpái?
prompt.english: Which of these visitors has to change their plan?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在廣場上幫表演的人照相
choices.simplified: 在广场上帮表演的人照相
choices.pinyin: Zài guǎngchǎng shàng bāng biǎoyǎn de rén zhàoxiàng.
choices.english: Taking photos of the performers in the square.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 十歲的孩子跟爸爸一起進去
choices.simplified: 十岁的孩子跟爸爸一起进去
choices.pinyin: Shí suì de háizi gēn bàba yìqǐ jìnqù.
choices.english: A 10-year-old going in with his father.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 七十二歲的爺爺跟朋友進去
choices.simplified: 七十二岁的爷爷跟朋友进去
choices.pinyin: Qīshí'èr suì de yéye gēn péngyǒu jìnqù.
choices.english: A 72-year-old man going in with a friend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 參觀完去廣場看四點的表演
choices.simplified: 参观完去广场看四点的表演
choices.pinyin: Cānguān wán qù guǎngchǎng kàn sì diǎn de biǎoyǎn.
choices.english: Watching the 4:00 show in the square after the visit.

questions.why: 兒童及七十歲以上的老人 both need FAMILY with them (家人陪著), so a 72-year-old with a friend must change his plan. The photo ban is only inside the tunnel, a child with his father is fine, and the 4:00 show is open to all.

focus.zh: 及；規定用在一個人身上
focus.en: and (formal); applying a rule to one person

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是在告訴遊客什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是在告诉游客什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào shì zài gàosu yóukè shénme?
prompt.english: What is this announcement mainly telling visitors?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 古城三百多年來的歷史
choices.simplified: 古城三百多年来的历史
choices.pinyin: Gǔchéng sān bǎi duō nián lái de lìshǐ.
choices.english: The fort's three-hundred-year history.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 廣場表演和休息的地方
choices.simplified: 广场表演和休息的地方
choices.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng biǎoyǎn hé xiūxí de dìfāng.
choices.english: The square's show and where to rest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 隧道暫時不開放和修理的方法
choices.simplified: 隧道暂时不开放和修理的方法
choices.pinyin: Suìdào zànshí bù kāifàng hé xiūlǐ de fāngfǎ.
choices.english: The tunnel being closed for now and how it is repaired.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 隧道重新開放和參觀的方法
choices.simplified: 隧道重新开放和参观的方法
choices.pinyin: Suìdào chóngxīn kāifàng hé cānguān de fāngfǎ.
choices.english: The tunnel's reopening and how to visit it.

questions.why: 重新開放 is the news, and the tour times, the family rule and the photo rule (同時 no touching) all tell visitors how to go in. The tunnel is not closing: its two years of repair are over (修了兩年，從今天起重新開放), and nothing is said about how it was repaired. The fort's age is only the welcome, and the square is a last extra for after the visit.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voicemail, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 張先生您好，我是明天帶大家去參觀古蹟的導遊。
lines.simplified: 张先生您好，我是明天带大家去参观古迹的导游。
lines.pinyin: Zhāng xiānshēng nín hǎo, wǒ shì míngtiān dài dàjiā qù cānguān gǔjī de dǎoyóu.
lines.english: Hello, Mr. Zhang. I'm the guide taking your group to the historic sites tomorrow.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 氣象預報說明天下午會下大雨，所以行程得改一下。
lines.simplified: 气象预报说明天下午会下大雨，所以行程得改一下。
lines.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō míngtiān xiàwǔ huì xià dà yǔ, suǒyǐ xíngchéng děi gǎi yíxià.
lines.english: The weather forecast says heavy rain tomorrow afternoon, so the itinerary has to change a little.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 本來下午要去的老教堂在小山上，下雨路很滑，所以改到早上九點去。
lines.simplified: 本来下午要去的老教堂在小山上，下雨路很滑，所以改到早上九点去。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái xiàwǔ yào qù de lǎo jiàotáng zài xiǎo shān shàng, xià yǔ lù hěn huá, suǒyǐ gǎi dào zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn qù.
lines.english: The old church we were visiting in the afternoon is up on a hill and the path is slippery in the rain, so it moves to 9 a.m.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 早上要逛的老街改到下午。那裡走在商店前面不用打傘，下雨也能慢慢逛。
lines.simplified: 早上要逛的老街改到下午。那里走在商店前面不用打伞，下雨也能慢慢逛。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshàng yào guàng de lǎo jiē gǎi dào xiàwǔ. Nàlǐ zǒu zài shāngdiàn qiánmiàn bú yòng dǎ sǎn, xià yǔ yě néng mànman guàng.
lines.english: The old street we were exploring in the morning moves to the afternoon. You can walk in front of the shops there without an umbrella, so we can take our time even in the rain.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 最後本來要到碼頭看夕陽，下雨就看不到了，我們改去一家有名的餐廳吃晚餐，費用一樣。
lines.simplified: 最后本来要到码头看夕阳，下雨就看不到了，我们改去一家有名的餐厅吃晚餐，费用一样。
lines.pinyin: Zuìhòu běnlái yào dào mǎtóu kàn xīyáng, xià yǔ jiù kàn bú dào le, wǒmen gǎi qù yì jiā yǒumíng de cāntīng chī wǎncān, fèiyòng yíyàng.
lines.english: To finish, we were going to watch the sunset at the pier; in the rain there will be nothing to see, so we'll go to a well-known restaurant for dinner instead, at the same cost.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 總之，白天的教堂和老街換了時間，晚上也改去餐廳，不過集合的時間和地方都不變，還是早上八點半在飯店門口。
lines.simplified: 总之，白天的教堂和老街换了时间，晚上也改去餐厅，不过集合的时间和地方都不变，还是早上八点半在饭店门口。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, báitiān de jiàotáng hé lǎo jiē huàn le shíjiān, wǎnshàng yě gǎi qù cāntīng, búguò jíhé de shíjiān hé dìfāng dōu bú biàn, háishì zǎoshàng bā diǎn bàn zài fàndiàn ménkǒu.
lines.english: In short, the church and the old street swap times during the day and the evening is now a restaurant, but the meeting time and place stay the same: 8:30 a.m. at the hotel entrance.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 明天早上九點，他們會在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 明天早上九点，他们会在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn, tāmen huì zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where will they be at nine tomorrow morning?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài lǎo jiàotáng cānguān.
choices.english: Visiting the old church.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài fàndiàn ménkǒu jíhé.
choices.english: Gathering at the hotel entrance.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài lǎo jiē shàng guàng shāngdiàn.
choices.english: Browsing the shops on the old street.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài qù lǎo jiē de lù shàng.
choices.english: On the way to the old street.

questions.why: The church moves from the afternoon to 早上九點. The old street was the OLD morning plan, and the hotel entrance is at 8:30, half an hour earlier.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老教堂和老街為什麼要換時間？
prompt.simplified: 老教堂和老街为什么要换时间？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎo jiàotáng hé lǎo jiē wèishénme yào huàn shíjiān?
prompt.english: Why do the old church and the old street swap times?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下雨的話碼頭看不到夕陽
choices.simplified: 下雨的话码头看不到夕阳
choices.pinyin: Xià yǔ de huà mǎtóu kàn bú dào xīyáng.
choices.english: In the rain there is no sunset to see at the pier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 雨天去老街比上山方便
choices.simplified: 雨天去老街比上山方便
choices.pinyin: Yǔtiān qù lǎo jiē bǐ shàng shān fāngbiàn.
choices.english: In the rain the old street is easier than going up the hill.

choices.speaker: N

passage.traditional: 祖父的老家是南部鄉下一棟一百多年的老房子。房子很舊了，修理很花錢，家人都希望他搬到城裡。{1}，祖父還是不肯搬。去年，市長發現這棟房子具有歷史價值，出錢請人來修。很多人擔心修完就不像古蹟了，{2}修好後跟以前差不多。不久來了颱風，附近好幾棟老房子倒了，{3}祖父的房子剛修好，一點事都沒有。現在，祖父每天帶遊客參觀老房子。遊客都愛聽他說故事，{4}這是他住了八十年的地方。他介紹老房子的歷史，{5}也讓更多人認識了家鄉。{6}，老房子讓祖父的生活又熱鬧起來了。
passage.simplified: 祖父的老家是南部乡下一栋一百多年的老房子。房子很旧了，修理很花钱，家人都希望他搬到城里。{1}，祖父还是不肯搬。去年，市长发现这栋房子具有历史价值，出钱请人来修。很多人担心修完就不像古迹了，{2}修好后跟以前差不多。不久来了台风，附近好几栋老房子倒了，{3}祖父的房子刚修好，一点事都没有。现在，祖父每天带游客参观老房子。游客都爱听他说故事，{4}这是他住了八十年的地方。他介绍老房子的历史，{5}也让更多人认识了家乡。{6}，老房子让祖父的生活又热闹起来了。
passage.pinyin: Zǔfù de lǎojiā shì nánbù xiāngxià yí dòng yì bǎi duō nián de lǎo fángzi. Fángzi hěn jiù le, xiūlǐ hěn huā qián, jiārén dōu xīwàng tā bān dào chéng lǐ. Jǐnguǎn zhèyàng, zǔfù háishì bù kěn bān. Qùnián, shìzhǎng fāxiàn zhè dòng fángzi jùyǒu lìshǐ jiàzhí, chū qián qǐng rén lái xiū. Hěn duō rén dānxīn xiū wán jiù bú xiàng gǔjī le, jiéguǒ xiū hǎo hòu gēn yǐqián chàbùduō. Bùjiǔ lái le táifēng, fùjìn hǎojǐ dòng lǎo fángzi dǎo le, xìnghǎo zǔfù de fángzi gāng xiū hǎo, yìdiǎn shì dōu méiyǒu. Xiànzài, zǔfù měi tiān dài yóukè cānguān lǎo fángzi. Yóukè dōu ài tīng tā shuō gùshì, bìjìng zhè shì tā zhù le bāshí nián de dìfāng. Tā jièshào lǎo fángzi de lìshǐ, tóngshí yě ràng gèng duō rén rènshì le jiāxiāng. Zǒngzhī, lǎo fángzi ràng zǔfù de shēnghuó yòu rènào qǐlái le.
passage.english: My grandfather's old home is a house over a hundred years old in the countryside in the south. The house is very old, repairs cost a lot, and the family wanted him to move to the city. Even so, my grandfather still refused to move. Last year the mayor found that the house had historical value and paid for it to be repaired. Many people worried that once repaired it would no longer look like a historic site; as it turned out, the repaired house looks much as it did before. Soon afterwards a typhoon came and several old houses nearby fell down; luckily grandfather's house had just been repaired and was not damaged at all. Now grandfather shows visitors round the old house every day. Visitors love hearing his stories; after all, this is where he has lived for eighty years. He tells them the history of the house, and at the same time more people have come to know his hometown. In short, the old house has made grandfather's life lively again.

passage.traditional: 上個月，室友的阿姨帶我們參觀古廟。阿姨在附近住了五十年，哪條龍最早刻好、哪一年發生過大火，她都知道。{1}，廟裡的事問她就對了。廟裡的龍是石頭刻的，十分生動，我們兩個一看到，就{2}說：「太了不起了！」這座廟燒過兩次，都是當地人出錢修好的。我以為修過的廟沒那麼有價值，阿姨{3}說，把廟修好也是歷史。現在年輕人不常拜拜，可是週末來廟前廣場的人{4}比以前多：有人擺攤，有人表演，{5}有人在這裡結婚。很多人以為古廟只有老人去，{6}，它一直是大家生活的中心。
passage.simplified: 上个月，室友的阿姨带我们参观古庙。阿姨在附近住了五十年，哪条龙最早刻好、哪一年发生过大火，她都知道。{1}，庙里的事问她就对了。庙里的龙是石头刻的，十分生动，我们两个一看到，就{2}说：「太了不起了！」这座庙烧过两次，都是当地人出钱修好的。我以为修过的庙没那么有价值，阿姨{3}说，把庙修好也是历史。现在年轻人不常拜拜，可是周末来庙前广场的人{4}比以前多：有人摆摊，有人表演，{5}有人在这里结婚。很多人以为古庙只有老人去，{6}，它一直是大家生活的中心。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, shìyǒu de āyí dài wǒmen cānguān gǔ miào. Āyí zài fùjìn zhù le wǔshí nián, nǎ tiáo lóng zuì zǎo kè hǎo, nǎ yì nián fāshēng guo dà huǒ, tā dōu zhīdào. Zǒngzhī, miào lǐ de shì wèn tā jiù duì le. Miào lǐ de lóng shì shítou kè de, shífēn shēngdòng, wǒmen liǎng ge yí kàn dào, jiù tóngshí shuō: "Tài liǎobùqǐ le!" Zhè zuò miào shāo guo liǎng cì, dōu shì dāngdì rén chū qián xiū hǎo de. Wǒ yǐwéi xiū guo de miào méi nàme yǒu jiàzhí, āyí què shuō, bǎ miào xiū hǎo yě shì lìshǐ. Xiànzài niánqīng rén bù cháng bàibai, kěshì zhōumò lái miào qián guǎngchǎng de rén fǎn'ér bǐ yǐqián duō: yǒu rén bǎi tān, yǒu rén biǎoyǎn, shènzhì yǒu rén zài zhèlǐ jiéhūn. Hěn duō rén yǐwéi gǔ miào zhǐyǒu lǎorén qù, shìshíshàng, tā yìzhí shì dàjiā shēnghuó de zhōngxīn.
passage.english: Last month my roommate's aunt took us to visit an old temple. She has lived nearby for fifty years: which dragon was carved first, which year the big fire broke out, she knows all of it. In short, if it is about the temple, ask her. The dragons in the temple are carved in stone and very lifelike; the moment the two of us saw them, we both said at the same time, "Amazing!" The temple has burned twice, and both times the local people paid to repair it. I thought a repaired temple was not worth so much, but the aunt said that repairing the temple is history too. Young people don't pray much nowadays, yet at weekends there are, if anything, more people in the square in front of the temple than before: some set up stalls, some perform, and some even get married here. Many people think only old people go to old temples; in fact, this one has always been the centre of everyone's life.

text.traditional:
星期六行程
早上九點在捷運站門口集合，先參觀龍山寺。
從龍山寺搭捷運到淡水，大約一個小時。紅毛城下午五點關門，所以最晚十二點離開龍山寺，在淡水吃完午餐再過去。
參觀完紅毛城及旁邊的老教堂，再到碼頭看夕陽。
氣象預報說星期六下午可能下雨。如果下雨，看完紅毛城就回臺北，參觀老教堂及到碼頭看夕陽都改到星期天。
老教堂星期天上午有宗教活動，不開放參觀，下午兩點以後才開放。
請記得帶傘。碼頭風很大，最好也帶一件外套。
歷史社

从龙山寺搭捷运到淡水，大约一个小时。红毛城下午五点关门，所以最晚十二点离开龙山寺，在淡水吃完午餐再过去。
参观完红毛城及旁边的老教堂，再到码头看夕阳。
气象预报说星期六下午可能下雨。如果下雨，看完红毛城就回台北，参观老教堂及到码头看夕阳都改到星期天。

title.english: The Old Market in My Hometown

text.traditional:
我的家鄉有一座一百多年前蓋的老市場。小時候，我常跟祖母去那裡買菜，聽她跟攤販聊天。後來附近開了好幾家超市，去老市場的人越來越少，屋頂破了也沒有人修理。
去年，市長打算把老市場改成停車場，很多人都覺得這樣很好，因為附近停車很不方便。我本來也這麼想，直到在網路上看到一張五十年前的照片：市場裡擠滿了人，每個人都笑得很開心。那時候我才體會到，這座市場不只是買菜賣菜的地方，更記錄了好幾十年來大家的生活。
後來，幾個年輕人積極地跟市長溝通，希望能把市場保留下來。他們找到了經費，請專業人員修好屋頂，同時把一部分的攤位改成書店及咖啡店，其他的攤位還是賣菜、賣水果。現在，週末來這裡的人多得不得了，買完菜的人會順便進書店看看，喝咖啡的年輕人也會帶一把青菜回家。連住在附近的老人也常回來坐坐。祖母說，她簡直不敢相信這就是她以前常去的地方。
text.simplified:
我的家乡有一座一百多年前盖的老市场。小时候，我常跟祖母去那里买菜，听她跟摊贩聊天。后来附近开了好几家超市，去老市场的人越来越少，屋顶破了也没有人修理。
去年，市长打算把老市场改成停车场，很多人都觉得这样很好，因为附近停车很不方便。我本来也这么想，直到在网路上看到一张五十年前的照片：市场里挤满了人，每个人都笑得很开心。那时候我才体会到，这座市场不只是买菜卖菜的地方，更记录了好几十年来大家的生活。
后来，几个年轻人积极地跟市长沟通，希望能把市场保留下来。他们找到了经费，请专业人员修好屋顶，同时把一部分的摊位改成书店及咖啡店，其他的摊位还是卖菜、卖水果。现在，周末来这里的人多得不得了，买完菜的人会顺便进书店看看，喝咖啡的年轻人也会带一把青菜回家。连住在附近的老人也常回来坐坐。祖母说，她简直不敢相信这就是她以前常去的地方。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng yǒu yí zuò yì bǎi duō nián qián gài de lǎo shìchǎng. Xiǎoshíhòu, wǒ cháng gēn zǔmǔ qù nàlǐ mǎi cài, tīng tā gēn tānfàn liáotiān. Hòulái fùjìn kāi le hǎojǐ jiā chāoshì, qù lǎo shìchǎng de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo, wūdǐng pò le yě méiyǒu rén xiūlǐ. Qùnián, shìzhǎng dǎsuàn bǎ lǎo shìchǎng gǎi chéng tíngchēchǎng, hěn duō rén dōu juéde zhèyàng hěn hǎo, yīnwèi fùjìn tíngchē hěn bù fāngbiàn. Wǒ běnlái yě zhème xiǎng, zhídào zài wǎnglù shàng kàn dào yì zhāng wǔshí nián qián de zhàopiàn: shìchǎng lǐ jǐ mǎn le rén, měi ge rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn. Nà shíhòu wǒ cái tǐhuì dào, zhè zuò shìchǎng bù zhǐ shì mǎi cài mài cài de dìfāng, gèng jìlù le hǎo jǐshí nián lái dàjiā de shēnghuó. Hòulái, jǐ ge niánqīng rén jījí de gēn shìzhǎng gōutōng, xīwàng néng bǎ shìchǎng bǎoliú xiàlái. Tāmen zhǎo dào le jīngfèi, qǐng zhuānyè rényuán xiū hǎo wūdǐng, tóngshí bǎ yí bùfèn de tānwèi gǎi chéng shūdiàn jí kāfēi diàn, qítā de tānwèi háishì mài cài, mài shuǐguǒ. Xiànzài, zhōumò lái zhèlǐ de rén duō de bùdéliǎo, mǎi wán cài de rén huì shùnbiàn jìn shūdiàn kàn kan, hē kāfēi de niánqīng rén yě huì dài yì bǎ qīngcài huí jiā. Lián zhù zài fùjìn de lǎorén yě cháng huílái zuò zuo. Zǔmǔ shuō, tā jiǎnzhí bù gǎn xiāngxìn zhè jiù shì tā yǐqián cháng qù de dìfāng.
text.english:
My hometown has an old market built over a hundred years ago. As a child I often went there with my grandmother to buy vegetables and listened to her chatting with the stallholders. Later several supermarkets opened nearby, fewer and fewer people went to the old market, and when the roof broke nobody repaired it.
Last year the mayor planned to turn the old market into a car park, and many people thought that was a good idea, because parking nearby is very difficult. I thought so too, until I saw a photo online from fifty years ago: the market was packed, and everyone was smiling. Only then did I realize that the market is not just a place to buy and sell vegetables; even more, it records decades of everyone's lives.
Later a few young people actively talked with the mayor, hoping to keep the market. They found funding, had professionals repair the roof, and at the same time turned some of the stalls into bookshops and cafés, while the other stalls still sell vegetables and fruit. Now the place is incredibly busy at weekends: people who have bought their vegetables drop into the bookshop on the way, and young people having coffee take a bunch of greens home. Even old people living nearby often come back to sit for a while. My grandmother says she can practically not believe this is the place she used to go to.

text.traditional:
去年暑假，我幫父母整理祖父留下來的老房子，在櫃子裡找到一個木頭箱子。箱子裡有好幾十張老照片及一本日記，日記裡的字很多我都看不懂。我本來想把這些東西丟掉，可是父親說，這些物品也許賣不了多少錢，卻是祖父一生的記錄。
聽了父親的話，我帶著日記，去請教大學裡一位教歷史的教授。教授看了以後十分驚訝。他說，日記裡記錄了六十年前我們這個地方的生活情形，有的事連書上都沒寫過。例如河上那座古老的橋，大家都以為是當時的市長蓋的，事實上是住在附近的人自己出錢、出力蓋起來的。知道這段歷史以後，當地人都覺得祖先很了不起。
後來，教授帶著學生把日記整理出來，同時去找當地的老人，請他們說說日記裡寫到的事。現在，這本日記放在當地的博物館裡，常常有人特地來看。我常想，要是那天真的把箱子丟了，這段歷史可能就永遠找不回來了。
text.simplified:
去年暑假，我帮父母整理祖父留下来的老房子，在柜子里找到一个木头箱子。箱子里有好几十张老照片及一本日记，日记里的字很多我都看不懂。我本来想把这些东西丢掉，可是父亲说，这些物品也许卖不了多少钱，却是祖父一生的记录。
听了父亲的话，我带着日记，去请教大学里一位教历史的教授。教授看了以后十分惊讶。他说，日记里记录了六十年前我们这个地方的生活情形，有的事连书上都没写过。例如河上那座古老的桥，大家都以为是当时的市长盖的，事实上是住在附近的人自己出钱、出力盖起来的。知道这段历史以后，当地人都觉得祖先很了不起。
后来，教授带着学生把日记整理出来，同时去找当地的老人，请他们说说日记里写到的事。现在，这本日记放在当地的博物馆里，常常有人特地来看。我常想，要是那天真的把箱子丢了，这段历史可能就永远找不回来了。
text.pinyin: Qùnián shǔjià, wǒ bāng fùmǔ zhěnglǐ zǔfù liú xiàlái de lǎo fángzi, zài guìzi lǐ zhǎo dào yí ge mùtou xiāngzi. Xiāngzi lǐ yǒu hǎo jǐshí zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn jí yì běn rìjì, rìjì lǐ de zì hěn duō wǒ dōu kàn bù dǒng. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng bǎ zhèxiē dōngxi diū diào, kěshì fùqīn shuō, zhèxiē wùpǐn yěxǔ mài bù liǎo duōshǎo qián, què shì zǔfù yìshēng de jìlù. Tīng le fùqīn de huà, wǒ dài zhe rìjì, qù qǐngjiào dàxué lǐ yí wèi jiāo lìshǐ de jiàoshòu. Jiàoshòu kàn le yǐhòu shífēn jīngyà. Tā shuō, rìjì lǐ jìlù le liùshí nián qián wǒmen zhège dìfāng de shēnghuó qíngxíng, yǒu de shì lián shū shàng dōu méi xiě guo. Lìrú hé shàng nà zuò gǔlǎo de qiáo, dàjiā dōu yǐwéi shì dāngshí de shìzhǎng gài de, shìshíshàng shì zhù zài fùjìn de rén zìjǐ chū qián, chūlì gài qǐlái de. Zhīdào zhè duàn lìshǐ yǐhòu, dāngdì rén dōu juéde zǔxiān hěn liǎobùqǐ. Hòulái, jiàoshòu dài zhe xuéshēng bǎ rìjì zhěnglǐ chūlái, tóngshí qù zhǎo dāngdì de lǎorén, qǐng tāmen shuō shuo rìjì lǐ xiě dào de shì. Xiànzài, zhè běn rìjì fàng zài dāngdì de bówùguǎn lǐ, chángcháng yǒu rén tèdì lái kàn. Wǒ cháng xiǎng, yàoshì nà tiān zhēn de bǎ xiāngzi diū le, zhè duàn lìshǐ kěnéng jiù yǒngyuǎn zhǎo bù huílái le.
text.english:
Last summer I helped my parents sort out the old house my grandfather left, and found a wooden box in a cupboard. In it were dozens of old photos and a diary; I couldn't read much of the writing in the diary. I meant to throw it all away, but my father said these things might not sell for much, yet they were the record of my grandfather's whole life.
After hearing what my father said, I took the diary to a history professor at a university. The professor was very surprised. He said the diary recorded how people lived here sixty years ago, and some of it had never been written in any book. For example, everyone thought the old bridge over the river had been built by the mayor of that time; in fact the people living nearby paid for it and built it themselves. Since learning this history, local people have felt their ancestors were remarkable.
Later the professor and his students put the diary in order, and at the same time went to the old people of the area to ask them about the things the diary mentions. Now the diary is in the local museum, and people often come specially to see it. I often think that if I really had thrown the box away that day, this piece of history might never have been found again.

lines.traditional: 我會帶一些水果，吃完也幫她洗碗。
lines.simplified: 我会带一些水果，吃完也帮她洗碗。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ, chī wán yě bāng tā xǐ wǎn.
lines.english: I take some fruit, and after the meal I help her wash the dishes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她剛搬來就常請老太太吃飯
choices.simplified: 她刚搬来就常请老太太吃饭
choices.pinyin: Tā gāng bān lái jiù cháng qǐng lǎo tàitai chīfàn.
choices.english: She often had the old lady over for meals after moving in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她把老太太當作自己的媽媽
choices.simplified: 她把老太太当作自己的妈妈
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎo tàitai dāngzuò zìjǐ de māma.
choices.english: She treats the old lady like her own mother.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她每個星期都去幫老太太煮飯
choices.simplified: 她每个星期都去帮老太太煮饭
choices.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqí dōu qù bāng lǎo tàitai zhǔ fàn.
choices.english: Every week she goes to help the old lady cook.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老太太對她像對女兒一樣
choices.simplified: 老太太对她像对女儿一样
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai duì tā xiàng duì nǚ'ér yíyàng.
choices.english: The old lady treats her like a daughter.

questions.why: 把我當作自己的孩子 means the old lady treats her like a daughter, not the other way round: the woman never says she sees the lady as her mother, and her 不是 shows they are not family. It is the lady who invites her, and she helps by bringing fruit and washing up, not by cooking.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳們昨天去爬山，下午下了大雨？
lines.simplified: 听说你们昨天去爬山，下午下了大雨？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen zuótiān qù pá shān, xiàwǔ xià le dà yǔ?
lines.english: I hear you went hiking yesterday and it poured in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，雨來得很突然，山路又溼又滑。
lines.simplified: 对啊，雨来得很突然，山路又湿又滑。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, yǔ lái de hěn túrán, shānlù yòu shī yòu huá.
lines.english: Yes, the rain came suddenly, and the mountain path was wet and slippery.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳們怎麼下山的？
lines.simplified: 那你们怎么下山的？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen zěnme xià shān de?
lines.english: So how did you get down?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 幸虧有一位伯伯開車經過，讓我們坐他的車下山，要不然我們還得走兩個小時。
lines.simplified: 幸亏有一位伯伯开车经过，让我们坐他的车下山，要不然我们还得走两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu yí wèi bóbo kāichē jīngguò, ràng wǒmen zuò tā de chē xià shān, yàobùrán wǒmen hái děi zǒu liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Luckily an older man drove past and let us ride down in his car; otherwise we'd have had to walk two more hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下次出門以前，先看一下氣象預報吧。
lines.simplified: 下次出门以前，先看一下气象预报吧。
lines.pinyin: Xià cì chūmén yǐqián, xiān kàn yíxià qìxiàng yùbào ba.
lines.english: Next time, check the weather forecast before you go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我看了啊！預報說是晴天，誰知道會變得這麼快。
lines.simplified: 我看了啊！预报说是晴天，谁知道会变得这么快。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le a! Yùbào shuō shì qíngtiān, shéi zhīdào huì biàn de zhème kuài.
lines.english: I did! The forecast said sunny. Who knew it would change so fast?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼說自己運氣好？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么说自己运气好？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme shuō zìjǐ yùnqì hǎo?
prompt.english: Why does the woman count herself lucky?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 出門前她看了氣象預報
choices.simplified: 出门前她看了气象预报
choices.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā kàn le qìxiàng yùbào.
choices.english: She had checked the forecast before going.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zhǐ zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: They only had to walk two hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們下山以後才開始下大雨
choices.simplified: 她们下山以后才开始下大雨
choices.pinyin: Tāmen xià shān yǐhòu cái kāishǐ xià dà yǔ.
choices.english: The heavy rain started only after they got down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有人讓她們不用走路下山
choices.simplified: 有人让她们不用走路下山
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén ràng tāmen bú yòng zǒulù xià shān.
choices.english: Someone saved them the walk down.

questions.why: 幸虧 marks the lucky part, the man's car; 要不然 tells what they escaped: two more hours on foot. The two hours never happened, the forecast was wrong, and the rain caught them on the mountain.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個週末去看的那間房子怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去看的那间房子怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù kàn de nà jiān fángzi zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How was the place you went to see last weekend?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 房租倒是不貴，可是房間小得簡直放不下一張床。
lines.simplified: 房租倒是不贵，可是房间小得简直放不下一张床。
lines.pinyin: Fángzū dàoshì bú guì, kěshì fángjiān xiǎo de jiǎnzhí fàng bú xià yì zhāng chuáng.
lines.english: The rent isn't expensive, actually, but the room is so small you could hardly fit a bed in it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那離學校近嗎？
lines.simplified: 那离学校近吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà lí xuéxiào jìn ma?
lines.english: Is it close to school, then?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐公車要四十分鐘，而且樓下就是夜市，晚上很吵。
lines.simplified: 坐公车要四十分钟，而且楼下就是夜市，晚上很吵。
lines.pinyin: Zuò gōngchē yào sìshí fēnzhōng, érqiě lóuxià jiù shì yèshì, wǎnshàng hěn chǎo.
lines.english: Forty minutes by bus, and there's a night market right downstairs, so it's noisy at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來不太理想。
lines.simplified: 听起来不太理想。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái bú tài lǐxiǎng.
lines.english: Doesn't sound ideal.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 總之，那間我是不會租的。這個週末我再去看別的。
lines.simplified: 总之，那间我是不会租的。这个周末我再去看别的。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, nà jiān wǒ shì bú huì zū de. Zhège zhōumò wǒ zài qù kàn bié de.
lines.english: In short, I'm not renting that one. I'll go and see others this weekend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的對那間房子有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 女的对那间房子有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de duì nà jiān fángzi yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of that place?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 價錢可以，但是不適合住
choices.simplified: 价钱可以，但是不适合住
choices.pinyin: Jiàqián kěyǐ, dànshì bú shìhé zhù.
choices.english: The price is fine, but it isn't right to live in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fángjiān hěn xiǎo, kěshì hěn ānjìng.
choices.english: Small, but quiet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 只是太遠，要不然就租了
choices.simplified: 只是太远，要不然就租了
choices.pinyin: Zhǐshì tài yuǎn, yàobùrán jiù zū le.
choices.english: Only too far, or she'd take it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fángzū tài guì, fángjiān yě tài xiǎo.
choices.english: Too expensive, and too small.

questions.why: 倒是不貴 grants the rent, then 簡直放不下一張床, the long bus ride and the noisy night market add up to 總之…不會租. It is noisy, not quiet; distance is only one of three problems; and the rent is the one good point.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 學校餐廳最近改了，現在不再一人一份，要自己拿菜。
lines.simplified: 学校餐厅最近改了，现在不再一人一份，要自己拿菜。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng zuìjìn gǎi le, xiànzài bú zài yì rén yí fèn, yào zìjǐ ná cài.
lines.english: The school cafeteria has changed: no more set portions, you serve yourself now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你沒看到門口的海報嗎？上面寫著：由於很多同學吃不完，飯菜白白丟掉，因此改成想吃多少就拿多少。
lines.simplified: 你没看到门口的海报吗？上面写着：由于很多同学吃不完，饭菜白白丢掉，因此改成想吃多少就拿多少。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ méi kàndào ménkǒu de hǎibào ma? Shàngmiàn xiězhe: yóuyú hěn duō tóngxué chī bù wán, fàncài báibái diū diào, yīncǐ gǎi chéng xiǎng chī duōshǎo jiù ná duōshǎo.
lines.english: Didn't you see the poster at the door? It says: because many students couldn't finish and food was thrown away for nothing, you now take as much as you want.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣不會有人拿太多嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样不会有人拿太多吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng bú huì yǒu rén ná tài duō ma?
lines.english: Won't some people take too much?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 吃完要把盤子拿回去，剩太多的人得多付十塊錢。
lines.simplified: 吃完要把盘子拿回去，剩太多的人得多付十块钱。
lines.pinyin: Chī wán yào bǎ pánzi ná huíqù, shèng tài duō de rén děi duō fù shí kuài qián.
lines.english: You take your plate back when you've eaten, and anyone who leaves too much pays ten dollars extra.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說這個月丟掉的飯菜少了一半以上。
lines.simplified: 听说这个月丢掉的饭菜少了一半以上。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhège yuè diū diào de fàncài shǎo le yíbàn yǐshàng.
lines.english: I hear food thrown out this month is down by more than half.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，餐廳省下了不少錢，於是經理決定每天多送大家一份水果。
lines.simplified: 对啊，餐厅省下了不少钱，于是经理决定每天多送大家一份水果。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, cāntīng shěng xià le bù shǎo qián, yúshì jīnglǐ juédìng měi tiān duō sòng dàjiā yí fèn shuǐguǒ.
lines.english: Yes, the cafeteria saved quite a lot, so the manager decided to give everyone a free portion of fruit each day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪今天多了一個蘋果！不過對我來說，最好的是不用再剩下了。我吃得少，以前一份飯菜總是吃不完。
lines.simplified: 难怪今天多了一个苹果！不过对我来说，最好的是不用再剩下了。我吃得少，以前一份饭菜总是吃不完。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài jīntiān duō le yí ge píngguǒ! Búguò duì wǒ lái shuō, zuì hǎo de shì bú yòng zài shèngxià le. Wǒ chī de shǎo, yǐqián yí fèn fàncài zǒngshì chī bù wán.
lines.english: No wonder there was an extra apple today! But for me the best part is not leaving food any more. I don't eat much, and I could never finish a set portion.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一個同學拿了很多菜，最後剩下一大半，會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 一个同学拿了很多菜，最后剩下一大半，会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yí ge tóngxué ná le hěn duō cài, zuìhòu shèngxià yí dà bàn, huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: A student takes a lot and leaves more than half. What happens?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下次來吃飯得多付十塊錢
choices.simplified: 下次来吃饭得多付十块钱
choices.pinyin: Xià cì lái chīfàn děi duō fù shí kuài qián.
choices.english: He pays ten dollars more the next time he eats there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 把盤子拿回去的時候得多付錢
choices.simplified: 把盘子拿回去的时候得多付钱
choices.pinyin: Bǎ pánzi ná huíqù de shíhòu děi duō fù qián.
choices.english: He pays extra when he takes his plate back.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià cì zhǐ néng ná yì rén yí fèn.
choices.english: Next time he may take only a set portion.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得把剩下的吃完才能走
choices.simplified: 得把剩下的吃完才能走
choices.pinyin: Děi bǎ shèngxià de chī wán cái néng zǒu.
choices.english: He must finish it before he can leave.

questions.why: Two lines meet: plates go back after the meal (吃完要把盤子拿回去), and 剩太多的人得多付十塊錢. The extra ten is paid on the spot when the plate goes back, not next time; set portions are the old system; and nobody is made to finish their food.

focus.en: applying a rule to a new case

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 餐廳為什麼能每天多送一份水果？
prompt.simplified: 餐厅为什么能每天多送一份水果？
prompt.pinyin: Cāntīng wèishénme néng měi tiān duō sòng yí fèn shuǐguǒ?
prompt.english: Why can the cafeteria give out extra fruit every day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 剩菜的同學多付了不少錢
choices.simplified: 剩菜的同学多付了不少钱
choices.pinyin: Shèng cài de tóngxué duō fù le bù shǎo qián.
choices.english: Students who left food paid a lot extra.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 自己拿菜，少請了幾個人
choices.simplified: 自己拿菜，少请了几个人
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ ná cài, shǎo qǐng le jǐ ge rén.
choices.english: With self-service, it hired fewer staff.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理想讓更多同學來餐廳吃飯
choices.simplified: 经理想让更多同学来餐厅吃饭
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiǎng ràng gèng duō tóngxué lái cāntīng chīfàn.
choices.english: The manager wants more students to eat there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 丟掉的飯菜比以前少了很多
choices.simplified: 丢掉的饭菜比以前少了很多
choices.pinyin: Diū diào de fàncài bǐ yǐqián shǎo le hěn duō.
choices.english: Much less food is thrown away than before.

questions.why: Two turns link: thrown-out food fell by more than half, so 餐廳省下了不少錢，於是 the manager added fruit. The ten-dollar charge is never said to pay for anything, self-service is not said to cut staff, and drawing more students in is never mentioned.

focus.en: so (an action taken because of it); combining two turns

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得新做法最大的好處是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得新做法最大的好处是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xīn zuòfǎ zuì dà de hǎochù shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man think is the best thing about the new way?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 自己的飯菜不會再剩下
choices.simplified: 自己的饭菜不会再剩下
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ de fàncài bú huì zài shèngxià.
choices.english: He no longer leaves food on his plate.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 每天可以多吃一個蘋果
choices.simplified: 每天可以多吃一个苹果
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān kěyǐ duō chī yí ge píngguǒ.
choices.english: He gets an extra apple every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 餐廳省下的錢比以前多
choices.simplified: 餐厅省下的钱比以前多
choices.pinyin: Cāntīng shěng xià de qián bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: The cafeteria saves more money than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ná tài duō de rén huì duō fù qián.
choices.english: People who take too much pay more.

questions.why: His 不過 sets the free apple aside: 最好的是不用再剩下了, since a set portion was always too much for him. The saving is the cafeteria's gain, and the extra charge is a rule he never says he likes.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳們店裡的麵包最近怎麼都賣不完？
lines.simplified: 你们店里的面包最近怎么都卖不完？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen diàn lǐ de miànbāo zuìjìn zěnme dōu mài bù wán?
lines.english: Why isn't your shop selling all its bread lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對面新開了一家麵包店，我們的客人就少了很多，每天都剩下二、三十個。
lines.simplified: 对面新开了一家面包店，我们的客人就少了很多，每天都剩下二、三十个。
lines.pinyin: Duìmiàn xīn kāi le yì jiā miànbāo diàn, wǒmen de kèrén jiù shǎo le hěn duō, měi tiān dōu shèngxià èr, sānshí ge.
lines.english: A new bakery opened across the street, so we've lost a lot of customers, and twenty or thirty loaves are left every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那剩下的怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那剩下的怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà shèngxià de zěnme bàn?
lines.english: What happens to the leftovers?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆本來都叫我們丟掉。我覺得太可惜，就建議他晚上八點以後打五折。
lines.simplified: 老板本来都叫我们丢掉。我觉得太可惜，就建议他晚上八点以后打五折。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn běnlái dōu jiào wǒmen diū diào. Wǒ juéde tài kěxí, jiù jiànyì tā wǎnshàng bā diǎn yǐhòu dǎ wǔ zhé.
lines.english: The boss used to tell us to throw it out. I thought that was a waste, so I suggested half price after 8 p.m.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他答應了嗎？
lines.simplified: 他答应了吗？
lines.pinyin: Tā dāyìng le ma?
lines.english: Did he agree?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他怕客人以後都等到八點才來買，不肯。所以我又建議，把麵包送到附近的食物銀行。
lines.simplified: 他怕客人以后都等到八点才来买，不肯。所以我又建议，把面包送到附近的食物银行。
lines.pinyin: Tā pà kèrén yǐhòu dōu děng dào bā diǎn cái lái mǎi, bù kěn. Suǒyǐ wǒ yòu jiànyì, bǎ miànbāo sòng dào fùjìn de shíwù yínháng.
lines.english: He was afraid customers would all wait until eight to buy, so he refused. So I suggested taking the bread to the food bank nearby.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次他答應了吧？
lines.simplified: 这次他答应了吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì tā dāyìng le ba?
lines.english: He agreed this time, surely?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說至少比丟掉好，就答應了。現在我每天下班都順便送過去。
lines.simplified: 他说至少比丢掉好，就答应了。现在我每天下班都顺便送过去。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō zhìshǎo bǐ diū diào hǎo, jiù dāyìng le. Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān xiàbān dōu shùnbiàn sòng guòqù.
lines.english: He said at least it beats throwing it away, and agreed. Now I drop it off every day on my way home from work.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這家麵包店為什麼常常剩下很多麵包？
prompt.simplified: 这家面包店为什么常常剩下很多面包？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiā miànbāo diàn wèishénme chángcháng shèngxià hěn duō miànbāo?
prompt.english: Why does this bakery often have a lot of bread left?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù kěn wǎnshàng dǎzhé.
choices.english: The boss won't discount in the evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kèrén dōu děng dào wǎnshàng cái mǎi.
choices.english: Customers all wait until evening to buy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn duō le yì jiā miànbāo diàn.
choices.english: There is now another bakery nearby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 麵包每天都做得比以前多
choices.simplified: 面包每天都做得比以前多
choices.pinyin: Miànbāo měi tiān dōu zuò de bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: They bake more bread every day than before.

questions.why: 對面新開了一家麵包店，我們的客人就少了: the competition is the cause. Waiting until eight is only what the boss fears might happen, refusing the discount came after the leftovers, and nobody says they bake more than before.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老闆為什麼沒有答應女的第一個建議？
prompt.simplified: 老板为什么没有答应女的第一个建议？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèishénme méiyǒu dāyìng nǚ de dì yī ge jiànyì?
prompt.english: Why didn't the boss agree to the woman's first suggestion?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆怕客人改到晚上才買
choices.simplified: 老板怕客人改到晚上才买
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn pà kèrén gǎi dào wǎnshàng cái mǎi.
choices.english: The boss feared customers would switch to buying at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆怕對面的店也跟著打折
choices.simplified: 老板怕对面的店也跟着打折
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn pà duìmiàn de diàn yě gēnzhe dǎ zhé.
choices.english: The boss feared the shop across the street would cut prices too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆覺得打五折賣得太便宜了
choices.simplified: 老板觉得打五折卖得太便宜了
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn juéde dǎ wǔ zhé mài de tài piányí le.
choices.english: The boss thought half price was too cheap.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 客人都跑到對面去買了
choices.simplified: 客人都跑到对面去买了
choices.pinyin: Kèrén dōu pǎo dào duìmiàn qù mǎi le.
choices.english: The customers all went across the street.

questions.why: She suggested 打五折, but 他怕客人以後都等到八點才來買，不肯: the boss feared customers would hold off for the discount. He never says the price is too low or mentions what the other shop would do; the shop across the street is only why bread was left in the first place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老闆對把麵包送去食物銀行有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 老板对把面包送去食物银行有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì bǎ miànbāo sòng qù shíwù yínháng yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the boss think of taking the bread to the food bank?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 比丟掉好，還能讓客人變多
choices.simplified: 比丢掉好，还能让客人变多
choices.pinyin: Bǐ diū diào hǎo, hái néng ràng kèrén biàn duō.
choices.english: Better than binning it, and it brings in customers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 比丟掉好，可是送過去太麻煩
choices.simplified: 比丢掉好，可是送过去太麻烦
choices.pinyin: Bǐ diū diào hǎo, kěshì sòng guòqù tài máfan.
choices.english: Better than binning it, but delivering it is a hassle.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟打折一樣，都比丟掉好
choices.simplified: 跟打折一样，都比丢掉好
choices.pinyin: Gēn dǎzhé yíyàng, dōu bǐ diū diào hǎo.
choices.english: Like the discount, it beats binning it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒有特別好，只是比丟掉好一點
choices.simplified: 没有特别好，只是比丢掉好一点
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu tèbié hǎo, zhǐshì bǐ diū diào hǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: Nothing special, just better than throwing it out.

questions.why: 至少比丟掉好 sets a low bar: he agrees only because it beats the bin, not because he thinks it is good. Nobody says it brings customers, he never complains about the delivery (she drops it off on her way home), and he refused the discount, so he does not rank it with giving away.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安，接下來關心最近蔬菜的價格。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安，接下来关心最近蔬菜的价格。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān, jiēxiàlái guānxīn zuìjìn shūcài de jiàgé.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Next, a look at vegetable prices.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上個星期的強烈颱風，使得南部很多種菜的田都淹水了，這幾天青菜比平常貴了很多。
lines.simplified: 上个星期的强烈台风，使得南部很多种菜的田都淹水了，这几天青菜比平常贵了很多。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqí de qiángliè táifēng, shǐde nánbù hěn duō zhòng cài de tián dōu yānshuǐ le, zhè jǐ tiān qīngcài bǐ píngcháng guì le hěn duō.
lines.english: Last week's strong typhoon flooded many fields in the south, and greens now cost much more than usual.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 農業研究人員表示，由於中部和東部的田沒有受到影響，青菜下個星期就會慢慢變便宜。
lines.simplified: 农业研究人员表示，由于中部和东部的田没有受到影响，青菜下个星期就会慢慢变便宜。
lines.pinyin: Nóngyè yánjiù rényuán biǎoshì, yóuyú zhōngbù hé dōngbù de tián méiyǒu shòudào yǐngxiǎng, qīngcài xià ge xīngqí jiù huì mànmàn biàn piányí.
lines.english: Agricultural researchers say that because fields in the centre and east were not affected, greens will start getting cheaper next week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不過，南部的田要重新種菜，至少得等一個月。
lines.simplified: 不过，南部的田要重新种菜，至少得等一个月。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, nánbù de tián yào chóngxīn zhòng cài, zhìshǎo děi děng yí ge yuè.
lines.english: But the southern fields will have to wait at least a month before they can be replanted.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 在這段期間，大家可以少買一點青菜，多買玉米這類放得比較久的蔬菜。
lines.simplified: 在这段期间，大家可以少买一点青菜，多买玉米这类放得比较久的蔬菜。
lines.pinyin: Zài zhè duàn qíjiān, dàjiā kěyǐ shǎo mǎi yìdiǎn qīngcài, duō mǎi yùmǐ zhè lèi fàng de bǐjiào jiǔ de shūcài.
lines.english: In the meantime, buy fewer leafy greens and more vegetables that keep longer, such as corn.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 肉和魚的價格這次沒有變，大家不用擔心。
lines.simplified: 肉和鱼的价格这次没有变，大家不用担心。
lines.pinyin: Ròu hé yú de jiàgé zhè cì méiyǒu biàn, dàjiā bú yòng dānxīn.
lines.english: Meat and fish prices haven't changed this time, so there's no need to worry.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 買回家的青菜，最好三天以內吃完，以免放壞了，白白丟掉。
lines.simplified: 买回家的青菜，最好三天以内吃完，以免放坏了，白白丢掉。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi huí jiā de qīngcài, zuì hǎo sān tiān yǐnèi chī wán, yǐmiǎn fàng huài le, báibái diū diào.
lines.english: Eat the greens you buy within three days, so they don't go bad and get thrown away for nothing.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 研究人員為什麼認為青菜下星期會變便宜？
prompt.simplified: 研究人员为什么认为青菜下星期会变便宜？
prompt.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán wèishénme rènwéi qīngcài xià xīngqí huì biàn piányí?
prompt.english: Why do the researchers think greens will get cheaper next week?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 肉和魚的價格都沒有變
choices.simplified: 肉和鱼的价格都没有变
choices.pinyin: Ròu hé yú de jiàgé dōu méiyǒu biàn.
choices.english: Meat and fish prices have not changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 別的地區的菜還是種得好好的
choices.simplified: 别的地区的菜还是种得好好的
choices.pinyin: Bié de dìqū de cài háishì zhòng de hǎohǎo de.
choices.english: Crops in other regions are still growing fine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大家改買玉米，青菜買得少
choices.simplified: 大家改买玉米，青菜买得少
choices.pinyin: Dàjiā gǎi mǎi yùmǐ, qīngcài mǎi de shǎo.
choices.english: People buy corn instead, so fewer greens are bought.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 研究人員會幫南部重新種菜
choices.simplified: 研究人员会帮南部重新种菜
choices.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán huì bāng nánbù chóngxīn zhòng cài.
choices.english: Researchers will help the south replant.

questions.why: 由於中部和東部的田沒有受到影響 is the researchers' reason: other regions can still supply greens. Unchanged meat and fish prices say nothing about greens, buying corn is the broadcaster's tip rather than the researchers' reason, and nobody says researchers will do the replanting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這次颱風造成了什麼結果？
prompt.simplified: 这次台风造成了什么结果？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng zàochéng le shénme jiéguǒ?
prompt.english: What did this typhoon lead to?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 中部和東部的田也淹水了
choices.simplified: 中部和东部的田也淹水了
choices.pinyin: Zhōngbù hé dōngbù de tián yě yānshuǐ le.
choices.english: Fields in the centre and east flooded too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 南部的田下星期就能再種
choices.simplified: 南部的田下星期就能再种
choices.pinyin: Nánbù de tián xià xīngqí jiù néng zài zhòng.
choices.english: Southern fields can be replanted next week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 南部至少一個月不能種菜
choices.simplified: 南部至少一个月不能种菜
choices.pinyin: Nánbù zhìshǎo yí ge yuè bù néng zhòng cài.
choices.english: The south can't plant for at least a month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 青菜至少一個月都會比平常貴
choices.simplified: 青菜至少一个月都会比平常贵
choices.pinyin: Qīngcài zhìshǎo yí ge yuè dōu huì bǐ píngcháng guì.
choices.english: Greens will cost more than usual for at least a month.

questions.why: Two lines combine: the typhoon 使得南部很多種菜的田都淹水了, and those fields must wait 至少一個月 to be replanted. The month is the wait for replanting, not for prices, which start falling next week; the centre and east were not hit; and next week is when prices fall, not when the south can plant.

focus.en: to cause; at least; combining two lines

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是要告訴聽眾什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是要告诉听众什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào shì yào gàosu tīngzhòng shénme?
prompt.english: What is this broadcast mainly telling listeners?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 菜為什麼變貴，這段時間怎麼買
choices.simplified: 菜为什么变贵，这段时间怎么买
choices.pinyin: Cài wèishénme biàn guì, zhè duàn shíjiān zěnme mǎi.
choices.english: Why greens cost more, and how to shop meanwhile.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 颱風以後南部要怎麼重新種菜
choices.simplified: 台风以后南部要怎么重新种菜
choices.pinyin: Táifēng yǐhòu nánbù yào zěnme chóngxīn zhòng cài.
choices.english: How the south will replant after the typhoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 菜為什麼變貴，該多買肉和魚
choices.simplified: 菜为什么变贵，该多买肉和鱼
choices.pinyin: Cài wèishénme biàn guì, gāi duō mǎi ròu hé yú.
choices.english: Why greens cost more, and that people should buy more meat and fish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 什麼菜變貴了，什麼菜變便宜了
choices.simplified: 什么菜变贵了，什么菜变便宜了
choices.pinyin: Shénme cài biàn guì le, shénme cài biàn piányí le.
choices.english: Which vegetables have gone up, and which have gone down.

questions.why: The first half explains the price rise and the second half tells listeners what to buy and how soon to eat it. Replanting is one line; the advice is to buy corn and other vegetables that keep, not meat and fish, which only stayed the same price; and nothing has got cheaper.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我是阿姨。你上次說你們社團想去食物銀行幫忙，也想把同學送的東西帶過去，我幫你問了。
lines.simplified: 我是阿姨。你上次说你们社团想去食物银行帮忙，也想把同学送的东西带过去，我帮你问了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì āyí. Nǐ shàng cì shuō nǐmen shètuán xiǎng qù shíwù yínháng bāngmáng, yě xiǎng bǎ tóngxué sòng de dōngxi dài guòqù, wǒ bāng nǐ wèn le.
lines.english: It's your aunt. You said your club wanted to help at the food bank and bring along things your classmates gave, so I asked for you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們說由於最近天氣很熱，食物容易壞，所以現在只收沒打開過的東西，像米、麵條。
lines.simplified: 他们说由于最近天气很热，食物容易坏，所以现在只收没打开过的东西，像米、面条。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen shuō yóuyú zuìjìn tiānqì hěn rè, shíwù róngyì huài, suǒyǐ xiànzài zhǐ shōu méi dǎkāi guo de dōngxi, xiàng mǐ, miàntiáo.
lines.english: They say that because it's been hot lately and food spoils easily, they now accept only unopened things, like rice and noodles.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們本來每個星期六都需要人幫忙，可是最近星期六去幫忙的人太多了，所以希望你們改成星期三下午去。
lines.simplified: 他们本来每个星期六都需要人帮忙，可是最近星期六去帮忙的人太多了，所以希望你们改成星期三下午去。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen běnlái měi ge xīngqíliù dōu xūyào rén bāngmáng, kěshì zuìjìn xīngqíliù qù bāngmáng de rén tài duō le, suǒyǐ xīwàng nǐmen gǎi chéng xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù.
lines.english: They used to need helpers every Saturday, but lately too many people go on Saturdays, so they'd like you to go on Wednesday afternoon instead.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們至少要去五個人，因為那天他們要把東西送到三個地方。
lines.simplified: 你们至少要去五个人，因为那天他们要把东西送到三个地方。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zhìshǎo yào qù wǔ ge rén, yīnwèi nà tiān tāmen yào bǎ dōngxi sòng dào sān ge dìfāng.
lines.english: You need at least five people, because that day they deliver to three places.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要是你們決定去，星期五以前打電話給我，我幫你們安排。
lines.simplified: 要是你们决定去，星期五以前打电话给我，我帮你们安排。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐmen juédìng qù, xīngqíwǔ yǐqián dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, wǒ bāng nǐmen ānpái.
lines.english: If you decide to go, call me before Friday and I'll arrange it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一種安排最符合食物銀行的需求？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一种安排最符合食物银行的需求？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yì zhǒng ānpái zuì fúhé shíwù yínháng de xūqiú?
prompt.english: Which arrangement best meets the food bank's needs?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù xiàwǔ qù liù ge rén.
choices.english: Six people on Saturday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù liù ge rén.
choices.english: Six people on Wednesday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù sān ge rén.
choices.english: Three people on Wednesday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ qù wǔ ge rén.
choices.english: Five people on Friday afternoon.

questions.why: Two lines combine: 改成星期三下午 and 至少要去五個人, so six on Wednesday fits. Saturday is the old day, three is the number of delivery places, and Friday is only the deadline for calling.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 社團有同學想把自己煮的湯帶去，食物銀行會收嗎？
prompt.simplified: 社团有同学想把自己煮的汤带去，食物银行会收吗？
prompt.pinyin: Shètuán yǒu tóngxué xiǎng bǎ zìjǐ zhǔ de tāng dài qù, shíwù yínháng huì shōu ma?
prompt.english: A club member wants to bring soup they made. Will the food bank take it?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 會，只要星期三下午送去

passage.traditional: {1}我奶奶小時候家裡很窮，常常吃不飽，她從來不讓我們把飯菜剩下。有一次，我吃不完一碗飯，想拿去倒掉，被她看到了。她沒有罵我，{2}帶我去看她在院子裡種的菜，告訴我種菜有多辛苦。從那天起，我都先想好自己能吃多少再拿，{3}再也沒剩下過。現在很多超市晚上會把賣不完的食物打折，{4}被丟掉的食物少了不少。我聽朋友說了這件事，{5}常常下班後去買打折的麵包和水果。{6}，能吃的東西就不該被當作垃圾。
passage.simplified: {1}我奶奶小时候家里很穷，常常吃不饱，她从来不让我们把饭菜剩下。有一次，我吃不完一碗饭，想拿去倒掉，被她看到了。她没有骂我，{2}带我去看她在院子里种的菜，告诉我种菜有多辛苦。从那天起，我都先想好自己能吃多少再拿，{3}再也没剩下过。现在很多超市晚上会把卖不完的食物打折，{4}被丢掉的食物少了不少。我听朋友说了这件事，{5}常常下班后去买打折的面包和水果。{6}，能吃的东西就不该被当作垃圾。
passage.pinyin: Yóuyú wǒ nǎinai xiǎo shíhòu jiālǐ hěn qióng, chángcháng chī bù bǎo, tā cónglái bú ràng wǒmen bǎ fàncài shèngxià. Yǒu yí cì, wǒ chī bù wán yì wǎn fàn, xiǎng ná qù dào diào, bèi tā kàndào le. Tā méiyǒu mà wǒ, fǎn'ér dài wǒ qù kàn tā zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng de cài, gàosu wǒ zhòng cài yǒu duō xīnkǔ. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ dōu xiān xiǎng hǎo zìjǐ néng chī duōshǎo zài ná, jiéguǒ zài yě méi shèngxià guo. Xiànzài hěn duō chāoshì wǎnshàng huì bǎ mài bù wán de shíwù dǎzhé, shǐde bèi diū diào de shíwù shǎo le bù shǎo. Wǒ tīng péngyǒu shuō le zhè jiàn shì, yúshì chángcháng xiàbān hòu qù mǎi dǎzhé de miànbāo hé shuǐguǒ. Zǒngzhī, néng chī de dōngxi jiù bù gāi bèi dāngzuò lèsè.
passage.english: Because my grandma's family was poor when she was little and she often went hungry, she never lets us leave food. Once I couldn't finish a bowl of rice and was about to tip it out when she saw me. She didn't scold me; instead she took me to see the vegetables she grows in the yard and told me how hard growing them is. From that day on I always think about how much I can eat before I take food, and as a result I have never left any since. Now many supermarkets discount unsold food in the evening, which has cut the food thrown away by quite a lot. When a friend told me about this, I started going after work to buy discounted bread and fruit. In short, food that can be eaten should not be treated as garbage.

passage.traditional: 我們學校餐廳每天晚上都會剩下不少飯菜，以前這些飯菜{1}到了第二天就被丟掉。上學期，幾個同學覺得太可惜，{2}去跟餐廳經理討論，希望把剩下的飯菜便宜賣給學生。經理擔心沒有人要買，說每天晚上{3}要有三十個人來買，才值得做。{4}經理對這個想法沒有信心，還是讓他們試了一個月。結果每天八點一到，就有很多同學來排隊，{5}經理改變了看法。現在這個活動{6}讓同學省了錢，也讓餐廳少丟了很多食物。
passage.simplified: 我们学校餐厅每天晚上都会剩下不少饭菜，以前这些饭菜{1}到了第二天就被丢掉。上学期，几个同学觉得太可惜，{2}去跟餐厅经理讨论，希望把剩下的饭菜便宜卖给学生。经理担心没有人要买，说每天晚上{3}要有三十个人来买，才值得做。{4}经理对这个想法没有信心，还是让他们试了一个月。结果每天八点一到，就有很多同学来排队，{5}经理改变了看法。现在这个活动{6}让同学省了钱，也让餐厅少丢了很多食物。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào cāntīng měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu huì shèngxià bù shǎo fàncài, yǐqián zhèxiē fàncài wǎngwǎng dào le dì èr tiān jiù bèi diū diào. Shàng xuéqí, jǐ ge tóngxué juéde tài kěxí, yúshì qù gēn cāntīng jīnglǐ tǎolùn, xīwàng bǎ shèngxià de fàncài piányí mài gěi xuéshēng. Jīnglǐ dānxīn méiyǒu rén yào mǎi, shuō měi tiān wǎnshàng zhìshǎo yào yǒu sānshí ge rén lái mǎi, cái zhídé zuò. Jǐnguǎn jīnglǐ duì zhège xiǎngfǎ méiyǒu xìnxīn, háishì ràng tāmen shì le yí ge yuè. Jiéguǒ měi tiān bā diǎn yí dào, jiù yǒu hěn duō tóngxué lái páiduì, shǐde jīnglǐ gǎibiàn le kànfǎ. Xiànzài zhège huódòng bùjǐn ràng tóngxué shěng le qián, yě ràng cāntīng shǎo diū le hěn duō shíwù.
passage.english: Our school cafeteria has quite a lot of food left every evening, and in the past it was usually thrown away the next day. Last semester a few students thought it was a shame, so they went to discuss it with the cafeteria manager, hoping to sell the leftovers cheaply to students. The manager was worried nobody would buy, and said at least thirty people would have to come each evening to make it worthwhile. Even though the manager had no confidence in the idea, he let them try for a month. As it turned out, as soon as it struck eight each evening, lots of students queued up, which changed the manager's mind. Now the project not only saves students money but also means the cafeteria throws away much less food.

Zìjǐ dài dàizi lái de kèrén, měi cì zài jiǎn wǔ yuán. Dǎzhé de shāngpǐn, mǎi le yǐhòu bù néng huàn. Běn chāoshì kāi dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn.
text.english:
So that food isn't thrown away for nothing, we have evening offers every day:
After 8 p.m.: bread and cakes 30% off
After 9 p.m.: bread and cakes half price; fruit 20% off
Vegetables, meat, fish: 40% off after 9 p.m. (no discount on meat and fish on Sundays)
Customers who bring their own bags: a further NT$5 off each time
Discounted goods cannot be exchanged
Open until 10 p.m.

小美：
冰箱壞了，房東說明天下午四點會有人來修，修好以前不能放東西。
冰箱裡的麵包和蛋糕是我的，我今天晚上會吃完。
那袋玉米是妳的吧？已經放了快兩個星期，我看了一下，有一半壞了，我丟了；好的我拿出來放在妳桌上。
妳那盒水餃還沒打開過，我拿去樓下阿姨家，請她幫忙放在她的冰箱裡，等我們的冰箱可以用了，妳再去拿。
房東說，冰箱修好以後，至少要等四個小時才能再放東西進去。要是到晚上十點還不能放，我們就等第二天早上再放吧。

text.traditional:
我剛來臺灣的時候，第一次跟同學去餐廳吃飯，看到他們把吃不完的菜打包帶回家，覺得很驚訝。在我的國家，很多人把在餐廳打包當作一件讓人不好意思的事，好像自己很窮，所以吃不完的菜往往就留在桌上。
有一次，我們點了太多菜，剩下一大半。我正要走，一位同學就請服務生拿盒子來，把菜都裝進去，還給了我一盒，說：「明天的午餐有了。」我本來有點不好意思，可是第二天中午吃的時候，發現菜還是很好吃，又省了一頓飯錢。
後來我發現，在臺灣，打包是很平常的事，就算在很貴的餐廳也一樣，服務生甚至會主動問客人要不要打包。由於大家都這麼做，因此誰也不會覺得奇怪。這使得我慢慢改變了看法：把吃不完的菜帶走，不是因為窮，是因為愛惜食物。
現在回國的時候，我在餐廳吃不完，也會請服務生幫我打包。朋友們一開始覺得很奇怪，我就把在臺灣學到的道理告訴他們，於是有幾個朋友也開始這麼做了。
text.simplified:
我刚来台湾的时候，第一次跟同学去餐厅吃饭，看到他们把吃不完的菜打包带回家，觉得很惊讶。在我的国家，很多人把在餐厅打包当作一件让人不好意思的事，好像自己很穷，所以吃不完的菜往往就留在桌上。
有一次，我们点了太多菜，剩下一大半。我正要走，一位同学就请服务生拿盒子来，把菜都装进去，还给了我一盒，说：「明天的午餐有了。」我本来有点不好意思，可是第二天中午吃的时候，发现菜还是很好吃，又省了一顿饭钱。
后来我发现，在台湾，打包是很平常的事，就算在很贵的餐厅也一样，服务生甚至会主动问客人要不要打包。由于大家都这么做，因此谁也不会觉得奇怪。这使得我慢慢改变了看法：把吃不完的菜带走，不是因为穷，是因为爱惜食物。
现在回国的时候，我在餐厅吃不完，也会请服务生帮我打包。朋友们一开始觉得很奇怪，我就把在台湾学到的道理告诉他们，于是有几个朋友也开始这么做了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhòu, dì yī cì gēn tóngxué qù cāntīng chīfàn, kàndào tāmen bǎ chī bù wán de cài dǎbāo dài huí jiā, juéde hěn jīngyà. Zài wǒ de guójiā, hěn duō rén bǎ zài cāntīng dǎbāo dāngzuò yí jiàn ràng rén bù hǎoyìsi de shì, hǎoxiàng zìjǐ hěn qióng, suǒyǐ chī bù wán de cài wǎngwǎng jiù liú zài zhuō shàng. Yǒu yí cì, wǒmen diǎn le tài duō cài, shèngxià yí dà bàn. Wǒ zhèng yào zǒu, yí wèi tóngxué jiù qǐng fúwùshēng ná hézi lái, bǎ cài dōu zhuāng jìnqù, hái gěi le wǒ yì hé, shuō: "Míngtiān de wǔcān yǒu le." Wǒ běnlái yǒudiǎn bù hǎoyìsi, kěshì dì èr tiān zhōngwǔ chī de shíhòu, fāxiàn cài háishì hěn hǎochī, yòu shěng le yí dùn fàn qián. Hòulái wǒ fāxiàn, zài Táiwān, dǎbāo shì hěn píngcháng de shì, jiùsuàn zài hěn guì de cāntīng yě yíyàng, fúwùshēng shènzhì huì zhǔdòng wèn kèrén yào bú yào dǎbāo. Yóuyú dàjiā dōu zhème zuò, yīncǐ shéi yě bú huì juéde qíguài. Zhè shǐde wǒ mànmàn gǎibiàn le kànfǎ: bǎ chī bù wán de cài dài zǒu, bú shì yīnwèi qióng, shì yīnwèi àixí shíwù. Xiànzài huíguó de shíhòu, wǒ zài cāntīng chī bù wán, yě huì qǐng fúwùshēng bāng wǒ dǎbāo. Péngyǒumen yì kāishǐ juéde hěn qíguài, wǒ jiù bǎ zài Táiwān xué dào de dàolǐ gàosu tāmen, yúshì yǒu jǐ ge péngyǒu yě kāishǐ zhème zuò le.
text.english:
When I first came to Taiwan and went to a restaurant with classmates for the first time, I was surprised to see them pack up the food they couldn't finish and take it home. In my country, many people treat taking leftovers from a restaurant as something embarrassing, as if you were poor, so unfinished food is usually just left on the table.
Once we ordered too much and more than half was left. I was about to leave when a classmate asked the waiter for boxes, packed all the food, and gave me one, saying, "There's tomorrow's lunch." I felt a little awkward at first, but when I ate it the next day at noon, the food was still good, and it saved me the cost of a meal.
Later I found that in Taiwan taking leftovers is completely normal, even in expensive restaurants; waiters will even ask customers whether they want them packed. Because everyone does it, nobody finds it strange. This slowly changed my mind: taking home what you can't finish isn't because you're poor; it's because you cherish food.
Now when I go home and can't finish a meal at a restaurant, I ask the waiter to pack it too. At first my friends found it odd, so I told them what I learned in Taiwan, and a few of them started doing the same.
