text.traditional:
我媽媽以前很喜歡去一家很大的超市買東西，因為一次買得多，價錢比較便宜。每個週末，她都會買好幾大袋回來，把冰箱放得滿滿的。可是我們家只有三個人，爸爸常常加班，我又住在學校宿舍，很多東西還沒吃完就壞了，只好丟掉。
去年十二月，媽媽整理冰箱的時候，發現裡面有一半以上的東西都放太久了。她算了一下，一年下來，被丟掉的食物至少有一萬塊錢。這件事讓她嚇了一跳，於是她決定改變買東西的習慣。
現在她每次去買菜以前，都會先看看冰箱裡還有什麼，再寫下要買的東西，而且只買三天以內吃得完的。她說，雖然一次買得少，每樣東西都貴了一點，可是由於不必再把食物丟掉，因此一個月下來反而省了不少錢。
她還把冰箱裡快要壞的青菜和肉拿來煮湯、炒飯，當作第二天的午餐。我回家的時候，她常常得意地說：「你看，冰箱裡的東西，一樣都沒有白白丟掉！」
text.simplified:
我妈妈以前很喜欢去一家很大的超市买东西，因为一次买得多，价钱比较便宜。每个周末，她都会买好几大袋回来，把冰箱放得满满的。可是我们家只有三个人，爸爸常常加班，我又住在学校宿舍，很多东西还没吃完就坏了，只好丢掉。
去年十二月，妈妈整理冰箱的时候，发现里面有一半以上的东西都放太久了。她算了一下，一年下来，被丢掉的食物至少有一万块钱。这件事让她吓了一跳，于是她决定改变买东西的习惯。
现在她每次去买菜以前，都会先看看冰箱里还有什么，再写下要买的东西，而且只买三天以内吃得完的。她说，虽然一次买得少，每样东西都贵了一点，可是由于不必再把食物丢掉，因此一个月下来反而省了不少钱。
她还把冰箱里快要坏的青菜和肉拿来煮汤、炒饭，当作第二天的午餐。我回家的时候，她常常得意地说：「你看，冰箱里的东西，一样都没有白白丢掉！」
text.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǐqián hěn xǐhuān qù yì jiā hěn dà de chāoshì mǎi dōngxi, yīnwèi yí cì mǎi de duō, jiàqián bǐjiào piányí. Měi ge zhōumò, tā dōu huì mǎi hǎojǐ dà dài huílái, bǎ bīngxiāng fàng de mǎnmǎn de. Kěshì wǒmen jiā zhǐ yǒu sān ge rén, bàba chángcháng jiābān, wǒ yòu zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè, hěn duō dōngxi hái méi chī wán jiù huài le, zhǐhǎo diū diào. Qùnián shí'èr yuè, māma zhěnglǐ bīngxiāng de shíhòu, fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn yǐshàng de dōngxi dōu fàng tài jiǔ le. Tā suàn le yíxià, yì nián xiàlái, bèi diū diào de shíwù zhìshǎo yǒu yíwàn kuài qián. Zhè jiàn shì ràng tā xià le yí tiào, yúshì tā juédìng gǎibiàn mǎi dōngxi de xíguàn. Xiànzài tā měi cì qù mǎi cài yǐqián, dōu huì xiān kàn kan bīngxiāng lǐ hái yǒu shénme, zài xiě xià yào mǎi de dōngxi, érqiě zhǐ mǎi sān tiān yǐnèi chī de wán de. Tā shuō, suīrán yí cì mǎi de shǎo, měi yàng dōngxi dōu guì le yìdiǎn, kěshì yóuyú bú bì zài bǎ shíwù diū diào, yīncǐ yí ge yuè xiàlái fǎn'ér shěng le bù shǎo qián. Tā hái bǎ bīngxiāng lǐ kuài yào huài de qīngcài hé ròu ná lái zhǔ tāng, chǎofàn, dāngzuò dì èr tiān de wǔcān. Wǒ huí jiā de shíhòu, tā chángcháng déyì de shuō: "Nǐ kàn, bīngxiāng lǐ de dōngxi, yí yàng dōu méiyǒu báibái diū diào!"
text.english:
My mom used to love shopping at a huge supermarket, because buying a lot at once was cheaper. Every weekend she brought home several big bags and packed the fridge full. But there are only three of us; Dad often works late and I live in the school dorm, so a lot went bad before it was eaten and had to be thrown out.
Last December, while tidying the fridge, Mom found that more than half of what was in it had been there too long. She worked it out: over a year, the food thrown away came to at least ten thousand dollars. That gave her a shock, so she decided to change how she shops.
Now before she shops she checks what's still in the fridge, writes down what to buy, and buys only what can be eaten within three days. She says that although buying less at a time makes each item a bit dearer, because she no longer throws food away, she actually saves quite a lot each month.
She also turns vegetables and meat that are about to go off into soup or fried rice for the next day's lunch. When I come home she often says proudly, "Look, not one thing in the fridge got thrown away for nothing!"

prompt.traditional: 媽媽為什麼決定改變買東西的習慣？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈为什么决定改变买东西的习惯？

prompt.english: Why did Mom decide to change how she shops?

choices.traditional: 冰箱太滿，東西放不下了
choices.simplified: 冰箱太满，东西放不下了

questions.why: 這件事讓她嚇了一跳，於是她決定改變: "this" is finding that a year of thrown-out food came to at least NT$10,000. The NT$10,000 is what the wasted food cost, not her whole supermarket spending; the full fridge and the writer in the dorm are part of the old situation.

prompt.traditional: 媽媽改了買東西的習慣以後，花錢方面有什麼改變？

choices.pinyin: Měi yàng guì le yìdiǎn, yí ge yuè fǎn'ér shěng qián.
choices.english: Each item costs a bit more, but she saves each month.

choices.traditional: 每樣便宜了，一年省下一萬塊

questions.why: 每樣東西都貴了一點，可是由於不必再把食物丟掉，因此…反而省了不少錢: dearer per item, cheaper overall. Cheaper items were the bulk-buying days, ten thousand is what a whole year of wasted food cost, and she never says more trips cost more.

prompt.traditional: 從媽媽最後說的話來看，她覺得新做法最成功的地方是什麼？

prompt.english: Judging by Mom's last words, what does she see as the new way's real success?

choices.traditional: 一個月下來省了不少錢
choices.simplified: 一个月下来省了不少钱
choices.pinyin: Yí ge yuè xiàlái shěng le bù shǎo qián.
choices.english: She saves quite a lot each month.

choices.simplified: 丢掉的食物比以前少一半
choices.pinyin: Diū diào de shíwù bǐ yǐqián shǎo yíbàn.
choices.english: She throws away half as much food as before.

choices.traditional: 買回來的食物都用到了
choices.simplified: 买回来的食物都用到了
choices.pinyin: Mǎi huílái de shíwù dōu yòng dào le.

choices.traditional: 不用每個週末去超市了
choices.simplified: 不用每个周末去超市了
choices.pinyin: Bú yòng měi ge zhōumò qù chāoshì le.
choices.english: She no longer has to go every weekend.

questions.why: 得意地說 that 一樣都沒有白白丟掉: what she is proud of in her last words is that nothing goes to waste. Saving money each month is true, but she says it earlier, not in her last words; she says nothing at all is wasted, not half as much; and fewer weekend trips are never her point.
